notes.title: The Seventh Member of the GT3 Family Rides Once More
notes.content:
[p]2021 gave us a lighter, redesigned version of that year’s 911: the [b]2021 Porsche 911 GT3[/b]. Taking a couple lessons from their acclaimed 911 RSR, this GT3 model came with improved aerodynamic design and a top speed of 200 mph. [/p][p align="justify"]With racing  embeded in its DNA (and construction) this car completed a lap of the Nürburgring-Nordschleife in just 6:59.927 minutes.[/p][p][/p][p]And just look at the blue line on the tires. Unlock this car on the Festival Playlist with 20 PTS! [/p][p align="justify"][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b779a00470d7fc88c2db7bb279893007c9f8da60.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]SERIES REWARDS [/b][/p][list][*][p]80 PTS: 2018 Mercedes-AMG E 63 S   [/p][/*][*][p]160 PTS: 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera 2 by Gunther Werks [/p][/*][/list][p][b]SPRING REWARDS [/b][/p][list][*][p]20 PTS: 2021 Porsche 911 GT3  [/p][/*][*][p]40 PTS: Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/80a2ca5231d28ab22895850e543fbd4e6a0bd707.jpg"][/img][/p][p]There are a lot more points to be earned and rewards to be unlocked. Have a go at this week’s Treasure Hunt challenge, here’s the clue you need to solve: Couped Up? Let's AMG the ante by seeing the heights of Mulegé! Figure out the solution and get yourself some well-deserved points.  [/p][p]Here’s the complete list of races and challenges available for this week:  [/p]

notes.title: Get Ready to Explore Japan in Forza Horizon 6!
notes.content: [p]Today we joined the Xbox Tokyo Game Show livestream to reveal Forza Horizon 6 featuring our next, highly requested destination: Japan. The teaser, which you can check out below, also celebrates the many iconic locations the Horizon Festival has visited over the years. [/p][previewyoutube="lwlw0ChiSR0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’re thrilled to be taking players to Japan in Forza Horizon 6, the next entry in the critically acclaimed and award-winning series of open world driving games. [/p][p]Forza Horizon 6 will launch first on Xbox Series X|S consoles and PC in 2026. It will be included with Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass at launch. With the excitement for this franchise on other platforms, we also have Playground Games and Turn 10 Studios working together to bring Forza Horizon 6 to PlayStation 5 post-launch. [/p][p]In Forza Horizon 6, you will get to discover a scenic and breathtaking Japan, where you will build up your racing status to become a Legend at the Horizon Festival.  [/p][p]As you already know, Japan has been one of the most iconic and requested locations by the Forza Horizon community. We are so excited for you to experience it, and we can't wait to share more details on Forza Horizon 6 early next year. Stay tuned! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/87b35a9871958b45fa7e68ddf0026fb1b730a6b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In the meantime, be sure to [u][url="https://aka.ms/FH6Xbox"]add Forza Horizon 6 to your Wishlist on the Microsoft Store[/url][/u] or [u][url="https://aka.ms/FH6Steam"]Steam[/url][/u] to stay up to date with the latest news from the team.  [/p][p]You can also [u][url="https://discord.gg/forza"]join our Forza Discord server[/url][/u] and the [u][url="https://aka.ms/FH6Forums"]Forza Forums[/url][/u] to chat about all things Forza Horizon and participate in contests with the community. Plus, be sure to follow our [b]@ForzaHorizon[/b] channels on [u][url="https://www.facebook.com/forzahorizon/"]Facebook[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.instagram.com/forzahorizonofficial/"]Instagram[/url][/u],  [u][url="https://www.youtube.com/@Forza"]YouTube[/url][/u],  [u][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@forzahorizon"]TikTok[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://twitter.com/ForzaHorizon"]X (formerly Twitter)[/url][/u] to get the latest Festival content delivered to your social feed. [/p][p]We’ve also put together a handy [u][url="https://aka.ms/FH6FAQ"]Forza Horizon 6 FAQ on our Forza Support website[/url][/u] – check it out, and we’ll see you at the Horizon Festival! [/p]

notes.title: Utility is the Name of the Game for this Week’s Vote.
notes.content:
We take to the dirt this week! Two compact monsters partner up with two utility pickups. Both pairs jump into the arena, but only one will emerge as the champion of the Horizon Backstage Vote. Which team is your favorite this time around? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e97bad96dd3e40b04b366e4722d86b583506cb77.jpg[/img]

One of Subaru’s signature vehicles kicks-off this week’s battle – the [b]2022 Subaru WRX[/b]. If you are looking for a compact car that excels at drifting, off-roading, and making a very satisfying sound look no further! Its brother in arms (and in brand) this week is the [b]1981 Subaru BRAT[/b]. The R in BRAT stands for Recreational, which means that this car is built to have fun, and you certainly will on any terrain you fancy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/989654f5c9312254431ec2ca58530bfb10587a49.png[/img]

A fierce design, sports-tuned suspension, and a powerful V6 engine are among the highlights in the [b]2023 Toyota Camry TRD[/b] – an everyday drive with a sporting spirit! One of the most unique pickups ever built completes this pair. Get your groove on with the [b]1961 Volkswagen Double Cab Pickup[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c8b083ebdd1888a16c3f9397ecf55829715a33b2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: F1 Speed and Classic Luxury Show Up at Your Garage This Week!
notes.content:
Speed and comfort go hand in hand with this week’s 20 PTS reward —the [b]2015 Mercedes-AMG GT S[/b]. Underneath the gorgeous looks of the GTS S you’ll find a 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8 that produces more than 500 bhp. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/439e2af4b294188cd9009ca8a1400c06f92f6a44.jpg[/img]

The SLS was the main inspiration for the GT S with clear differences including the lack of gullwing doors and a narrower wheelsbase.  

Unlock this modern wonder and grow your German supercar collection until September 25! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1a8da046384f4f08b2847efd0458a8441c303406.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Four Supercars for One Super Battle!
notes.content: [p]Four supercars are about to jump onto the field and compete for your vote. Pick your favorite pair of track toys and vote in-game. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3ce709cf504729d62ef26f081820375b7e5491b7.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]The first hyper team this week starts with a hero of the LM GTE-pro class built to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Ford’s iconic win at Le Mans in 66: the [b]2016 Ford #66 Ford Racing GTLM Le Mans[/b]. Boasting a power-to-weight ratio of nearly two and a 2.5 turbo engine that amasses 380 horsepower, the [b]2013 Donkervoort D8 GTO[/b] completes this first team of track superstars. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ede125ff0e06f4f8de4e2c6c1fdd3c45916ddd02.png"][/img][/p][p align="justify"]The [b]2023 Porsche 911 GT3 R[/b], a high-power endurance racer, starts the lineup for the second team this week. A mighty 4.2-liter engine powers this built-for-performance beast. Completing the second team is the [b]2016 Lotus 3-Eleven[/b], a car that’s all thrill and no roof! This British icon is powered by a phenomenal 3.5 supercharged V6 engine that produces 410 bhp. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/73a95a8f584659809dedd4ace115e1209af7b851.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: German Automotive Returns Presenting One of its Finest Racing Machines!
notes.content:
[p] [/p][p]The [b]2012 Porsche 911 GT3 RS 4.0[/b] is the 911 RS’s evolution, including 50 additional horsepower thanks to its redesigned airflow and larger displacement. This car was built for Porsche fans who love to take their cars to the track and experience their true potential.  [/p][p]Lighter, fiercer, and bolder than its predecessor, the RS 4.0 puts together an elegant look with exciting power for hardcore fans of beating the clock. Only 600 units of this car were made, all of them sold out as fast as this car can go around the track, and now you can have your go in one of them unlocking it for 20 PTS until September 18 on the Festival Playlist. [/p][p]Which side are you leaning on with your builds on this car? [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b436fd04e170bb9dc51a88f5c8ef9397f6aed4cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p]

[b]SERIES REWARDS [/b]  [/p][list][*][p]80 PTS: 2018 Mercedes-AMG E 63 S   [/p][/*][*][p]160 PTS: 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera 2 by Gunther Werks [/p][/*][/list][p]  [b]SPRING REWARDS [/b]  [/p][list][*][p]20 PTS: 2012 Porsche 911 GT3 RS 4.0  [/p][/*][*][p]40 PTS: Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p] 
[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e0df7b3e2a08de006640f584b20cd4a31c794fd5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can also start gathering points to unlock your new favorite road trip drive: the [b]2018 Mercedes-AMG E 63 S[/b]. This superb sedan is equipped with a twin-turbocharged V8 engine that puts 603 horsepower at your disposal. [/p][p]Get ready for a speedy launch and supreme acceleration with the all-wheel drive system featured in this luxury drive. However, if sharp corners come your way and you wish to take them a little differently, you can engage the Drift Mode included in the car to shut down the power on the front wheels and go for some spins! [/p][p]Earn 80 PTS on the Festival Playlist to unlock the [b]2018 Mercedes-AMG E 63 S[/b] until October 2.  [/p][p]There are even more rewards to unlock during this Summer season, take a look below: [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ea981110253d358c960ab43e9d984abdcf3d6daa.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Get Ready for a Dirty Fight at the Horizon Backstage!
notes.content:
This week we have four off-road specialists! By design or customization, these cars love dirt, mud and pretty much everything but tarmac. Which team will get your vote? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/878661165bfaffcf1ce7d7b3036f3b51ea5aad78.jpg[/img]

The first pair is two very different Porsches with one thing in common: they love rally events. Take the [b]2023 Porsche 911 Rallye[/b], which has everything that makes a 911 superb, while adding a complete off-road package to take on the most extreme races on the planet. Its companion is no slack either. The [b]2018 Porsche Macan LPR Rally Raid[/b] was custom built to compete in one of the toughest motorsport classes ever. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/292d80be1345e8063e51b5f954be95b6cc8c5e51.png[/img]

Their opponents might be smaller but make up for it with agility and precision! Starting with the [b]2017 Ford #14 Rahal Letterman Lanigan Racing GRC Fiesta[/b], this all-wheel drive rallycross car is perfect for cross country events on the Horizon Festival! Completing the pair is one of the most dominating contenders of the Rally Dakar: the [b]2013 MINI X-Raid ALL4 Racing Countryman[/b].

notes.title: Add a Muscle Car Hidden Gem to Your Garage!
notes.content: [p]It’s the final week of the [b]Forza Horizon 5 Summer Party[/b] and we’re ending it on a high exhaust note. Put your pedal to the metal and unlock the final rewards this series has for you. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/09bdfe6ee4ac4b8821b2190087dd9067f2ce929a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Feel the sting of Dodge’s follow up to the wonderful Plymouth RoadRunner. Loaded with a mighty 7.0-liter Hemi engine, unlock the 1970 Dodge Coronet Super Bee for 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist. The Super Bee was designed by Harvey J. Winn who submitted the design for an internal contest, but we were the real winners with this machine! [/p][p]Unlock the Super Bee and take it for a spin in the last week of Summer Party from September 04 until September 11! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2e188c6f0eb210d6261332b07cc91f05a06e9917.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]No series is complete without fresh customization items that will help you look your best. This week, the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] includes the [b]Captive Tee[/b] and “[b]Snap![/b]” emote for you to choose! You can also drive home in the [b]1987 Porsche 959[/b] and the [b]2018 McLaren 600LT Coupé[/b].    [/p][p]Need more points? Here’s how you can do it (and how to earn more rewards) this week! [/p][p][b]SERIES REWARDS   [/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]80 PTS:[/b] 2012 Lamborghini Aventador J [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]160 PTS:[/b] 1967 Mercedes-Benz 280 SL [/p][/*][/list][p][b]SEASON REWARDS   [/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]20 PTS:[/b] 1970 Dodge Coronet Super Bee [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]40 PTS:[/b] Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6d17e3d6209253e57f9bd66dfa5f27fb0ebf3f07.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Gas or Electric, All Choices are Superb!
notes.content:
This week we welcome two supercars and two electric marvels to the Horizon Backstage for a unique battle! Pick your favorite pair and vote in-game today. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a57b7107dea065f847986b100b78f9a33ba677fd.jpg[/img]

The first car coming to this all-star lineup is the [b]2023 Chevrolet Corvette Z06[/b], a supercar on the affordable side capable of going toe-to-toe with cars twice the price. The battery-powered machine partnering with the Z06 is the[b] 2022 BMW i4 eDrive40[/b]. This car carries the legacy of the German brand with its traditional rear-wheel drive, but takes it to the future with electric power! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2004e220b6bcbf913819f171d79a669cd2c23550.jpg[/img]

Their first rival is a super powered hybrid coming straight from Maranello! The [b]2020 Ferrari SF90 Stradale[/b]’s 986 horsepower comes courtesy of its 4-liter V8 gas engine and its three electric motors. This time the Prancing Horse partners with a white tiger, as Hyundai’s premier electric sports saloon completes this pair – the [b]2022 Hyundai IONIQ 6[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8a9a23502d03d41d10fd9e5639f1812c100d1c5f.png[/img]

notes.title: Ready for a Road Trip on the 2022 Toyota GR86?
notes.content: [p]The penultimate week of the [b]Summer Party[/b] brings an unmissable new car to the [b]Festival Playlist[/b], the all-new [b]2022 Toyota GR86[/b] can be yours for [b]20 PTS[/b]! Did you know this was our 7th most requested car ever on the [b]Suggestions Hub [/b]when it was released?  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/36178571cde0a39a612791ace6dafbb7f507481f.png"][/img][/p][p]And we can understand your requests; the GR86 is a car built with fun in mind, an ideal machine to take on a road trip! It was designed to be small, quick, agile, and an absolute hoot to drive.  [/p][p]Don’t let its 2.4-liter four-cylinder engine deceive you, this car is as nimble as can be and will certainly give you a run for your money. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d2a8071dd79baa9b2e4f3070b9b7412bffdca292.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]GR86[/b] will be available from [b]August 28 [/b]until [b]September 04 [/b]through the [b]Festival Playlist[/b]! [/p][p]Thinking about taking the GR86 for a spin? Don’t forget to style up first! The [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] has some great options this week including the [b]Confetti Canon Horn[/b] and a [b]Bird Pattern Sundress[/b]. Cars include the [b]1965 Shelby Cobra 427 S/C[/b] and the [b]1994 Ford Supervan 3[/b]. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b20ed3c30e3ee351cfb6f04f9f8b76dcc831ddce.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Need some more content? Looking for a new ride to try? Here’s a look at the many rewards and unlockables available for you this week: [/p][p][b]SERIES REWARDS  [/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]80 PTS:[/b] 2012 Lamborghini Aventador J [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]160 PTS:[/b] 1967 Mercedes-Benz 280 SL [/p][/*][/list][p][b]SEASON REWARDS  [/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]20 PTS:[/b] Toyota GR86 [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]40 PTS:[/b] Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5eee227138f460f13a64a3c4feb8ab9389c7107c.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Windows Central: Microsoft анонсирует Forza Horizon 6 в рамках Tokyo Game Show 2025
notes.content: Компания Microsoft планирует анонсировать Forza Horizon 6 в рамках выставки Tokyo Game Show 2025. Об этом сообщает издание Windows Central, которое получило доступ ко внутренней документации платформодержателя.

notes.title: A High-Performance Duel is Brewing This Week!
notes.content:
Four cars built for high speeds and competition battle it out for your vote at the Horizon Backstage! Which super powered pair are you choosing this week? 

The first car in this battle is the most powerful M series car ever created – the [b]2022 BMW M5 CS[/b]. As its name implies, this car is built for competition. Its mighty partner for this week is the [b]1989 Vauxhall Lotus Carlton[/b] – a muscled-up version of the Opel Carlton. Lotus did quite a lot with this car redesigning engine, exterior, suspension, and more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/868976ecd51251276592dd278ae78ef1d1134315.jpg[/img]

Their opponents are two American modern muscle cars. The first rider joining this rodeo is the [b]2022 Cadillac CT4-V Blackwing[/b], a luxury sedan with a 472 horsepower engine. Rounding up this corner of the battle comes a reworked and reimagined Mustang – the [b]2003 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/aa2fd5f95c5458d88d063170b0dbecbd2d54f221.jpg[/img]

Which team is going to take the win this week? The choice is yours to make! Vote in-game until August 28! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1d34437fe3985e1e1505c39c9a870131f37d4a0e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ride the Waves of the Summer Party Starting Today!
notes.content:
[p][b]Summer Party[/b] has started in [b]Forza Horizon 5! [/b]You can drive around Mexico in the [b]1973 Ford XB Falcon GT. [/b]Considered the most famous Australian car abroad as the star of Mad Max and the first all-Australian designed car from Ford, the XB Falcon delivers a snarling 300 horsepower from its 351 “Cleveland” V8. With less than 1,000 XB GT hardtops produced, this iconic Australian muscle car is a rare bird.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2e188c6f0eb210d6261332b07cc91f05a06e9917.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is the first week you can start earning points to unlock the 2012 Lamborghini Aventador J, a roofless version of the Aventador with reduced weight, added Carbonskin technology, and a ton of power at the tip of your toes. [/p][p]Have you encountered any issues with the latest playlist? [u][url="http://aka.ms/THUB"]Let us know on the Troubleshooting Hub[/url][/u]. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5f8ae5869baa6bc98822a4ed316813f04316a748.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here’s a closer look at the events and rewards in this week’s [b]Festival Playlist[/b]. Yours to unlock by [b]Thursday, August 21.[/b] [/p][p][b]SERIES REWARDS[/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]80 PTS[/b]: 2012 Lamborghini Aventador J [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]160 PTS[/b]: 1967 Mercedes-Benz 280 SL [/p][/*][/list][p][b]SEASON REWARDS[/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]20 PTS[/b]: 1973 Ford XB Falcon GT [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]40 PTS[/b]: Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p]Over in the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b], this week’s stock includes the [b]1926 Bugatti Type 35 C [/b]and the [b]2016 Porsche 911 GT3 RS[/b], as well as [b]Minecraft Theme Car Horn[/b] and [b]Red Round Shades[/b]. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1859ece83a62a3cba779b719f9a5155b2c57bb70.jpg"][/img] [/p]

notes.title: Drive the 2020 Hot Wheels Legends Tour Winner in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content: [p]The barbecue continues to sizzle as the [b]Summer Party[/b] enters its second week at [b]Horizon Mexico[/b]! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0a93773a0e17ed8669443115ec3121b3fbc8dff0.png"][/img][/p][p]The smallest member of this family of rewards is here with the option to take the roof away and enjoy the sun. Drive the amazing 2017 Abarth 124 Spider as you unlock it with 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist. This little car born out of the same mold that made the Mazda Miata comes with a delicious, turbocharged engine. [/p][p]You have until August 28 to unlock your new favorite summer ride! [/p][p] [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1859ece83a62a3cba779b719f9a5155b2c57bb70.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This week the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] features an old-timey speedster (with massive steampunk vibes), the [b]Napier Railton[/b] straight out of 1933. Bask in the glory of its W12 engine that can amass 580 bhp! [/p][p]You will also be able to find the stunning [b]2019 Ferrari 488 Pista[/b]. The iconic hood, magnificent racing stripes, and the mightiest V8 Ferrari had ever made, make this a must have for lovers of the Prancing Horse and motorheads alike. The [b]Air Guitar[/b] emote and [b]Orange Race Suit[/b] clothing item will also be available to give your character a fresh look. [/p][p]Remember that you still have two more weeks to earn 80 PTS and unlock the 2012 Lamborghini Aventador J! [/p][p]Want your dream ride to be featured in Forza Horizon 5? [url="http://aka.ms/SHUB"][u]Upvote your favorites on the Suggestions Hub[/u][/url]. Have you encountered any issues with the latest update? [url="http://aka.ms/THUB"][u]Let us know on the Troubleshooting Hub[/u][/url]. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/daf88487a0446250b6ddae5244484319420955ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Coming right up, a list of all the rewards and challenges you will be able to unlock until [b]August 3[/b]: [/p][p][b]SERIES REWARDS [/b] [/p][list][*][p][b]80 PTS:[/b] 2012 Lamborghini Aventador J [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]160 PTS:[/b] 1967 Mercedes-Benz 280 SL [/p][/*][/list][p][b]SEASON REWARDS[/b]  [/p][list][*][p][b]20 PTS: [/b]2017 Abarth 124 Spider [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]40 PTS:[/b] Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0aff1bb499e0658031cc937afe5e289e65b3acdd.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: All-Terrain Titans Partner with Everyday Rides this Week!
notes.content: [p]Fun comes in all shapes and sizes, specially if you are looking at this week’s Horizon Backstage Vote lineup. You have until August 21 to vote – may the best pair win! [/p][p]Your first team of David and Goliath cars starts with a truck with an unmatched legacy of climbing rocks and running on mud. Get a hold of the Fox suspension and off-road capability of the [b]2019 Toyota 4Runner TRD[/b] Pro. With the body of a minivan but the heart of a compact, the first team is completed with the [b]2013 Wuling Sunshine S[/b], one of the world’s best-selling cars ever! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/20b49e85b6fdb6700654adc69af107c721760613.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The already night-invulnerable Land Cruiser gets even more hardcore with a makeover by the Arctic Trucks team. Captaining this team, is the [b]2016 Toyota Land Cruiser Arctic Trucks AT37[/b]. The ying to all-terrain yang comes in the shape of a revived classic – the [b]2015 MG MG3.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/529fbf24838f917d8bdd9ed53749af0a1c1dff89.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Vote for your favorite team today! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8782ddbe7b473320638d4d4dfbbcdb09eabd96ca.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Remember Historic Britain in the Last Week of this Celebration!
notes.content: [p]We’re on to the final week of the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary as Forza Horizon 4 drifts into the spotlight and we reminisce about those fresh Spring days in beautiful, historic Britain. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/df4173ffc12a1ce4523d24d19ecb7d0225642dc6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Remember, this is the final week to participate in the [b]Monthly Rivals[/b] and [b]Forza EV[/b] events, as well as to earn Festival Playlist completion for the [b]Horizon Origins Story[/b] and to unlock the [b]Series Rewards[/b]: [/p][p][b]80 PTS[/b]: 2013 Wuling Sunshine S [/p][p][b]160 PTS[/b]: 1962 Peel P50 [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/20b49e85b6fdb6700654adc69af107c721760613.jpg"][/img][/p][p]All the events and rewards mentioned in this blog are available until Thursday, August 14. Here’s a look at what’s happening in Horizon Mexico this week: [/p][p][b]20 PTS[/b]: 2012 Eagle Speedster [/p][p][b]40 PTS[/b]: Backstage Pass [/p][p]Welcome to the UK! Head on over to our Forza Horizon 4 inspired Festival site, set up for this week only south of the Horizon Stadium in [b]Tierra Prospera[/b]. Smash [b]10 Horizon UK Bonus Boards [/b]and you’ll be rewarded Forza Horizon 4’s British cover hero – the [b]2018 McLaren Senna[/b]. Drive the car honoring Ayrton Senna’s incredible accomplishments in the [b]Forzathon Weekly [/b]and don’t forget to snap an image in this week’s [b]Photo Challenge [/b]to unlock the [b]UK Cover Car [/b]horn. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7ab3e24f88acdd9137c81cdd1c88097451a8057f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Can you master the [b]2018 Land Rover Range Rover Velar First Edition[/b]? Unlock it in [b]Survival [/b]featured in this week’s [b]Seasonal Playground Games [/b]and put the car to the test in [b]The Trial [/b]to unlock the [b]2013 McLaren P1[/b]. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/def6560fd3ccee5eec4719ebf2d2e357a1e83c6a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This week has two [b]Seasonal Championships [/b]where you can win the [b]2019 Aston Martin DBS Superleggera [/b]and “[b]A Moment Apart[/b]” by Odesza for your [b]Horizon Mixtape [/b]– that incredible opening song everyone hears on Forza Horizon 4’s start screen. [/p][p]The finishing touches on this week’s Playlist include [b]Horizon Open[/b], where you’ll need to complete a [b]Dirt Racing Custom[/b] event and the [b]Snow Crew Socks[/b] will be yours. Plus, [b]The Eliminator[/b] – our battle royale mode first introduced in Forza Horizon 4; [b]finish 30th or better[/b] to unlock the [b]Karaoke[/b] emote.  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a626fe9cef8c9e6ca1fa0a125a2b7a2fe371af75.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, over in [b]Super7[/b], another game mode first introduced at Horizon Britain, take home a [b]2020 McLaren GT[/b] by successfully completing all seven challenges posted on the board. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b2aac3e9e581b1992c68417e1aeca856f1414e8f.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: A Visit from Another Hemisphere Arrives at Horizon Mexico!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c575d872d7ae5e9d5d045eb17416a07524aa1872.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome to Australia, mate! Did you know the third installment in the Forza Horizon series brought the world’s greatest automotive festival to the Land Down Under?  [/p][p]Whether you spent most of your time in Surfer’s Paradise, in the Outback, or down by Byron Bay to watch those iconic sunsets, we’re celebrating those Aussie adventures all week long in Forza Horizon 5. Pack your Ute, we’re off on a road trip! [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/de53198a5454468df9549699394ebb6beb5925f4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Available until Thursday, August 7, this week’s rewards include: [/p][list][*][p][b]20 PTS[/b]: 1985 HDT VK Commodore Group A [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]40 PTS[/b]: Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p]There’s a new temporary Forza Horizon 3 Festival Outpost setup in Mexico’s desert, south of [b]Dunas Blancas[/b]. Smash [b]10 Horizon Australia Bonus Boards[/b] in its vicinity to unlock the [b]2016 Lamborghini Centenario LP 770-4[/b]. Be sure to photograph it to unlock the [b]Australia Cover Car[/b] horn, then put it to the test in the [b]Forzathon Weekly[/b] as we celebrate Forza Horizon 3’s cover car, built for Ferruccio Lamborghini’s one hundredth birthday.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f9fe552fcde691ce41d81142db37cbfedf73ba62.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]Pay a visit to the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] where you can unlock the [b]2015 Koenigsegg One:1[/b] and the [b]2004 Nissan Pickup #23 Rally Raid[/b], as well as the [b]What's Inside[/b] emote, the [b]Fred V Grafix[/b] car horn and the [b]Horizon Australia Tee[/b]. [/p][p]It’s another [b]Stock Showdown[/b] in [b]The Trial[/b] this week. Push the [b]2014 HSV GEN-F GTS[/b] to its limits and assist your teammates towards victory to win the [b]1998 Nissan R390 (GT1)[/b]. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4f85e77ef74a638cb0f94543de72362848d13102.jpg"][/img][/p][p]They were new to Forza Horizon 3, so we’re spotlighting them on this week’s Festival Playlist. Complete a trio of [b]Danger Signs[/b] at [b]Metal Bird[/b], [b]Ranas Saltarinas[/b] and [b]Salto De Río[/b], as well as fourth in [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] titled [b]Ice Crash[/b], and you’ll unlock a [b]Super Wheelspin[/b] from each. [/p][p]Aussie Rules in this week’s [b]Seasonal Championships[/b], where you can expand your [b]Horizon Mixtape[/b] playlist with “[b]Ingrid is a Hybrid[/b]” from Dusky – the Forza Horizon 3 start screen song, as well as your car collection with the [b]2014 HSV GEN-F GTS[/b] and the [b]2011 Hot Wheels Bone Shaker[/b]. Reach for the Stars at [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] and you’ll take home a [b]2010 Nissan 370Z[/b]. [/p][p]Next week, we’re celebrating beautiful, historic Britain for our last season of the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary. Until then, the party at Horizon Mexico is celebrating all things Australia and Forza Horizon 3, and you’re invited to join them! [/p]

notes.title: Forza Horizon 5 Festival Playlist – Horizon 10-Year Anniversary: Week 2, Autumn
notes.content: [p]Ready to relive those Southern Europe road-trips and parties? It’s the second week of the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary and there’s so much to discover on the Festival Playlist in celebration of Forza Horizon 2. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/63c1e38c3f74d2fb978bc8045ce1f0b0b02cbca5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Before we dive into the slate of weekly activities available until Thursday, July 31 here’s a look at this week’s seasonal rewards: [/p][list][*][p][b]20 PTS[/b]: 2012 Lamborghini Gallardo LP 570-4 Spyder Performante [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]40 PTS[/b]: Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p]This week, head over to the new Forza Horizon 2 inspired Festival site temporarily setup of west of Guanajuato in [b]Colinas Áridas[/b]. Smash [b]10 Horizon Europe Bonus Boards[/b] placed nearby to unlock the [b]2014 Lamborghini Huracán LP 610-4[/b] and don’t forget to capture it in this week’s [b]Photo Challenge[/b] to unlock the [b]Europe Cover Car[/b] horn. Forza Horizon 2’s cover car features prominently in the [b]Weekly Forzathon[/b], the perfect excuse to tune up its rumbling, burbling V10 engine. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/cc28979dcc3050b47dbd3d982166a5ff7c99c536.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Visit the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] and acquire the [b]2018 Bugatti Chiron[/b] and the [b]2012 Lamborghini Aventador LP700-4[/b], as well as [b]The Robot[/b] emote, the [b]Paint Spray[/b] car horn and the [b]Horizon Europe Tee[/b]. [/p][p]Over in [b]The Trial[/b], which is a Stock Showdown behind the wheel of the [b]2007 Peugeot 207 Super 2000[/b] on dirt trails, you can take home the [b]2009 Ferrari 458 Italia[/b]. Don’t have the prerequisite car? Don’t worry – it’s up for grabs in the [b]Hot Hatch Hustle Seasonal Championship[/b]. [/p][p]Don’t miss out on this week’s [b]Seasonal Championships[/b]. Get behind the wheel of a [b]Honda Civic Type R[/b] and compete to win the [b]Honda Hoodie[/b] all week long so you can show off your racing skills! Win the Euro Cross to add “[b]Nocturne[/b]” by Keeno to your [b]Horizon Mixtape[/b] playlist – the Forza Horizon 2 start screen song, and as previously mentioned, the [b]2007 Peugeot 207 Super 2000[/b] is also available. Over in [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b], drive [b]Into the Nexus[/b] and win to earn the [b]1993 Renault Clio Williams[/b]. [/p][p]  [/p][p]That’s everything you can look forward to in this week’s celebration of Horizon Europe. Next time, we’ll be reminiscing everything that made the Land Down Under so special – don’t miss out and we’ll see you at the Horizon Festival! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2d0fad7a56816a30898d9162affa5cb1a334ee68.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Celebrate Forza Horizon’s Legacy Once More!
notes.content: [p]We celebrate Forza Horizon’s legacy one more time with the return of the 10-Year Anniversary Playlist.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s reignite the celebrations and see what this Playlist brings to the Horizon Festival![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/da7dea5deddc50e2c5c36bbd6269efd1a620ba60.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Evolving World[/b][/h2][p]Forza Horizon 5’s Mexico is redressing for the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary. Each week, a new Festival site will be temporarily setup in Mexico in celebration of the past Festivals.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/06a545ad38bd509bdcf56c0d8b87264c7b739969.png"][/img][/p][p]In the Summer “Wet” season, reminisce about the origins of the Horizon Festival in Colorado as we celebrate the original Forza Horizon with a new festival site in the Copper Canyon. In the Autumn “Storm” season, reflect on the days of cross-country racing through Europe’s vineyards in Forza Horizon 2 with an associated outpost west of the city of Guanajuato.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/aff207ff0c2b579254ed9c1b1355513fd51ccc9d.png"][/img][/p][p]The Winter “Dry” season is all about the land down under as we relive the days of driving through the Outback in Forza Horizon 3’s Australia with a desert festival setup south of Dunas Blancas. Last, but certainly not least, we look back on countryside roads of beautiful, historic Britain as we celebrate Forza Horizon 4 with an appropriately themed outpost south of the Horizon Stadium.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3fa953be9429d44e4a79345dd240a538179571ac.png"][/img][/p][p]Over the next four weeks, festival races at Horizon Mexico are also involved in these anniversary celebrations, as classic flags, gantries, displays and towers recreate the vibes and essence of our past Horizon Festivals.[/p][p]Plus, be on the lookout for the Bonus Board collectibles. Each week, these iconic “smashables” can be found around the temporary Festival sites mentioned above and are a fun throwback to the Bonus Boards of previous Horizon games.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9b13464cf61afc988ec535cde6529da73d3ce20f.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Festival Playlist[/b][/h2][h3][b]2013 Wuling Sunshine S[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8fe5ce5cfd389e4d9e5f0222478ddbba7b09575b.png"][/img][/p][p]Wuling (“five diamonds”) is the biggest manufacturer of microvans in China. These pint-sized commercial vehicles are no bigger than compact cars but are the work horses for millions of farmers and small businesses. One of these microvans, the Wuling Sunshine, is the best-selling car of all time in China. Launched in 2002, it’s seen dozens of variants, and has become a cultural icon with Chinese consumers. The second generation launched in 2013 with an “S” variant, with technical upgrades like ABS and EBD. Powered by a 1.2-liter engine that outputs 82hp with a 5-speed manual transmission, it may not sound like a whole lot under the hood, but Forza tuners will certainly maximise its potential after an engine swap and various upgrades.[/p][h3][b]2012 Lamborghini Gallardo LP 570-4 Spyder Performante[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a4cf3dfaa9a81af96e1feb0cf4bc9790101b64ee.png"][/img][/p][p]The already amazing Gallardo LP570-4 Superleggera gets an upgrade by removing its roof. Just like its predecessor, the 2012 Lamborghini Gallardo LP 570-4 Spyder Performante is a nimble powerhouse capable of producing 570 bhp while being swift and grippy through corners. This car’s body was designed to be striking in appearance, completely aerodynamic, and as light as possible. Some of the new features added to the Spyder Performante version of the Gallardo include a new front with a V-shaped nose. The Spyder is the last member of the Gallardo line to be built, and only 180 copies of the car were ever produced.[/p][h3][b]1985 HDT VK Commodore Group A[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c373d5216d74479bd150869071d11332de705441.png"][/img][/p][p]In Australia, the name Peter Geoffrey Brock evokes Australian Touring Car Championships, national pride, and the twisting, undulating roads of Bathurst. The Commodore Group A is a distinctive car in Brock’s racing career, built during the period when he was running his own company building race-bred road cars. In the mid-1980s, home grown rules evolved to a European formula that included homologation. We have these rules to thank for the 502 models of the VK Commodore Group A that were built. Dubbed “Bluey” or the “Blue Meanie” for the Formula Blue color painted on the models: in sight, sound, and speed, the Group A holds a special place in the heart of Holden fans.[/p][h3][b]2012 Eagle Speedster[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2f018b549dc5e5ba2bfe212906015d26a5a54cb0.png"][/img][/p][p]The bumper-to-bumper beauty that is the Eagle Speedster will have you gasping for breath and racing to victory in Forza Horizon 5. If the chopped windscreen, classic Jaguar E-type lines, and low-slung cockpit doesn’t fire your synapses into a frenzy then you have probably flat-lined. The Eagle Speedster is a vintage ride with all the technology of today.[/p][h2][b]Horizon Backstage Vote[/b][/h2][p]Here's the card for the next matchups taking place at the Horizon Backstage Vote for this series. Make sure to cast your vote and pick the car pair that gets added to the Backstage Shop![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f9dbd3857b1873d111bb35ad5649a3b52e112898.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Week 1 (July 17 – July 24):[/b] 1997 Toyota Soarer and 2023 Formula Drift #64 Forsberg Racing Nissan Z VERSUS 1995 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra R and 1965 Hoonigan Gymkhana 10 Ford Hoonicorn Mustang[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4f523a2031187fc041c2b9b8e7e5d38805ac72d8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Week 2 (July 24 – July 31):[/b] 2007 Alfa Romeo 8C Competizione and 1991 Bentley Turbo R VERSUS 2008 Aston Martin DBS and 1990 Aston Martin Lagonda[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f04495b6a1ee09d991f5510d9e6c34cce9f27527.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Week 3 (July 31 – August 7):[/b] 1973 Ford XB Falcon GT and 1966 Chevrolet Nova Super Sport VERSUS 1968 Plymouth Barracuda Formula-S and 1970 AMC Rebel The Machine[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/44e7c9d4e7f35c0a59bd8cd59cc430e1b508aa65.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Week 4 (August 7 – August 14):[/b] 2021 Mercedes-AMG GT Black Series and 2021 Bentley Flying Spur VERSUS 2023 Porsche 911 GT3 RS and 2018 Mercedes-AMG E 63 S[/p][h2][b]What’s Next[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9fe4041944c91888c8cd84d7f2cd770c55437b3c.png"][/img][/p][p]The choice of the next Festival Playlist is up to you! Choose between these two Festival themes, challenges and rewards to play next month.[/p][p][b]Summer Party[/b][/p][p][b]Series Rewards:[/b][/p][list][*][p]2012 Lamborghini Aventador J[/p][/*][*][p]1967 Mercedes-Benz 280 SL[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weekly Rewards:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Summer: 1973 Ford XB Falcon GT[/p][/*][*][p]Autumn: 1980 FIAT 124 Sport Spider[/p][/*][*][p]Winter: 2022 Toyota GR86[/p][/*][*][p]Spring: 1970 Dodge Coronet Super Bee[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Back to the 90’s[/b][/p][p][b]Series Rewards:[/b][/p][list][*][p]1992 Ferrari 512 TR[/p][/*][*][p]1992 GMC Typhoon[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Weekly Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Summer: 1997 Toyota Soarer 2.5 GT-T[/p][/*][*][p]Autumn: 1998 Mitsubishi FTO GP Version R[/p][/*][*][p]Winter: 1990 Aston Martin Lagonda[/p][/*][*][p]Spring: 1996 SUBARU SVX[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Celebrate Forza Horizon 5’s 10-Year Anniversary Once More!
notes.content: [p]Welcome to the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary as we celebrate this past decade of fast cars, iconic music, and incredible road-trips all at the world’s greatest automotive festival. Whether you first joined us in Colorado, Southern Europe, Australia, Britain, or Mexico, we’re excited to have you onboard to mark this moment together! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/eec171a5c71719b0afbc7ea506a8a78ed0ca8834.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Mexico is also joining in the festivities as Forza Horizon 5’s map is redecorated for the Horizon 10-Year Anniversary. Look out for classic flags, gantries, displays and towers in races that recreate the vibes and essence of our past Horizon Festivals. [/p][p]Before we dive any further, here’s a look at the overall [b]Series Rewards[/b]: [/p][list][*][p][b]80 PTS[/b]: 2013 Wuling Sunshine S [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]160 PTS[/b]: 1962 Peel P50 [/p][/*][/list][p]Our [b]Monthly Rivals [/b]features the [b]2013 Dodge Viper SRT GTS Anniversary Edition [/b]on the Lookout Circuit. Meanwhile in [b]Forza EV[/b], test drive the [b]2018 Jaguar I-Pace [/b]on the Arch of Mulegé and set your fastest lap time! [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/20b49e85b6fdb6700654adc69af107c721760613.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Are you ready to party like it’s 2012? The first week of this Playlist, available through Thursday, October 20, features two unmissable reward cars – including the one driven by Darius Flynt, Forza Horizon’s notorious antagonist: [/p][list][*][p][b]20 PTS[/b]: 1968 Plymouth Barracuda Formula-S [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]40 PTS[/b]: Backstage Pass [/p][/*][/list][p]Each week, a new Festival site will be temporarily setup in Mexico in celebration of the past games. Week 1 celebrates Forza Horizon’s Colorado in the [b]Copper Canyon[/b] – smash [b]10 Horizon Colorado Bonus Boards[/b] while there to unlock the [b]2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS[/b]. Capture it to complete this week’s [b]Photo Challenge[/b] rewarding the [b]Colorado Cover Car[/b] horn. Don’t step out just yet because you’ll also need Forza Horizon’s cover car in the [b]Weekly Forzathon[/b]. [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1903c3cf64c2f1ade55f291973169c62f32af3d2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]It’s a Stock Showdown in [b]The Trial[/b]. Prove your mastery of the [b]2013 Ford Shelby GT500[/b] to win the [b]2012 Hennessey Venom GT[/b]. [/p][p]Two new unmissable [b]EventLab[/b] creations await! Take on [b]The Backroads[/b] from Veixity, a Street Race through a shipping port depot filled with trash, industrial work, a gas station, and narrow straights to win the [b]Take Off[/b] emote. Meanwhile, GT Deny presents [b]Coastal Town Circuit Pro[/b]. Race around two color-filled laps featuring coastal hotels and bars. Utilize those straights to their fullest potential and make your move to unlock the [b]Star 27 Sundress[/b]. [/p][p]A trio of [b]Super Wheelspins[/b] await in this week’s [b]Seasonal[/b] [b]PR Stunts[/b]! Prove your love of Forza Horizon’s [b]Speed Traps[/b] by setting new records at [b]Horizon Baja[/b], [b]East Resort[/b] and [b]Pantano Pass[/b]. Head over to [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] and break the [b]Forest Edge[/b] record for another [b]Super Wheelspin[/b].  [/p][p]Emerge first place in this week’s [b]Seasonal Championships[/b] to expand your driving adventures with the [b]1995 Volkswagen Corrado VR6[/b], the [b]2013 Ford Shelby GT500[/b] and the first of our weekly music rewards for [b]Horizon Mixtape[/b], “[b]Language[/b]” by Porter Robinson – the start screen song as seen in Forza Horizon. Take on the Dragons at [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] and the [b]2012 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon[/b] will be yours. [/p][p]Lastly, over in the [b]Forzathon Shop [/b]you will find the [b]1965 Shelby Cobra 427 S/C [/b]and [b]2019 Hennessey VelociRaptor 6x6[/b], as well as the [b]Quick Draw [/b]emote, the [b]Horizon Colorado Tee [/b]and the [b]Legacy Rewind [/b]car horn. You have one week to get them, so don’t miss out! [/p][p]That’s your roundup of all things happening at Horizon Mexico during this one-week celebration of Forza Horizon’s Colorado. Next week, it’s all about Southern Europe and Forza Horizon 2. Until then, we’ll see you at the festival. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4df9d1892375182cdb8c816df19482a4ec247f5a.png"][/img][/p]

If you have had one cup too many and can’t sleep, make a visit to the Shop and watch as the drones make different forms in the sky.  [/p][p]These and many more [i]rewards will be available until June 26[/i]. Don’t miss out! [/p][p][/p][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/67004e7b43b7e492c3ce2cb3bac5756e0a2aead7.png[/img]

notes.title: Off-Road Giants and Compact Racers Pair Up in the Horizon Backstage!
notes.content:
[p]Two pairs of super powered pickup trucks and nimble hatchbacks are racing for your vote this week in the Horizon Backstage Vote.

notes.title: Hit the Lights and the Gas Pedal with the Return of Midnights at Horizon
notes.content:
Extended night cycles and neon light decorations return to the Horizon Festival. Race underneath the neon lights in four champions of the night with the four reward cars returning this series. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/dec0b4f0c23064eb1299da9d07a4355439c9e526.jpg[/img]
[h2]Evolving World [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1dab19cc0c37ac95f7058d9bc6c3028c1f825425.jpg[/img]
The neon lights return! All racing events will feature neon decorations for the next four weeks. To appreciate the lights further, we have also brought back the extended night cycles in all seasons of Midnights at Horizon. 

Aeródromo en la Selva glows once more! Visit this unique location covered in fan-favorite neon decorations for some late night drag racing and a drone show. 

Find and smash 10 Neon Light Cube collectibles to complete the Collectibles challenge during the Autumm Season.  

Four Neon Light Tanks are scattered through the Horizon Festival. Can you find and photograph them all? 

[h2]Festival Playlist [/h2]

Unlock four cars eager to take on a nocturnal street race as this month’s seasonal rewards on the Festival Playlist! Also available to unlock for the next four weeks are Car Horns, Rally Adventure-themed clothing items, and a lot more. 

[b]2021 Lexus LC 500 [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/201ac944de8493eb61304a2fc5027d2fe56cb3bc.jpg[/img]
The Lexus LC has been in production since 2017 and has iteratively evolved with each model since then. The 2021 spec trims down on the weight and improves the suspension system to ensure the car feels more connected to the road, offering a more robust and stable driving experience while retaining the luxurious looks and feel that Lexus is known for. In fact, the “LC” stands for “Luxury Coupe,” and the line itself replaced the SC, which was formerly Lexus’ luxury car of choice from 1991 until 2010. Also new for 2021 is cornering assist with braking control, so you can maximize its 5.0-liter, naturally aspirated V8 with confidence. Producing 471-horsepower and 398 lb-ft. of torque at its peak, the LC achieves 0-60mph in only 4.4 seconds and remains a testament to Lexus’ focus of elegance in driving. 

[b]2022 Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/76070678721c1d78733ae0dcaa3819a8ebdc9020.jpg[/img]
As the larger, more extreme and even faster sibling of the Blackwing duo, the Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing is the V8-powered sports sedan that automotive dreams are made of. Its high-performance numbers are simply astounding with 668-horsepower and 659 lb-ft of torque. That means it’s fast, very fast actually. For top speed, the CT5-V Blackwing breaks the 200mph barrier, while Car and Driver testing has penned in the 0-60mph statistic at 3.6 seconds, with the 100mph target coming in at 7.7 seconds. That’s almost two seconds faster than the CT4-V Blackwing! It’s also sporting the same racing-inspired trimming as its smaller counterpart to deliver incredible downforce and ensure a smooth and nimble drive. Simply put, there’s no lifting this one off the asphalt, until it takes on the more elevated terrain of Forza Horizon 5’s landscapes of course. 

[b]2021 Audi RS 6 Avant [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f826fed65956feebedb0197d1ed5a1011734c4e8.jpg[/img]
Combine a 4-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine with the chassis of a station wagon and you get the car that Audi enthusiasts have always desired. Indeed, the 2021 Audi RS 6 Avant is dream come true for fans of the German automaker, and it's backed by high-speed performance numbers that are staggering for a vehicle of its class. Its high-end Tiptronic transmission delivers the engine’s 591 horses to the signature Quattro all-wheel drive system to achieve a top speed of 189mph and it reaches 0-60mph in just 3.5 seconds. With notably aggressive yet nuanced RS-specific styling including a wide body design and flared wheel arches, a classy modern interior, and a large capacity trunk to secure all your road-trip essentials, the RS 6 Avant has it all, and is undoubtedly a road champion in true practicality. 

[b]2022 Cadillac CT4-V Blackwing [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e31c1ad2c205beb329d92768e1e65826fc7e0fc3.jpg[/img]
The successor to the beloved Cadillac ATS-V is here. With a rear-wheel drive platform and a 3.6-liter twin turbocharged V6 engine under the hood, the Cadillac CT4-V Blackwing is the next must have addition to your Forza Horizon 5 garage. Or perhaps that title belongs to the more formidable CT5-V Blackwing, which is also coming to the game. Both are excellent choices for cruising and racing around Mexico’s asphalt roads, and with a low-level spoiler and launch control on each, they’re also the perfect choice for drag racing. Power wise, the CT4-V Blackwing delivers 472-horsepower with 445 lb-ft of torque, which means, according to Car and Driver testing, it can go from standstill to 60mph in 4 seconds, and to 100mph in 9.4 seconds. Cadillac estimates a top speed of 189mph. It’s a mean machine in a smaller package to the CT5-V Blackwing, which makes it ideal for just about everything. 

 

[b]Backstage Vote [/b]

Each week of the Backstage Vote two pairs of cars racing head-to-head for your vote. Pick your favorite team and the winner will be available for purchase at the Horizon Backstage Shop!  

Here’s every matchup coming this series: 

Week 1 (22/05 - 29/05): 1969 Fiat Dino Coupe + 1962 Peel P50 VS 1976 Volkswagen Sp-2 + 1975 DS Automobiles DS 23 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fd845cfc65510952c0eed07578588f524bfd2c41.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2d51d031b7f0e19fcdde730c86cefb9bb40c7450.jpg[/img]
Week 3 (05/06 - 12/06): 2022 Hyundai Kona N + 2021 Volkswagen ID.4 VS 2022 Ford Focus ST + 2022 BMW iX xDrive50

Week 4 (12/06 - 19/06): 2007 Toyota Hilux Arctic Trucks AT3 + 2016 Renault Clio R.S. 16 Concept VS 2019 Ford Ranger Raptor + 2023 Ford Fiesta ST 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ec04d9c1224afa52ea1e30cba6b1d034a7cb2669.jpg[/img]
Don’t miss out and make sure to vote for your favorite teams!

notes.title: Lamborghini and Forza celebrate and unveil a symbol for players driving together
notes.content:
Fans of Forza Horizon 5 have been enjoying new cross-platform play since April 25, allowing more players across different consoles and PC to drive together, all for the first time. 

To mark the occasion, we’re uniting the freedom to explore in Forza Horizon 5 in the seat of a [b]Lamborghini Revuelto[/b] with an exciting new Livery.  

[previewyoutube=-nj5Ekqfdss;full][/previewyoutube]
The Lamborghini Revuelto reward car can be earned through playing the new free update, Horizon Realms, and you can unlock the exclusive livery in-game via Share Code, also for free. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c4971395b0622590997cb83ff32ef0580395c372.png[/img]
The roads of Forza Horizon have always been breathtaking. Now, they’re boundless. From April 25, Forza Horizon 5 opened up like never before, inviting players from more platforms to drive together on the same open road. Lamborghini and Forza have joined forces to create a powerful symbol of unity: a first-of-its-kind livery, designed for a vibrant driving community, that is only getting bigger. 

 
[h2]A Symbol of Unity [/h2]
Introducing the [b]Lamborghini Revuelto Forza Horizon 5 Special Livery[/b], a one-of-a-kind masterpiece that doesn’t just celebrate speed and design, and unity. More than a car, it’s a call to race side by side. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a83d2955ab964f11c9800492336754b5d35f7670.png[/img]
Designed together with Lamborghini, the livery features a striking green-to-blue gradient, reflecting in Forza Horizon 5, where we can all finally drive as one. notes.title: V12 Engine and Pininfarina Body, Unlock the 575M Maranello!
notes.content:
The [b]2002 Ferrari 575M Maranello[/b] came as an upgraded version of the 550 Maranello. Featuring improvements such as a 5.7-liter V12 engine that could produce 508 bhp, bigger brake discs, and an improved weight distribution. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ab05e4fc9de4c4548e312cc3956a5757b459bd4b.jpg[/img]
By far one of the biggest technological improvements added to the car was its gearbox. It was mounted in the back of the car to provide smoother and faster gear changes (specially when the car was in Sports Mode). The gearbox also had control over each of the four individual suspensions. This was also the first time an F1-style gearbox was fitted on a V12 road Ferrari. 

The bigger engine required minor modifications in the body, which you can clearly spot on the hood which sports a new intake and in the front spoiler as well. Small changes to the car’s finish were also made to improve aerodynamics.

notes.title: Exploring Forza Horizon 5’s Biomes and Seasons
notes.content:
While there’s no denying that flashy supercars and built-for-fun off-road vehicles are the stars of the show in the Forza Horizon series, it’s the widely varied, based-on-real-life environments that really make the games shine. Whether it’s kicking up dust while blasting across the Australian Outback in Forza Horizon 3 or leaving a swirling trail of leaves through the English countryside on a crisp autumn day in Forza Horizon 4, we’ve all got great memories of exploring the vibrant worlds created by the developers at Playground Games. With Forza Horizon 5, the team has their sights set on the most diverse locale yet: Mexico.

[hr][/hr]
But what about the biomes themselves? Spread out over a map that’s about one-and-a-half times the size of Forza Horizon 4’s, the 11 biomes represent the most diverse map a Forza Horizon game has ever delivered. Let’s take a closer look:

[h2]Canyon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/617367300dd0e478a4bf975d3ca4e14954fc1817.jpg[/img]
You might recognize this as the biome that was shown in the Forza Horizon 5 reveal trailer in June. It’s filled with rock formations patterned with unique striations, many of which erode into hoodoos that are only found in the canyon. Fun fact: each of the biomes have unique audio and the canyon has more echoes than any of the others.

[h2]Tropical Coast[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7259e3c786a9298562eb39982e407fea66f4c5e0.jpg[/img]
This might be what you think of when you imagine a tropical Mexican vacation. Filled with palm trees, seagulls, white sand beaches and calm waters, it feels a lot like a postcard come to life. At least that’s the case until you reach storm season, which completely changes how you need to navigate it. Watch out for flying palm trees!

[h2]Farmland[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/942c68f14062e4ac33aab0a67f2e9aee206db75d.jpg[/img]
Unlike the flatter or drier farmland found in some of the previous Forza Horizon games, these rolling hills are filled with lush vegetation, fruit-bearing trees, and wide, shallow rivers. You’ll have plenty of fences to smash through and picturesque homesteads to explore while you’re cruising through here.

[h2]Arid Hills[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a8214010288c8493927abcac664a138033fd1e90.jpg[/img]
As you might suspect given the name, this biome is full of dry grasses on rolling hills and plains, providing plenty of open spaces to drive across if you feel like off-roading. One of the coolest features in this biome is a lake that actually dries up in the winter season, opening up shortcuts via fast passages and secret areas.

[h2]Jungle[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7c570ffd9fb7f10a1ed18246bbe8e7cffb5fe6db.jpg[/img]
Filled with lush, dense vegetation and towering trees that let beautiful rays of sun through the canopy, this biome also sports some impressive waterfalls and winding rivers. There are also a number of hidden temples in this area, all of which are based on real locations in Mexico.

[h2]Living Desert[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c73ef91ed22f54da1f8d88bb9464a8f9da48eb26.jpg[/img]
In a first for the Forza Horizon series, Forza Horizon 5 features a cactus desert that’s full of towering saguaros. There are also a number of rock formations and rock piles that are unique to the area. As the name implies, it’s full of life and features plenty of flowers and wildlife.

[h2]Rocky Coast[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/78e3cc7074c1e907f5a8f50e02e342b9afefc60d.jpg[/img]
While the tropical coast features lots of trees and vegetation, this one has a completely different vibe. Since there aren’t many trees, you’ll get a full view of the ocean and some excellent views of the sun setting at the end of the day. As a bonus to all you golfers out there, you can even take a spin around (read: through) a golf course.

[h2]Sand Desert[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ffc655ca91f1ee3a252454a96ff87947dad1feb6.jpg[/img]
Full of towering sand dunes, this biome is perfect for cruising around in a buggy and carving into the sand. If you don’t feel like getting sand between your toes, many of the roads in this area feature long straightaways so there are plenty of opportunities to see how fast your favorite ride really goes.

[h2]Swamp[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ae3073ed6d2ca9273383633aeb02dd1006f5438d.jpg[/img]
Although a swamp might not sound like the best place for a race, this biome’s shallow waters are a great place for it. The swamp also features a lot of mangrove trees that sport very thick, interconnected roots. You can actually smash through these during races, changing the route depending on whether or not your car can handle it.

[h2]Urban City of Guanajuato[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b7d89da489a2b672276b5c1ba924afc666595a27.jpg[/img]
Like a number of cities in Mexico, there’s a good deal of amazing architecture and vibrant colors everywhere you look. Unlike a lot of cities, however, it features a lot of rolling hills and tunnels, making for some really fun race routes. As with the Canyon, you’ll hear plenty of echoes bouncing around the city’s tight roadways.

[h2]Volcano[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/04c0aa498844a8b3a7b7efca4b3eed8da47799fb.jpg[/img]
In another first for the Forza Horizon series, this massive mountain is situated right next to the Living Desert. It’s a very high-altitude volcano, so driving to the top is a unique experience that rewards players by seeing way off into the horizon. This is also the only place in the game that you’ll encounter snow, so be sure to pack an extra jacket.

notes.title: Drive and Collect 4 Nissan Classics in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
Rediscover Nissan’s vibrant legacy with the four cars from across the Japanese brand’s automotive history coming to Forza Horizon 5 with our latest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339980/Forza_Horizon_5_Nissan_Retro_Rides_Car_Pack/]Car Pack: the Nissan Retro Rides Car Pack[/url] – now available on all platforms for [b]$4.99/€4.99€/£3.99/AU$7.95/¥680[/b].

[h1]1987 Nissan BE1[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c6de349d703016db8563bae20a242fb2a7c19dec.png[/img]

Here’s the car that started Nissan’s Pike Car line. A car that you could get and feel all warm and cozy: the [b]1987 Nissan BE1[/b].

Ever think about the good ol’ days? Designer Naoki Sakai did so too, so it turned in a retro design meant to compete with other car brands that were taking over the Japanese market.

Meant to be used as an everyday car, Nissan used different materials to make the body of this car, including thermoplastic resin (that could resist small rock impacts), durasteel (mainly in the front), and ABS resin.

Buyers of this car were picked by lottery, because, of course, who wouldn’t want to drive home in a car with that much face card?

[hr][/hr]
[h1]1989 Nissan S-Cargo[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e6519855073c3f029974beab0f0a33afa4da64d7.png[/img]

Available for purchase only by reservation, the [b]1989 Nissan S-Cargo[/b] is the Pike car meant for commercial use.

That hump on the back is indeed a loading area, like what you would find on a van. Thus, resulting in a car that looked like a snail, explaining why Nissan chose a name that sounded like escargot.

Only 8,000 units of this car were sold, making it a very rare JDM jewel and now you can get your hands on one of them with the Nissan Retro Rides Car Pack!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]1989 Nissan Pao[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9ef0edbdd29cc08e1c468c96c7453e14ee021ef2.png[/img]

Travel back to the late 80s and witness how fast orders for the [b]1989 Nissan Pao[/b] were made; they sold out in just three months with 51,667 applications for the unit.

Taking a closer look at this car will reveal inspiration taken from other car makers of the time, all put together into one practical package built to be as appealing as Japanese personal electronic devices.

Everything about this car evokes inexplicable appeal: the way the windows open, the optional sunroof, and the four delightful colors it came in are all part of what makes this tribute to retro cars a wonderful JDM to add to your collection!

[hr][/hr]
[h1]1991 Nissan Figaro[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/712b3b2bd9609083955ce8c912077bef4c4ff55c.png[/img]

Sold only in Nissan Cherry Stores back in the days of girl groups and grunge, the [b]1991 Nissan Figaro[/b] is a tiny, retro, convertible car built with a dash of luxury and extravagance.

The highlight of this car’s retro design is found inside. The console and dials are built in a beautiful white color with some chrome details found in frames and the steering wheel. The elegant lever at the center console could put some modern luxury cars to shame.

It may have been built to appeal to retro car fans; however, the Figaro came equipped with the latest technology for the time, such as air conditioning and a CD player.

Available in colors that represent the four seasons, the Figaro is a ride to enjoy all year long.

Complete your collection and customize your favorite Nissan Pike Cars with this[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339980/Forza_Horizon_5_Nissan_Retro_Rides_Car_Pack/] unique Car Pack available for purchase on its own[/url] or as a part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48752/Forza_Horizon_5_Ultimate_Car_Pack_Collection/]Ultimate Car Pack Collection Bundle![/url]

[i]The Nissan Retro Rides Car Pack is not included in Forza Horizon 5 Premium Edition.[/i]

[h1]Horizon Realms Reward Cars [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/251e428f55d0b89e55306eb06b04d7f503e9b481.png[/img]
Unlock these four new reward cars by earning Accolades on each of the 12 Realms available in this new update. This collection of rewards comes with amazing power and perhaps more wheels than you expected. 

[h2]2024 Lamborghini Revuelto [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/598867d138be0eb5b5bafd43f176ce4790fd3c33.png[/img]
The raging bull goes hybrid with the latest addition to its exotic hyper car collection: the 2024 Lamborghini Revuelto.  

The total power output of this car is the largest of any Lambo ever: 1001 bhp. 814 horsepower comes from the V12 engine set in the middle of the car, and the rest comes from three electric motors (two mounted on the front axles and one in the gearbox).  

Rear-wheel steering and improved stability make the Revuelto handle corners like a breeze.  

Plug into the madness of Lamborghini’s ultimate hybrid drive with the Lamborghini Revuelto. 

[h2]2023 Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/854388421a86a94f487b3d9c0e3dbfbe7af5eadc.png[/img]
Lamborghini takes to the dirt with the 2023 Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato! The Italian brand’s icon of the roads gets off-roading modifications to take the dirt roads by storm. 

The Huracán Sterrato marks a very important moment in time for Lamborghini. It is the last “special edition” of the Huracán; it is the last Lambo to use the iconic V10 engine; and it is the first time Lamborghini put a Rally button on a coupé. 

The first noticeable changes come with adding a new air intake on the roof of the car and removing the side intakes to prevent the car from breathing too much dirt. Next comes a modified version of the classic V10 engine that puts out 601 horsepower! 

Flip the off-road switch in the raging bull, available in Horizon Realms! 

[h2]2018 Lotus Exige Cup 430 [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c14f9f703b73a819e7b704de54c6673fa998703b.png[/img]
The ultimate Lotus experience has arrived at the Horizon Festival with the 2018 Lotus Exige Cup 430, an even stronger and loonier version of the Exige. 

Hidden in plain sight within the car’s name is its first impressive stat: the horsepower. The Exige Cup 430 produces 430 horsepower dispatched by a 3.5-litre V6 engine. While that number might not sound crazy, when it’s paired up with the car’s extreme lightweight and improved downforce, the 430 reaches 100 kph in about 3.3 seconds.  

Designed to fulfill your deepest track fantasies, the Exige Cup 430’s gorgeous design and crazy speed will not disappoint racing fans eager to dominate the courses of the Horizon Festival. 

[h2]2022 Hennessey Mammoth 6x6[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c91cc5a457af9b3a2a80c25fcfbbe1c2846ed1ae.png[/img]
Trumpeting its way towards the Horizon Festival comes a speed behemoth with a prehistoric attitude. The 2022 Hennessey Mammoth 6x6 is the bulkier and meaner version of the RAM TRX built by Hennessey’s mad scientists. 

In case it wasn’t obvious enough, the Mammoth was built to dominate any terrain conceivable by its driver. The Hennessey team fitted a 6X6 rear axle locking differential, upgraded suspension, and 20-inch wheels.  

True to fashion, the Mammoth can also storm a track and score more than impressive times with its 1000 horsepower and 969 lb-ft torque thanks to several improvements made on its engine, including a 2.5-liter supercharger. 

Become the king of the Ice Age with the Hennessey Mammoth 6x6! 

[h1]See You at Horizon Mexico[/h1] 

Join our [url=http://discord.gg/forza]official Discord server[/url] and stay in touch with our community. You’ll be able to interact with more players, find builds and liveries to download, EventLab creations to try, photos taken by our community, and more.  

Subscribe to our [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]newsletter[/url] and stay in the know of all things Forza Horizon 5. 

Races, challenges, customization, and more are waiting at the Horizon Festival! We hope you enjoy your Forza Horizon 5 adventure.

notes.title: Hyper Hybrids Meet Hot Hatches in this Week’s Feud!
notes.content:
Sparks are flying in this week’s Backstage battle as two hybrid hypercars team up with hot hatches to take the win!

First, a glimpse into the future of Porsche GT4 race cars, the 2021 Porsche Mission R. This electrifying racer teams up with a modern classic hatchback: the 2016 Abarth 695 Biposto! Not only is the Biposto quite a looker, but it is also the fastest road legal Abarth ever made!

notes.title: Unlock an Italian Rally Legend!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2f111272db6459854ba06c0fb55d4c25e5a53f57.jpg[/img]
The final week of the Horizon Wilds Takeover features a legendary rally car to add to your garage: the [b]1986 Lancia Delta S4[/b]. It might resemble a regular, road Delta, but on the inside this car’s rally legacy really shows.  

Built for all-purpose racing, this car featured all-wheel drive to handle loose terrains like sand and dirt. It also featured both a super and a turbo charger in its four-cylinder engine as a way to avoid turbolag. 

Unlock this Group B legend with 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f31d69b3b4fbeafb2b3e1e3b1456e481df635786.png[/img]
This week is also your final opportunity to unlock the[b] 2021 SIERRA Cars 700R.[/b] It’s your overall series reward for 160 PTS and is built to take on the most extreme, challenging dirt courses. The 700R builds upon the RX3 with improved handling and stability in a faster, more lightweight and affordable package. It’s the perfect choice for racing on the Horizon Baja circuit in the desert, where its quick pace and agility are certain to leave your rivals behind in trails of dust!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/540062f2f0d24d03ebeda2ebc5fa06a58d6b9df6.jpg[/img]

The fourth and final week of High Performance is here! This is the week you can unlock the incredible 2021 Porsche Mission R. This car makes a clear statement, bringing together everything that the Porsche lineage has always set out to achieve and doing it with astounding performance numbers.  

While the car is proof of concept and won’t enter production, the vision behind the all-wheel drive, lightweight and fully electric car has been to show how race cars could evolve over the next five to six years. Indeed, the Porsche Mission R, which is perfect for high-intensity sprint racing, is pioneering the future of electrified Porsche GT4 race cars with over 800 kW (1,000 horsepower), 0-62mph in less than 2.5 seconds, an overall top speed of 186mph, and super-fast charging to 80% in just 15 minutes.

Welcome maximum power to your garage with the 2011 Koenigsegg Agera, a speed monster capable of producing astounding amounts of power. 

The Agera’s mighty 5.0-liter, twin turbo V8 engine can produce 960 bhp and take this car from 0 – 100 kmh in just 3 seconds. [list]
[*] Forza Horizon 5’s cover car: the 2021 Mercedes AMG-One 
[*] 5,000 #Forzathon Points which can be used to buy cars and cosmetics 
[*] 5 Backstage Passes which can be used to unlock any hard-to-find car available in the Backstage Shop 
[/list]
If you’re already playing Forza Horizon 5, be sure to share the news with your PS5 friends and invite them to join us at the Horizon Festival as cross-play will be available between all platforms! 

[h2]PlayStation 5 Graphics Modes [/h2]

Forza Horizon 5 on PS5 features two rendering modes to choose from: Performance (60fps) and Quality (30fps).  

On PS5 Pro, the Performance mode receives increased visual fidelity, while Quality mode adds ray traced car reflections to Races and Free Roam. 

We hope you are looking forward to exploring Forza Horizon 5’s vast open world and features with Horizon Realms across all platforms the game is available on. Remember that you can pre-order any version of Forza Horizon 5 starting today on the PlayStation Store to receive a special bundle; pre-purchasing Premium Edition will grant you Early Access on April 25.  

We’ll see you at the Horizon Festival soon!

notes.title: Dive into the Horizon Realms on April 25!
notes.content:
Forza Horizon 5 is getting one of its biggest updates!  

This April, the Horizon Festival evolves with Horizon Realms. 

[previewyoutube=3uloIoUR9xc;full][/previewyoutube]

This brand-new feature will let players dig into Forza Horizon 5’s history of Evolving World updates. Explore 12 fantastic Evolving World locations: 11 of the best previously limited-time locations and the premiering Stadium Track.  

Collect new Horizon Realms-exclusive accolades to unlock four new-to-Horizon reward cars.  

Revisit your favorite environments, or discover them for the first time, in Horizon Realms available for every platform on April 25! 

[h2]A Selection of the Best Evolving Worlds  [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/357d150f95ec02b08c8b03ec856397d2c5f16491.png[/img]

Horizon Realms gives players the chance to explore a hand-picked collection of some of the community’s favorite previously released Evolving World updates.  

Get ready to (re-)discover and adventure though these beloved locations while behind the wheel of your favorite cars:  
[list]
[*] Stunt Park  
[*] Ice Rink  
[*] Oval Track  
[*] Summer Party  
[*] Neon Airstrip 
[*] Día de Muertos  
[*] Winter Wonderland  
[*] Lunar Drift Arena  
[*] Retrowave Highway  
[*] Cars and Coffee  
[*] Stadium Maze  
[/list]
Along with these 11 returning environments, there will be a brand-new one: The Stadium Track! 
You can also race around this Evolving World with the new permanent race route coming to the game, the Horizon Stadium Circuit. You can find details further into this post. 

[h2]New Dedicated Accolade Tab[/h2]
A new Accolade Tab exclusive to Horizon Realms will be added to the game featuring 60+ accolades. While most of them are new to this update, you will also be able to unlock previously released accolades tied to the returning Evolving Worlds that are now accessible with Horizon Realms.   

Each of the Evolving World locations featured in Horizon Realms includes 5 new accolades to unlock! Find them under the Horizon Realms Accolades tab.  
You can also find an Accolade for the Horizon Stadium Circuit under the Road Racing tab. 

Complete Horizon Realms Accolades to acquire 12 new badges coming to the game. Plus, for the first time ever, unlocking an accolade will reward the player with #Forzathon Points! Go for a 100% in every Realm and unlock rewards with your newly acquired Points. 

[h2]Obtain 4 New Reward Cars [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a8d8c9c8e6ad30f1a1eb554a2d87f11e0ca526c2.png[/img]

Earning accolades will also score new cars for your garage. Complete unique challenges featured on every Realm to unlock four new-to-Horizon reward cars:
[list]
[*] Lamborghini’s take on a hyper hybrid, the 2024 Lamborghini Revuelto 
[*] Stomp the off-road scene with the 2023 Lamborghini Huracán Sterrato 
[*] The mightiest version of the Exige, the 2018 Lotus Exige Cup 430 
[*] Ride the king of the Ice Age with the 2022 Hennessey Mammoth 6x6  
[/list]
[h2]Two Ways to Dive into Horizon Realms  [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ca5cea549c0aa0e396dd269b1677323a4ac33f91.png[/img]
There will be two different ways to experience Horizon Realms:  

[h3]Skill Mode  [/h3]
hoose one of the Horizon Realms to enter and try to bank as much Skill Score as possible. Each Evolving World has its own separate Skill Score leaderboard, and there will also be a total Skill Score Leaderboard tallying up all points banked on each Realm – so try to take the top spot in all of them!  

Earning enough Skill Score will also unlock new player Badges unique to Horizon Realms!  
[h3]Free Mode  [/h3]
This mode puts the leaderboards to the side and focuses on players having a good time in their favorite Realms.  

Enter on your own or with your friends in a Convoy to explore your favorite Realms, obtain Badges tied to previous content updates, unlock accolades to earn #Forzathon Points, and more!  
[h2]Start Your Engines at the New Stadium Track[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1454c12ad40aa25489223bc1af16b38477f9cedf.png[/img]

Line up at the starting line of a brand-new race route: the Horizon Stadium Circuit! Featuring corners, bends, and racing decorations, this new track will become a permanent race route in the game – complete with its own event icon on the map and Rivals leaderboard!  

Score your best time on this new race route in Rivals and Horizon Open, and explore the Stadium Track Realm in Horizon Realms' Free Mode and Skill Mode. 
[h2]Explore Nissan’s Heritage with a New Car Pack [/h2]
Four new cars from throughout Nissan’s automotive history will become available for purchase as Forza Horizon 5 releases for PlayStation 5 with the Nissan Retro Rides Car Pack. 

This new DLC pack includes the 1989 Nissan Pao, 1991 Nissan Figaro, 1989 Nissan Scargo, and the 1987 Nissan Be-1. 

Add these cars to your collection and customize them how you want! 

The Nissan Retro Rides Car Pack will be available starting April 25 for $4.99/€4.99/£3.99.  [b]Players who bought the Ultimate Car Pack Collection will receive this Car Pack at no additional cost. [/b]

notes.title: Forza Horizon 5 Comes to PlayStation 5 in Spring 2025
notes.content:
[h1]The Horizon Festival Welcomes a New Community of Players. [/h1]

With nearly 900 cars available in the game, over 40 thematic game updates, two expansions, and so much more content, our team is excited to announce that this spring, PlayStation 5 players will be able to explore Mexico’s beautiful roads and experience the Horizon Festival for the first time as we are officially launching Forza Horizon 5 on PS5.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2335f497b8bbf8c419e16322454719779283906c.png[/img]

The PlayStation 5 version of Forza Horizon 5, developed by Panic Button in partnership with Turn 10 Studios and Playground Games, will have the same content as the Xbox and PC releases of the game. Previously released Car Packs, as well as the Hot Wheels and Rally Adventure expansions, will also be available for purchase. 

We are excited to see the Forza Horizon 5 community grow with new players on PS5, and we can’t wait to see the creativity and skill these new creators, builders, and racers will bring to our vibrant community. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5ef8d83fe04d12c46c61e0eb970c38775b3c9d04.jpg[/img]

In addition to bringing Forza Horizon 5 to PS5, we’re working on a special new free content update for all platforms, Horizon Realms. Realms will give players the chance to explore a curated collection of some of the community’s favorite previously released Evolving Worlds, alongside some other surprises. Stay tuned to [url=https://linktr.ee/forzahorizonofficial]our channels[/url] for more details soon.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7fb4cd9187d23b834b080bcfe7cc2528a9181e90.png[/img]

Wishlist Forza Horizon 5 on the PlayStation Store today to stay informed about updates and release times. If you already own the game on another platform, share the news with your friends in the PS5 community and tell them to get ready to join your convoys as cross-play will be available for all Forza Horizon 5 players across Xbox consoles, PC and PS5.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/09b97b7bce51c3554fce45197fca23133b6ddbdf.png[/img]

We look forward to welcoming new players to the Horizon Festival, and we are sure Forza Horizon 5 veterans will share their experience, tips, and tricks to make beginners feel right at home as they start their adventures. 

Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/forza]official Forza Discord server[/url] to connect with other players, follow our [url=https://www.instagram.com/forzahorizonofficial/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/ForzaHorizon]X (formerly Twitter) accounts[/url] to stay in the loop, and [url=https://forza.net/newsletter]sign up for our newsletter[/url] to get more details about Forza Horizon 5’s release on PlayStation 5 and all things Forza. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2520b2047acf87cea61050ef3d664704f23c1771.png[/img]

Whether you are adventuring through Forza Horizon 5’s Mexico on Xbox, PC or PS5, we look forward to racing alongside you all at the Horizon Festival this spring.

notes.title: Celebrating Excellence in EventLab: 2024 Golden Tank Award Winners
notes.content:
Welcome to the third annual Golden Tank Awards—a celebration of the finest EventLab creations, published by players like you! Five winners in five different categories will take home the prestigious Golden Tank Award in recognition of their amazing contributions to the game.  

Every year our community surprises us with creations we could never have imagined seeing in Forza Horizon 5. We are always thrilled to see how creators use the props, tools, and environments we provide to create something amazing.
