notes.title: Coming to your Garage this Month
notes.content:
[h2]Festival Playlist[/h2]

Hidden Horizons’s rewards feature an all-round collection of cars to take on any terrain.

Try two track superstars or two rally legends, all unlockable in each of the next four weeks and solve 
the mystery of which one is the fastest around our roads.

[b]1995 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution III GSR[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c0be3ef2e38638baf982c2021a47e015b11ccb50.png[/img]

The first Reward Car available to unlock this series is a highly regarded rally legend. Solve off-roading mysteries with the 1995 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution III GSR.

Equipped with an all-wheel drive system and built to be lightweight, this car handles like a dream on road and off it as well. Furthermore, the reduced weight helped the car make the most out of its 2.0 turbocharged engine, allowing it to reach 100 kph  in 5.1 seconds. 

The Evo III is a car that’s used to podiums having earned two second place finished in the Constructors Championship in 1995 and 1996 as well as a first-place finish in the WRC Driver’s Championship at the hands of Tommi Mäkinen.

Do not break its tradition, and keep earning wins in the Evo III at the Horizon Festival!

[b]2022 Subaru WRX[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7aa87a9a25f70eb31a460cadb9e12971b0a615fa.jpg[/img]

Sporting the new Subaru 2.4-liter engine is the 2022 Subaru WRX, the latest entry in the Japanese brand’s rally- inspired sports sedan car series.

This redesigned version of the WRX produces 271 bhp and can go from 0 – 100 kph in about 5.7 seconds . As is tradition with this line of cars, the 2022 version of the WRX comes with all-wheel drive to accelerate as fast as possible and use every one of the 258 lb-ft of torque it makes.

Equip this car with the finest off-roading customizations and create your own rally champion.

[b]1991 Toyota Chaser GT Twin Turbo[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3809b9318103dcc26fc72fe644fbe9563fb2196c.png[/img]

The reward for the Winter Season of Hidden Horizons is one of the smoothest JDMs ever made. Make room in your garage for the 1991 Toyota Chaser GT Twin Turbo.

This version of the Chaser sports a 2.5-liter 6-cylinder engine that is, of course, turbocharged. The 1JZ-GTE engine can  produce 276 bhp and 268 lb-ft of torque .

This car’s other highlights include its amazing drive, courtesy of a phenomenal suspension that includes a limited-slip differential on the rear, and its front-engine/rear drive build that provides a ton of balance.
Have a go at creating your perfect street racer with the GT Twin Turbo! 

[b]2013 Volvo C30 Polestar[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/26efb005f838851976e2ec20bf35fb1a84a8edd0.png[/img]

One of Volvo’s most exclusive builds arrives at the Horizon Festival this series. An front-wheel drive, 250 horsepowered, ready-to-race version of the C30: the 2013 Volvo C30 Polestar.

The source of all its power? Elementary, my dear reader!  It's a 2.5-liter five-cylinder engine tuned by Volvo’s long-time partner in making things fast, Polestar.

To make the look match the inside, this car was fitted with a new, more aerodynamic bodykit, and a striking blue color. Polestar also added new brakes and stiffer springs to upgrade the driving experience.

Only 250 units of this car saw the light of day in America;  get a hold of yours and discover the mystery of its performance!

[h2]What’s Next [h2]
Our next series will come with new badges, clothing items, collectibles, and cars!
Flash back  to another era in Back to The 90’s .

notes.title: Discover the Mysteries of Our Latest Update in Hidden Horizons!
notes.content:
[h3]The time has come to grab your magnifying glass and get the hunting hat off the rack to uncover the secrets of Hidden Horizons! Your detective and hiding skills will be put to the test with the new Hide & Seek multiplayer mode. From the courts to the roads of the Horizon Festival, our latest partnership with Jordan features a custom version of a muscle car classic. 

The Stadium transforms into a giant maze for the next four weeks! Complete it using the platforms we have added and find its hidden treasure. Track & Field meet as this series’ Reward Cars features limited builds and all-time rally favorites. Sleuth and speed around the Horizon Festival in our latest update, Hidden Horizons![/h3]

[h2]Release Notes and Game Fixes[/h2]

[b]Cars[/b]
[list][*]2018 Lamborghini Aventador SVJ’s exhaust pipes are now correctly painted
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2022 Cupra Formentor and the 2022 Cupra Tavascan where livery decals were applying to the steering wheel badge
[*]Fixed the 2020 Lamborghini SC20’s brake caliper location and the rev red line
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2021 BMW M3 with some inaccurate textures on the M Performance front, side, rear and wing carbon fiber upgrades[/list]
[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here.[/url] The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have.

 [h2]An A-maze-ing New Stadium to Solve![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/332abbde4b3c48094817483ebdcc3bf81c5569f9.png[/img]

Try to solve the maze that has taken over the Stadium during Hidden Horizons. This Evolving World Location comes with platforms that will help you find the exit to the Stadium and are also great photo opportunities to take solo pictures or group shots.

The Maze Stadium will also be featured in some Festival Playlist challenges, so be on the lookout for rewards to find inside this limited-time location!

[h2]Join a Thrilling Game of Chase with Hide & Seek[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Z32r8ECNNiA;full][/previewyoutube]
Forza Horizon 5 welcomes Hide & Seek, its newest multiplayer experience. 
In this brand-new game mode, a group of six players will take part in a game of chases taking on one of two roles. 

Hiders are tasked with remaining hidden from their opponents until the End Zone (the location the Hider needs to reach) is revealed. After the End Zone has been disclosed, the Hider will have to reach it before time runs out and before Seekers build enough points to take the win.

On the other hand, Seekers will be tasked with finding and staying close to the Hider. Doing so will earn them points to complete the Seeker’s Detection Meter. Seekers must complete their bar before time runs out and before the Hider reaches the End Zone to put the win under their belt. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0b1f847089ac090420cb9bb29d3fb34f9bf4eb52.png[/img]

Hide & Seek will have its own in-game progression system through which players will be able to earn badges and complete accolades unique to Hide & Seek.

[h2]FH5’s Latest Partnership is Nothing but Net (And a Custom Car)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1657f3fb9272895cdda3161a7fcd7c5ca4e611d9.jpg[/img]

Available through the Gifts Tab in your Message Center starting September 10, the 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3Motorsport Edition will let you dunk around the roads of the Horizon Festival in style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8446dd89587258060d95b9d719da5301bc88ea4a.png[/img]

notes.title: Forza Presents a New Game Mode for Forza Horizon 5 and Reveals New Partnership
notes.content:
We are thrilled to be on the floor at [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaAtGamescom]Gamescom 2024[/url] with a sneak peek of what we’ve got in store for Forza Horizon 5—and it’s all coming next month!

A brand-new multiplayer game mode inspired by our community and their creations comes into Forza Horizon 5 for you to enjoy with 5 friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b3dcecead90e378bc668bbb3d834ed96198277aa.jpg[/img]
From the hoops to Forza’s tracks and roads, our latest partnership brings a custom muscle classic and a new racing suit.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0f628edf736c6734f9b59c0d251411b15b3b3bc5.jpg[/img]
[h3]All Gas. And Brakes.[/h3]

The court and the road come together for the Jordan Luka 3 collab in Forza. 

[previewyoutube=dKK2vJNi0cc;full][/previewyoutube]

Check out the custom Luka 3 ‘Motorsport’ inspired 1969 Chevrolet Camaro coming to you this September on Forza Horizon 5. This exciting new collab car will be sent to players via the Gifts tab in the in-game Message Center this September.

[h3]Find the New Game Mode Coming to Forza Horizon 5![/h3]

The entire Forza Horizon 5 team is excited to announce the new game mode coming to the Horizon Festival: Hide & Seek.

[previewyoutube=Z32r8ECNNiA;full][/previewyoutube]

In this new game mode, one of two possible roles will be assigned to players at random: 

[b]Hiders.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/31b8da2c5e54538936805d4c8aa2c656a2592efe.jpg[/img]

The Hider will be tasked with getting to a location in a set amount of time without getting caught by the team of Seekers. 

Sneak past Seekers by blending into the traffic and hiding within the environment to reach your destination before the time runs out or Seekers gather enough points to win!

As a Hider, you will be able to drive the following cars: 
[list]
[*]2012 Jeep Wrangler 
[*]2017 Ford F-150 Raptor 
[*]2017 Chevrolet Colorado ZR2 
[*]2018 Mercedes X Class [/list]
[b]Seekers.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/051d83fea336395cf51e082cbda3f94cb91148ee.jpg[/img]

5 players will take on the role of Seekers whose main objective is to find and stay close to the Hider. By finding and staying close to their opponent, Seekers will start filling the Seeker’s Detection Meter. If your team completes it, you will win the round!  

Make the most out of the high-spec rental car that will be assigned to you to complete your mission.  
The vehicles available for Seekers are:  
[list][*]2016 BMW M4 GTS  
[*]2017 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1  
[*]2011 Mercedes SLS AMG  
[*]2015 Audi RS6  
[*]2008 Mitsubishi Lancer Evo X GSR  
[*]2021 Ford Bronco [/list]
All playable cars for both Hiders and Seekers will only be available on their stock version, so liveries, tunes, and builds will not be available to play.

[b]How to Play.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0df294697fba257c00ce722fbcdb639f68113433.jpg[/img]

The game is split into two phases, each with a 4-minute duration. 

In the first phase, the Hider will have to remain undercover while Seekers make their best effort to locate them before this phase ends and lock on their position to fill the Seeker’s Detection Meter and ensure the win.

During the second phase, a randomly spawned [b]End Zone[/b] becomes active. The Seekers have 4 minutes to detect the Hider before they reach the End Zone. The time is ticking, remain shrouded as much as you can to avoid the Seekers or use your tools to find the Hider and fill the Detection bar!

[b]Power-ups.[/b]

Both Seekers and the Hider will have special powers available to help them complete their objectives.

The Seekers' [b]Radar[/b] points to the approximate location of the Hider. Once they have found their target, they can use their [b]Ping[/b] ability to lock onto their exact location and show it on the map (for 20 seconds) for the rest of the team to follow.

The Hider's ability is called [b]Chase Breaker:[/b] when activated, Hiders can force-brake the Seekers and turn off their Radar and Ping for 20 seconds. Chase Breaker will also ghost your car, meaning you will become transparent and able to pass through any smashable object in the game.

Be careful when using your abilities! They have a cooldown period, so you don’t want to be caught empty at the wrong time; manage your resources properly and secure your win.

[b]Matchmaking.[/b]
Once Hide & Seek becomes available to play, a new location will be added to your map to enter this new game mode. You will also be able to access games through the Online page of the main menu.
You will be able to join games alone and matchmake with other players in the community or join as a convoy leader and play with your friends.

[b]Rewards.[/b]
Besides being a fun new game mode to try, there are other perks that come when completing sessions of Hide & Seek.

First, Hide & Seek will have its own separate progression track. You will be able to earn XP exclusive for this game mode by completing games. Leveling up will earn you new badges when you reach certain thresholds.

If you play this game mode frequently, you will build a play streak. When you do, bonus XP will be earned with every completed game, allowing you to level up faster.

Finally, new accolades tied to Hide & Seek will be added to the game for players to unlock while discovering this new multiplayer experience! A set of achievements will be released in a future update in October.

Hide & Seek will be available when the Hidden Horizons series goes live on September 10; we hope you enjoy queuing up for games in this new mode or joining with your friends as a convoy!

notes.title: Coming to your Garage this Month!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/820784ba981347ad0d78e6825f60ee1929440163.png[/img]

[h1]2022 Ford Focus ST[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8913de7955edaf721213094f159c375dc09d6ef5.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the High-Performance Dailies Festival Playlist. Available from August 15 until August 22[/i]

This version of the Focus ST got a facelift done to it, having its badge displayed on top of a new grill underneath a renovated hood. The intakes are positioned differently, and overall, this new look is quite satisfying for a car meant to be driven every day.

However, the best part of a Focus since the beginning of time is the way it drives. Fitted with a 2.3-liter turbocharged engine that nets 276 bhp will take you from 0-100 kmh in 5.5 seconds. In addition to that great engine, the superb driving of the ST makes your everyday rides feel like you are completing a racing circuit.

[h1]2023 Toyota Camry TRD[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2e87e47733ec421efdb459e07c0e42443673b905.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the High-Performance Dailies Festival Playlist. Available from August 22 until August 29[/i]

In the history of motorsport, only three letters can take a car from regular jJoe to track superstar; and that is the case with the 20 PTS reward available during the Autumn Season on High-Performance Dailies.  Take a spin around the new circuits available this series on the 2023 Toyota Camry TRD.

Designed to take the Camry into a newer and sportier horizon, the TRD was fitted with an all-new suspension for more precise handling and body control. A front splitter, side aero skirts, a rear diffuser, and a rear spoiler were added to its kit to maximize aerodynamics and reduce drag. 

Completing the performance package in this car, a 3.5-liter V6 engine sits snugly underneath this car’s hood, and taking a close look at the wheels will reveal the new sports brakes added to the car. 

[h1]2023 Ford Fiesta ST[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0e9f6bc8d8ef0962d8b18554799bcdfe5addc610.jpg[/img]Earn [i]20 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the High-Performance Dailies Festival Playlist. Available from August 29 until September 5[/i]

The final version of the 2023 Ford Fiesta ST sprints into the Horizon Festival. To wave goodbye to entire generations of fans, Ford has produced a street racer that may look small but has charmed the masses with its amazing handling.

The Fiesta ST is fitted with a 1.5 Ecoboost turbocharged engine that produces 197 bhp and 236 lb-ft of torque: a racing experience that is as economical as it is thrilling.

Of course, the main feature of every Fiesta (and especially the ST) is its agility, made possible by its softer steering and a new suspension. 

One of the UK’s favorites runs into Mexico to win new fans and a ton of races. Have a go at the multiple customization pieces available for the car as you unlock it!

[h1]2021 Dodge Durango SRT Hellcat[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/21067634269520b867ed7e353c08f1014502620d.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 “Spring” Season on the High-Performance Dailies Festival Playlist. Available from September 5 until September 12[/i]

Close this daily-drive-party with a performance SUV branded with the Hellcat badge: the 2021 Dodge Durango SRT Hellcat.

A 6.2-liter V8 engine powers this performance SUV and produces a whopping 710 brake horsepower making this the most powerful car ever produced in its category at the time. The Durango’s massive power can be put to the test in a race as the car breaks the 100 kmh barrier in just 3.5 seconds --or by towing, since it can hold up to 8,700 pounds (about 3946.25 kg).

Bembo brakes, shocks, and wide tires tame the power of this performance SUV and translate it into excellent handling. 

Overall, the Durango Hellcat gives a muscle-like experience to share with an entire family.

[h1] What's Next?[/h1]

Next stop: Hidden Horizons! Join us as we welcome a brand-new game mode, new reward cars, the Stadium Maze, and the return of Pathfinder!

notes.title: Everyday Racers Line Up at the Starting Line in High-Performance Dailies
notes.content:
The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-high-performance-dailies]new update[/url] coming to Forza Horizon 5 features everyday cars built for performance. Unlock four reward cars that celebrate the car-next-door vibe with two hatchbacks  and an extreme off-roader.

Make the most out of these vehicles with the four Sprint Road Race Routes that will be added permanently to the game starting this series. 

Get your foot on the gas pedal and make your engines roar in High-Performance Dailies!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7d37c374364e01a530518f35447bc2cc996ebba1.png[/img]
[h2]Get Your Racing on with Four New Road Race Routes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2af2621a9fd2e837875f60467813481744855443.jpg[/img]
Get your cars to the starting line and prepare to set the fastest times you can on the four new Road Race Routes we have added to Forza Horizon 5 on High-Performance Dailies. 

Each of these new roads will let you earn an Accolade for posting a clean time on them and they will also be featured on different Festival Playlist challenges. They will all be permanently available after the series ends!

The four new races are: 
[list][*] Cloverleaf Sprint
[*] San Juan Sprint
[*] Valle del Rio Sprint
[*] Rocosa Sprint [/list] 
Enjoy these routes on both Horizon Open and Rivals from August 13 and on the World Map starting August 15!  

[h2]New Collectible Added[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ca8a99cc00d205e3789e75018741752923a9e418.png[/img]

To remind you that going fast and smashing through things is a very serious matter, we have added a collectible item that’s suited up and ready to race.

Featured on the Festival Playlist’s second week, the Business Suit Tank Collectible will be available to find, smash, and add to your collection. 

Your EventLab creations will feel like the casual Friday at the office as you will be able to add this collectible to your events as well.

[h2]Let Your Inner Artist Flourish![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ee0a6e62ee77e3f488b17ef0ba9403d44144aad2.png[/img]
Time for a color splash for your character!

Available as a reward on the first week of High-Performance Dailies’ Festival Playlist, unlock the Artist Outfit by completing the #BackToSchool Challenge.

Now you’ll know what to wear when making a new livery or build for your cars.

[h2]Festival Playlist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/820784ba981347ad0d78e6825f60ee1929440163.png[/img]
The next four weeks will be packed with four everyday cars overloaded to provide maximum performance. 

Make room in your garage for three hatchbacks and an off-road SUV as the weekly rewards coming to Forza Horizon 5 in High-Performance Dailies.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]
Next stop: Hidden Horizons! Join us as we welcome a brand-new game mode, new reward cars, the Stadium Maze, and the return of Pathfinder!

notes.title: A Brazilian Exotic Makes its Way to Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6166013a476ed14c4a36911a4ade54c333ab35f5.png[/img]
Coming in as Cars & Coffee’s second Reward Car, the 1976 Volkswagen SP-2 comes into the Horizon Festival to shoot its shot to be named your garage’s prettiest car for 20 PTS until August 1. 

This car was once called the most beautiful VW ever made, the signature front and sporty curves in the back make a fair case about it. 

Made using the Brazilian VW Type 3 Variant’s chassis and adding a stylistic changes in its body, yielded a unique car made to satisfy a country’s need for sports cars amid a time of heavy restrictions.

notes.title: Coming to Your Garage this Month
notes.content:
[h2]Can you unlock these cars from around the world?[/h2]

[h3] 2017 Aston Martin Vanquish Zagato Coupé [/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3ec688711d43711d2d04e63a4b0c2c4a5331642e.png[/img]

Even though the makers of this update’s Series Reward might prefer tea in their cups every morning, there’s no doubt the 2017 Aston Martin Vanquish Zagato Coupé is as potent as your favorite brand of jitter juice. 

The 6.0-liter V12 engine roaring under this car’s hood will surely wake up the neighbors and wish them a happy morning with the smell of gasoline and burnt rubber. There’s no better morning routine than doing some skincare and then going all out on the track reaching 0-100 kmh in just 3.5 seconds. 

Welcome the fifth car in the 50-year-old collaboration between Aston Martin and Zagato with our 80 PTS Series Reward Car for Horizon Cars & Coffee! 

[h3] 2021 Lamborghini Aventador LP 780-4 Ultimae [/h3] 

Created as a numbered series, only 350 models of the coupe version of the final Aventador were produced. We are of course referring to the 2021 Lamborghini Aventador LP 780-4 Ultimae, the ultimate Aventador. Inside this raging bull beats a naturally aspirated V12 heart; the most powerful engine Lamborghini has ever produced, being able to create 769 break horsepower that nets a 0-100 kmh time of 2.8 seconds. Take a sip of that Lambo espresso driving in the best and last version of the Italian brand’s former signature car: the LP 780-4 Ultimae. 

[h3] 1976 Volkswagen SP-2 [/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6166013a476ed14c4a36911a4ade54c333ab35f5.png[/img]

Though it may not look as striking as some hyper cars; the 1976 Volkswagen SP-2 is still an exotic rarity worthy of a spot in your collection. 

Born in Brazil out of the need of locally produced race cars, the SP-2 was created by VW Brazil using the same chassis the Brazilian VW Type 3 Variant was made on and fitting a 1.7-liter air-cooled engine. 

Even though the car ended up heavier, its steel body provides an amazing cosmetic finish that let it stand out from other local competitors of the same category. 

Try a cult classic and Latin American rarity formerly named the most beautiful Volkswagen in the world with the 1976 Volkswagen SP-2. 

[h3] 2022 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF [/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/836b22c3b315c854c1f1c4deb5e301a9405300ee.png[/img]

Just when your morning jolt isn’t quite making it, the 2022 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF clutches in to save the day. 

The Miata RF is a fantastic convertible that is also such a pleasure to drive; its new Kinematic Posture Control allows it to (somehow) improve its cornering abilities compared to previous models.  

The 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine produces 181 hp and 151 lb-ft, plus it has the perfect power to weight ratio for a car of this kind. Coupled with its improved power steering system, the Miata is waiting for a few mods to become a drift king. 

[h3] 1973 Volkswagen Thing[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/836c8f52915d323d5d1180ede560f1558dbea5e9.png[/img]

Another air-cooled, repurposed, automotive oddity will be available to unlock this series as the final Festival Playlist Reward Car. This time, it's the German military truck transformed into outdoor explorer, the 1973 Volkswagen Thing. 

The birth certificate of this car states its purpose was leisure, whether you wanted to take it off roading or on your everyday drives, the Thing would deliver fun every turn of its wheels. 

Even though the stock version of this car is as stripped as they come, it will only take a few tweaks from your building mastermind to transform it into the off-roader of your dreams! 

[h2] JDM Jewels Car Pack [/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/888cb417ec70028fa4c45619ebb7795315d1b082.png[/img]

Japanese styling and engineering take the Horizon Festival for a ride with the latest Car Pack coming to Forza Horizon 5! 

The JDM Jewels Car Pack includes 4 versatile vehicles that were only available in the Japanese Market to drive and customize. 

[h3] 1993 Autozam AZ-1 [/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e25aaf28fb0e69fd5f8ad2a6b825e34bb555a5fe.png[/img]

Thanks to the restrictions on what can be called a kei car, most models end up being kind of dull and soulless. However, the makers of what has been called one of the greatest kei cars of all time broke the mold with the 1993 Autozam AZ-1. 

This fun-sized warrior had everything you want to see in a traditional hyper car like gullwing doors, an aerodynamic body design, and an engine sitting in the middle. No wonder its production chief was the same person in charge of the first Miata! 

How fast can you make your AZ-1? Only one way to find out: with the JDM Jewels Car Pack available now! 

[h3] 1997 Mitsubishi Montero Evolution [/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a94af3d246043d59f3cacb7c071bacb4014f4abe.png[/img]

Make room in your garage and your Hall of Fame for the car that has won the Dakar Rally 12 times, the JDM Jewels Car Pack is proud to present the 1997 Mitsubishi Montero Evolution. 

The road version of the back-to-back rally champion comes equipped with a 3.5-liter V6 engine able to produce 275 horsepower to plow through many terrains and surfaces. Contrary to normal 4x4 vehicles, the Montero’s body featured a hood scoop and two spoilers in the back. 

From the inside the Montero doesn’t even try to hide its racing origins. Two bucket seats in the front along with racing-style gauges so you feel like you are running against the clock in the roughest terrains imaginable. 

[h3] 1997 Nissan Stagea RS Four V [/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4941040989e128db70d68542df88448e5c975f77.png[/img]

Made from a mixture of parts from some of Nissan’s greatest cars, the 1997 Nissan Stagea RS Four V is, put simply, a station wagon that can go fast. 

Lurking inside of this vehicle is a 2.6-liter straight six engine and underneath it an all-wheel drive system; but not just any engine and AWD system as these are the same ones you can find in a Nissan R33 Skyline. 

A fast vehicle with all the room in the back for your groceries, luggage, or whatever you can fit inside. The cherry on top is the wide array of improvements people make on this car using its already solid base. 

[h3] 1991 Toyota Sera[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8d7e8ce98dd37e29de342c599dc048fbed665174.png[/img]

One of the most unique hatchbacks ever built has come to the Horizon Festival. Not only will the 1991 Toyota Sera amaze you with its unique engine, but it will also do it with the remarkable style it was built with. 

You have probably never seen a hatch quite like this before. To start, the first impression you’ll probably get from this car will be made by its glass canopy rooftop; we can all agree it is not the norm for three-doored vehicles. Then, trying to pull on the doors won’t do you any good when getting in, as the Sera was fitted with butterfly-style doors.  

To complete the set of extravaganzas, you’ll be greeted by a 1.5 L engine; though those numbers might not impress you, this was the largest version of the 5E-FHE engine ever made. 

 

[h2] What’s Next[/h2] 

Time to rev those engines High-Performance Dailies. The next series coming to Forza Horizon 5 will feature 4 Festival Playlist Reward Cars, new racing routes, and new EventLab props including our latest collectible.

notes.title: Get Your Cup Filled to the Brim with Cars & Coffee- July 16th!
notes.content:
Relax with the latest update coming to Forza Horizon 5: Horizon Cars & Coffee. This new series features a brand-new Evolving World Location, the Coffee Shop, which will become your favorite location for solo or group photo ops. Stay for a late cup o’ joe and watch the new drone show featured at the Coffee Shop at night! 

The finest beans are waiting for you to take a sip, or should we say a smash, as you find our newest collectible hidden in the Coffee Shop. 

Cars from around the world converge at the Festival’s new hot spot with the Reward Cars coming this series including the 2017 Aston Martin Vanquish Zagato Coupé, 2021 Lamborghini Aventador LP 780-4 Ultimae, 1976 Volkswagen SP-2, 2022 Mazda MX-5 Miata RF, and the 1973 Volkswagen Thing. 

Four of Japan’s biggest stars shine brighter than ever in the JDM Jewels Car Pack coming this series welcoming Japan exclusive cars that have made their way to Mexico to Forza Horizon 5. 

Props, badges, outfits, and more will be available starting July 16 in Horizon Cars & Coffee! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/661837cd6b4f7e6d7c0692e96629093a7d058e79.png[/img]
 
[h2]Release Notes and Game Fixes. [/h2]

[/list] 

[b]Cars [/b] 

[list] 

[*]The 2023 Hyundai Ioniq 5 N’s rear badge will now show as intended 

[*]Fixed the 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse’s dark matte textures 

[*]All three Time Machine’s side mirrors will now display properly 

[*]Fixed an issue with the 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara ‘Jurassic Park’ where sometimes wheels were clipping after large jumps 

[/list] 

[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here[/url]. The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 
 

[h2]A New Evolving World Location is Brewing at the Horizon Festival. [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c82e3cec7ac1169ab55d2d7a004b0016c0fe7c9f.png[/img]

Horizon Cars & Coffee brings you the best place to ingest your mandatory dose of much needed daily caffeine in the Coffee Shop Location. This new spot is piping hot with locations to take pictures of your cars and even entire convoys! 

The Coffee Shop is riddled with the same murals you can see in different areas of the Mexico map, and some new artwork on its walls. Furthermore, you can use the drive-through area for cool photo opportunities. 

Look at the inside of the Coffee Shop and you’ll find a nice photo studio when you need a picture of your favorite rides with a clean white background. Special lights will also turn on at this section of the Shop at night for a unique illumination on your pictures.  

All around the Coffee Shop you will see platforms designed to fit multiple cars; these are amazing for group shots to immortalize your convoys. In total, there are three platforms surrounding the Shop; one features another iconic mural seen across Mexico, while the other two use nature as their backdrop. 
 

[h2] A Coffee with Unique Body for You to Unlock [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2af5d3b94bf2303101634ca5067c10d6de3c12ff.png[/img]

Nothing beats the sensation of putting on your most comfy set of clothes to get a nice cup of your favorite kind of coffee and going for a ride on the crisp roads of the Horizon Festival.  

To help you with that first part, we have added the Coffee Cup outfit as an unlockable reward on the first week of the Festival Playlist. 

We know how hard it is to put a smile on your face before you have had your first cup of the day, so we decided to include a premade smile on this outfit, so you don’t have to fake it until that first glorious sip. 
 

[h2] The Most Caffeinated Drone Show Yet! [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3a62305e3cf32ee3ebd3daa478e02a181511e536.png[/img]

The Coffee Shop Location will also be the host of a completely new drone show in this series! 

Visit the new Evolving World Location at night and watch the flying drones make the shapes of a coffee cup, a car wheel, and this series’ logo. 

The drone show plus the spotlights that appear at night near the Coffee Shop will also provide unique photo opportunities for you and your convoy. 
 

[h2] Spill the Beans with This New Collectible [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/47bd8e57e6791662ba244bd72a72e0025515aa53.png[/img]

There’s no need to make a line for this one-of-a-kind cup, you just need to find it. 

Visit the Coffee Shop during the third week of Horizon Cars & Coffee and smash 10 Coffee Cup Collectibles to complete the Spill the Beans challenge available that week. 

Be careful with the cup! As soon as you hit it, you’ll see its content spilled all over the place. 
 

[h2] No Sugar, No Cream, Just Props. [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0a3440064112642ce0b85b210fc8383db459a48a.png[/img]

EventLab creators, your order is up and ready! 

If you liked what you saw at the Coffee Shop, we are making some of the bits and pieces that made the new area special available for your EventLab creations.  

Six new props to build your own relaxation station or a highly caffeinated racing course will be available this series. Enjoy building with: 

[list] 

[*]Ramps & Platforms  

[list][*]Cars & Coffee Plinth[/list]

notes.content:
[h2]Can you unlock these future legendary vehicles?[/h2]

[h3] 2023 KIA EV6 GT [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e67260a49cae3a8f89ef545717f5a72fc5b546e4.png[/img]

Earn 80 PTS during the Modern Horizons Festival Playlist to unlock as a Series Reward. 

The 2023 KIA EV6 GT has the heart-and-home feel of an SUV that crosses the “GT” line on the sand to become a racing utility vehicle that’s as comfy as it is powerful.  

Like a futuristic spaceship, EV6 GT features a green button on the steering wheel that unlocks its true power, transforming this changeling from urban driver into racing speedster able to go from 0 – 100 kmh in just 3.2 seconds using its surprising 576 bhp. 

To keep you on your toes from the get-go, this KIA’s inside is adorned with racing interiors like the seats and trim, so even the tamest drives around the Festival will have the unique race-to-the-finish feel. 

Did we mention it’s 4 wheel-drive and electric? Because it is and we love it. 

[h3] 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b21bddef136340b353e7caf55baa09187c3e664b.jpg[/img]

Galloping to the Horizon Festival with crashing footfalls; it’s the latest, biggest, and meanest horse we have seen: the 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse. 

As soon as you pop this car’s hood you will be greeted with a very delightful badge, one that says “5.0”. The emblem is not there only for decoration, it’s to remind you of the massive 5.0-liter V8 naturally aspirated Coyote engine that drives this car forward and powers it with 500 horsepower. 

6-speed manual transmission and rear-wheel drive to get the complete muscle car experience and an updated braking system to excel its performance on the track as well 

Enjoy the reckless charge of the 2024 Ford Mustang Dark Horse! 

[h3] 2023 Hyundai iONIQ 5 N [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d911da39277c506e00d30887e9d081fe4169df26.png[/img]

The future has arrived. Looking like your regular Sunday-drive SUV, but hiding a potent powertrain and futuristic technology, the 2023 Hyundai IONIQ 5 N is an auspice for cars to come.  

The all-electric powertrain will put its 320 bhp to work and to make the 5 N vanish right in front of your eyes as it reaches 100 kmh from a standstill in 4.5 seconds.  

This new iONIQ is a great outdoors partner with an upgraded towing capacity, a great ride, and a minimalist interior design you’ll want to live in. 

[h3] 2021 Toyota GR Yaris [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/04d5908c5738f4f645bd629cd229f55bbfc1a2d6.png[/img]

Running on sheer force of vigor and with a willingness to take you from point A to point B in the least number of seconds possible, the 2021 Toyota GR Yaris is taking its shot as your new favorite hot hatch.  

The GR is quite hot, actually: a daredevilish four-wheel drive system to make quick work of corners, a very eager 2.1-liter turbocharged engine that puts out 257 bhp, and a six-speed manual transmission to experience corner taking like a true champion built to smash the giants of the track. 

Drive around the Horizon Festival in the new benchmark for modern hatchbacks and create your own special build of the versatile vehicle. 

[h3] 2023 Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo Turbo S [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0e0942979c51a673694bef7211cdab34bb919db3.png[/img]

Picture it: the echo of eons of Porsche's magnificent history added to modern electric technology and comfort of an all-wheel-drive SUV. You don’t have to imagine it anymore: it's the 2023 Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo Turbo S,: Porsche’s all-electric sports utility vehicle. 

As the name implies, this Taycan shares a lot of aspects and components with its sedan counterpart. However, the electric SUV comes with two engines that output 750 horses as soon as you touch that pedal. You will cruise so comfortably inside; you’d probably forget that this vehicle can reach 100 kmh in just 2.4 seconds. 

Porsche reaps the past by adding elements of its racing legacy into this model which perfectly contrasts with the new generation additions such as touch screens and, of course, the completely modern electric power train bringing the racing history of the brand into the modern era. 

[h2] Universal Icons Car Pack [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1ce2e1108d694ce35c7b3d37af71d4373ca79b6b.png[/img]

From the big screen to your gaming monitor, these icons from your favorite movies and TV shows take the Horizon Festival for a retro revival!  

Experience new adventures for K.I.T.T. from Knight Rider, the Jurassic Park 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara, and all 3 versions of the Time Machine from the Back to the Future trilogy! 

 

[h3] Time Machine from Back to the Future [/h3]  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a0c0003d2a39a01d7f15257beae6c44fce6f82fb.png[/img]

The original Time Machine from Back to the Future has arrived at the Horizon Festival! 

Lights and sounds similar to what you saw on the film will burst out of the car just when you hit 88 mph. 

[h3] Time Machine from Back to the Future Part II [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b23a264a40320a8e22159e6599d658eb2c034d92.png[/img]

Complete with the new Mr. Fusion attachment, the second iteration of the Time Machine will also be available on the Universal Icons Car Pack.  

Just like the first Time Machine, this one will display unique effects once the classic 88 mph speed is met. 

[h3] Time Machine from Back to the Future Part III [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0a84b4e763c83156fcc860d89af02b8dcc47197d.png[/img]

Back to the Future’s Time Machine from the saga’s third instalment will be at your disposal in this Car Pack. 

The driving experience of this Time Machine really sets it apart from the previous two versions, and of course, this one will also produce the iconic VFX of its movie counterpart when it reaches, you guessed it, 88 mph. 

[h3] 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara from Jurassic Park [/h3]   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a472bb251c3b36394bfeed1811cda718cb7dab1d.png[/img]

From Isla Nublar, the Horizon Festival welcomes Jurassic Park’s 1992 Jeep Wrangler Sahara. 

Your vehicle of choice to race on the different off-roading courses in Mexico or to take on a cozy tour watching unusually large ancient reptiles. 

[h3] K.I.T.T from Knight Rider [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/689864a78a58ff0714bcea9b1398c347a4758d24.png[/img]

Villains hidden across the Horizon Festival, beware! A muscle car powered by justice and artificial intelligence has arrived. 

K.I.T.T also comes with a body kit (no pun intended) that allows it to activate Super Pursuit Mode! 

[h2] You’re Gonna Need a Bigger Car... [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/496708dfff59e139b37c3c07865ff4a1b11b3d54.png[/img]

Lurking in the deepest corners of the Festival Playlist’s second week is an outfit so amazing nobody has been able to keep it in captivity. From the bottom of the ocean, get your character ready to wear the Shark Outfit--includes swim trunks and fins! 

Complete Week 2 EventLab “Laderas Core” by PinHead Larry06 to unlock this exclusive outfit. 

[h2] A Modern Construct to Add to Your Collection [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/66b6717902ec6a5e4b10d7e102510ad4b11445d2.png[/img]

BEEP BOOP BOP! Transmission confirmed. Location of the new collectible: unknown. Coolness level: the highest. 

Modern Horizon’s second week Collectible event will give you the chance to find and smash. 

You will also be able to add this automaton to your EventLab constructions in case you were looking for a futuristic theme or build a robotic scenario. 

[h2] What’s Next [/h2] 

Time to slow things down and take a well-deserved breather!  

Forza Horizon 5’s next update will feature a new Evolving World Coffee Shop, as well as new collectibles and clothing items, and, of course, new cars to unlock and collect!

notes.title: One of BMW’s Greatest Sports Coupés is Looking for a Space in Your Garage
notes.content:

Beautiful on the outside, and mighty strong on the inside; the 1986 BMW M635CSi set the
standards for how a sports coupé should look like and perform.

Fitted with a mighty BMW straight-six cylinder engine that amassed 262 bhp, this luxury
racer could achieve a top speed of 255 kmh and produced 246 lb-ft of torque.
Next to the undeniable power came the superlative innovation this car included in the form
of electronic components and additions such as catalytic converters and exhaust gas
purification.

made by the fantastic Paul Bracq.

notes.title: Hyundai And Lamborghini Flash their Past into the Future.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6a1b8ee5d5505de97ad5f3396c25acc739455b24.png[/img]
Lamborghini brings the legend of your childhood dreams into the 21st century with a
modernized, hybrid version of the iconic Countach: the 2021 Lamborghini Countach LPI
800-4.

The electric power train fitted into this car makes it able to almost instantaneously deliver
its 802 bhp as soon as you hit the gas pedal. In return, this car can run from 0-100 km/h in
just 2.8 seconds.

Only 112 units of this Lambo were made, each packed with a 6.5-liter V12 engine powered
by jealousy of everyone you know.

Unlock this car until May 30 for 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist!

If you have any suggestions to make the Forza Horizon 5 experience better than it has
been, visit our [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url] and let us know!

Contact the team [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]on the Troubleshooting Hub[/url] if you see any
issues with this new update or its features.

Dip your toes into the awesome splash created by the Retrowave completing every
challenge available to you this week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/193b7248c21fa381becbe76bf4e67cb633e5cb34.jpg[/img]
[b]SERIES REWARDS [/b]
[list]
[*]80 PTS: 2022 Hyundai N Vision 74
[*]160 PTS: 1982 DeLorean DMC-12 [/list]
[b]SPRING REWARDS [/b]
[list]
[*]20 PTS: 2021 Lamborghini Countach
[*]40 PTS: 1992 Ferrari 512 TR [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ed703e4cbf2df726714922741594b2cadfcf5537.png[/img]

The 1974 Pony concept car reimagined, reworked, and rebirthed as the 2022 Hyundai N
Vision 74 comes as Horizon Retrowave’s Series reward for 80 PTS.

This bit of past and future combined goes together better than PB & J, with its
retrofuturistic outside design and the top-of-the-line hydrogen fuel cell and electric power
train that give this car instant torque as soon as your foot steps on the pedal.

The future is now, and it has 670 bhp to time travel around the Horizon Festival!

notes.title: Coming to Your Garage with Horizon Retrowave!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/193b7248c21fa381becbe76bf4e67cb633e5cb34.jpg[/img]
Past, present, and future converge in the 5 cars available to unlock this series. Enjoy collecting and driving cars built to remember old glories, bring to life concepts of the past, or reminders of awesome eras.  

Here are the cars to unlock on this series Festival Playlist: 

[h3]2022 Hyundai N Vision 74[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/175239a23d800a84780301e22dfb6ee09069b21f.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 80 PTS during the Horizon Retrowave Festival Playlist to unlock as a Series Reward. [/i] 

Based on the already amazing idea of the 1974 Pony Coupe Concept, Hyundai took the Pony for a time traveling ride and brought back a ton of ideas that show us what the future of car making could look like with the 2022 Hyundai N Vision 74   

The N Vision comes with a hydrogen fuel cell and an electric power train that gives the car 670 horsepower and instant torque. Adding cooling units allows the car to run a lap around any track flat-out without risking performance. 

You can see hints of other celebrated cars like the Delorean in the design of the N Vision; however, the thrill comes when you make this car your own with a nice tuning. 

[h3]2021 Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6a1b8ee5d5505de97ad5f3396c25acc739455b24.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the Horizon Retrowave Festival Playlist. Available from May 23 until May 30. [/i] 

Bringing a legend into the 21st century is no easy task, however if anyone can make is one of Italy’s best car makers ever. Lamborghini decided to celebrate the 50th anniversary of one of their elite supercars with the 2021 Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4. 

In one of the coolest tricks, we have seen to modernize a vintage icon, Lamborghini made the new Countach a hybrid supercar that puts out approximately 802 bhp at the tips of your fingers. 

This upgraded machine appears to have been built to make your friends jealous as only 112 units were ever made. Each one of those pieces includes an astonishing 6.5-liter V12 engine capable of teleporting you from 0-100 km/h in just 2.8 seconds.  

Jump into the future with Lambo here to replace your childhood posters. 

[h3]1986 BMW M635CSi[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/31146341bb30dcbf3f021f7fb30d1682edacaeb4.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the Horizon Retrowave Festival Playlist. Available from May 30 until June 6. [/i] 

Listening to that BMW M88 6-cylinder engine really takes us back to a time when things were simpler and the 1986 BMW M635CSi was the king of the crossroads between luxury and powerful performance. 

 This front-engine, rear-wheel drive was a powerful sporty coupé equipped with 282 bhp and a not-too-shabby 246 lb-ft of torque this car could reach a top speed of 255 km/h. 

It’s not all speed when we talk about an icon of an era such as de M365, the engineering of this car also relied on modern electronics and innovative inclusions such as catalytic converters and exhaust gas purification. Likewise, this car’s exterior design was superbly designed by Paul Bracq; the result was a timeless stylish design with sportive details. 

One of the biggest and baddest sports cars of another era flashbacks into the Horizon Festival with the 1986 BMW M635CSi! 

[h3]1980 Lotus Esprit Turbo[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f20b0c8221fd96ad152f83892d15b05aa149e3b2.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the Horizon Retrowave Festival Playlist. Available from June 6 until June 13. [/i] 

An already fantastic car takes the leap into supercar territory with the aid of a Garrett T3 turbocharger, get your teacups and biscuits ready for the 1980 Lotus Esprit Turbo. 

Even though it still carries the Esprit label tag, this version is almost entirely new. From the “Turbo Esprit” decals found on the body to the 2.2 -liter engine, new suspension, and aerodynamic additions done to the body, the Esprit Turbo looks refined, refreshed, and ready to race.  

A trip down memory lane wouldn’t be complete without revisiting an English masterpiece like the Esprit Turbo. 

[h3]1986 Citroen BX 4TC[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e63de3899bf24a77e82b567c5fa43854d343b2bd.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 “Spring” Season on the Horizon Retrowave Festival Playlist. Available from June 13 until June 20.[/i] 

Built to fulfil the production requirements of the World Rally Championship, the 1986 Citroen BX 4TC’s commercial version puts the thrill of rally performance at your reach. 

An iron casted 2.1-liter engine with straight 4 cylinders powered this production version to achieve a top speed of 220 km/h and reach a 0-100 km/h time of 7.5 seconds. The 4TC also featured Citroën’s iconic hydropneumatic suspension system.  

Only 62 units of this car were produced, so not only are you getting rally heritage, you’ll also be adding a real-life rarity to your collection. 

[h2]What’s Next.[/h2] 

We drive off the Retrowave sunset and approach Modern Horizons! 

This next series will feature new cars including one a lot of our players have been requesting as well as new EventLab props and a brand-new collectible. 

Keep on adventuring and we’ll see you next series, adiós!

notes.title: Get Soaked in the Horizon Retrowave!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ed703e4cbf2df726714922741594b2cadfcf5537.png[/img]
A wave filled with neon lights, synthwave music, and retro vibes floods the Horizon Festival with Horizon Retrowave, the latest update coming to Forza Horizon 5. 

5 new retrofuturistic rides join your collection as this series’ reward cars including the 21st century version of a Lambo legend and Hyundai that fuses past and present in the same vehicle. 

Enjoy the new radio Station, Horizon Wave, that will be providing a synthwave soundtrack to your driving adventures through the Festival. This new station brings a new host and over 10 new tracks all in synthwave style. 

A new Neon Highway appears with neon decorations that will vibe with the music playing on your radio as you drive by.  

Keep on reading to get splashed with the retro revival taking over the Horizon Festival on Horizon Retrowave! 

[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes[/h2] 
[list] 
[*]20 new EventLab props including 12 with lights synched to the music being played through in-game radio. 
[*]New Horizon Wave Radio Station featuring a new DJ and 21 new songs 
[*]New Neon Highway 
[*]General  
[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue where AI Traffic cars were not present in Street Races 
[*]Improvements made for an issue where some players were getting “Forza Horizon Server Not Available” error message while trying to connect to the Auction House, Message Centre, Leaderboards or browse Liveries, Tunes and Vinyl 
[*]Fixed an issue where players were not able to follow/unfollow creators via the Creative Hub 
[*]General performance and stability fixes[/list] 
[*]Cars 
[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2020 Audi TT RS where front fenders were disappearing when equipping the customized hood 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2020 Audi TT RS where the digital gauge in the cockpit view had some texture inconsistencies [/list][/list][url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here[/url]. The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 

[h2]Get Your Sunglasses Ready for Cruise on the Neon Highway.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/009b3d3337e63a8028724fa95ee44760856871a8.png[/img]
The lights are bright and the highway long, the Neon Highway shows up at the Horizon Festival to set the retro mood for the series. 

Going for a drive on the Neon Highway, you’ll spot tons of different decorations all with a sweet neon groove. Take a look at the neon rails, palm trees, and tank mascots scattered around the highway as you drive.  

The vibes and mood aren’t the only thing the Neon Highway has; its decorations will be synched to the song playing on your in-game radio, so go for a drive and change your station to see how the highway fits your mood. 

Find these new decorations on the Highway near “The Marathon” event. 

The Neon Highway isn’t the only part of the map getting flashy this series; neon decorations from Midnight at Horizon are coming back to races featured on series 34, and the extended night cycles are coming back with them to get a better view of all the neon lights shining through the Festival.  

[h2]Feast Your Eyes with the Drone Retro Show.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6f933479a63cfc37db041c26b441e9717a7b9e1f.png[/img]
Drive to the right side of the Stadium, close to “The Marathon” event and take a look at the neon-fueled drone show brought to you this series. 

A big, bright sun made by drones will set on the edge of the Neon Highway for you to gaze at for a completely retro experience. 

Use this setting and event to score some amazing pictures and to dampen yourself with the retrowave coming for the next four weeks.  

[h2]Get Your Synth-Vibe on with the New Radio Station.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/28a162fbf2516af4867a65f504e9299a1dd50d91.jpg[/img]
The lights are set, and the location is vibing; get the complete Retrowave experience with the brand-new radio station coming to Forza Horizon 5. 

As soon as you enter the game, our new DJ, Isabel Moss will welcome you to Horizon Wave, the synthwave radio station kicking off transmissions with the new update. 

This new radio station features 21 new songs including the streamer friendly “Encanto Remix” by Mitch Murder.  

All seasonal events will have their ambiance set with the music of this new station.

The Retrowave Outfit will be available to unlock by completing the Festival Playlist’s first week photo challenge. A purple suit and a glove full of power to become completely submerged in the wave.

notes.title: Celebrate 50 Years of A Legendary Victory with the Ford GT #66 GTLM Le Mans!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3ce709cf504729d62ef26f081820375b7e5491b7.jpg[/img]
Ford returns to one of the most famous endurance races of all time with a mighty racer powered by efficiency and legacy. The 2016 Ford GT #66 GTLM Le Mans is a 500+ horsepowered car built to celebrate the 50th anniversary of Ford’s iconic 1-2-3 win at Le Mans in 1966.

The power in this car is brought to you by a 3.5-liter twin-turbocharged EcoBoost V6 engine; the same one that took home the gold at the Rolex 24 hours at Daytona and the 12 Hours of Sebrig.
Take a legendary racer through Mexico’s toughest GT challenges and write event more wins on the Ford GT’s scoreboard unlocking it for 20 PTS from April 25 until May 2.

notes.title: Coming to Your Garage in Apex AllStars
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/dad9d6433e143d174711e5f3031253a7585b0dbf.jpg[/img]
This series we are featuring 5 AllStar competitors taking positions on the grid as the Festival Playlist rewards for Apex AllStars. 

You will be able to unlock and race in different record-breaking GT racers and cross the checkpoints featured in the different courses located through Mexico’s fine scenery with these reward cars. 

[h3]2013 Chevrolet Summit Racing Pro Stock Camaro[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/668f2326d9f8437d8518c06fe4d00e3305a48368.jpg[/img]
Presenting the 2013 Chevrolet Summit Racing Pro Stock Camaro, a dragster from Chevrolet whose call card is insane acceleration.  

If you start counting to 10, by the time you reach 6 this car will have already completed a quarter mile drag race. This car’s top speed reaches 310 kmh and it won’t take long to reach it either. 

The Street Scene will be happy to receive a former NHRA Series winner as you unlock the Pro Stock Camaro for 80 PTS. 

[h3]2016 Ford GT #66 GTLM Le Mans[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3ce709cf504729d62ef26f081820375b7e5491b7.jpg[/img]
Built to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Ford’s amazing win at Le Mans, the 2016 Ford GT #66 GTLM Le Mans is looking to reprise the feat and bring home another gold trophy. 

After their stunning 1-2-3 victory in 1966, Ford takes on the endurance challenge of Le Mans once again with a modern version of the Ford GT which included a 3.5-liter twin-turbocharged EcoBoost V6 engine. This same powertrain guaranteed wins at Rolex 24 at Daytona and the 12 Hours of Sebring. 

500+ horsepower of pure legacy is at your disposal to craft your own racing legacy and pedigree with the power and efficiency of the 2016 #66 GTLM Le Mans. 

[h3]2021 Hyundai #98 Bryan Herta Autosport Elantra N[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d31384ccefb15c683c1605c3cc46176af5fd8f4a.jpg[/img]
With a 2.0-liter turbocharged engine, the latest touring car racers by Hyundai and the former Pirelli World Challenge champions Bryan Herta Autosport are ready to run a victory lap around Mexico’s road racing courses. 

Coming out of a second-place finish at IMSA Michelin Pilot Challenge in 2021 and another silver medal in that same Challenge on 2023, the 2021 Hyundai #98 Bryan Herta Autosport Elantra N is looking to stand at the top of the podium on the Horizon Festival. 

Hit the asphalt with this car’s 2.0-liter turbocharged engine and taste the full throttle of its amazing 350 horsepower. 

[h3]2005 Mitsubishi #1 Sierra Enterprises Lancer Evolution Time Attack[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/268301ef53666cedd2af5e3925ca66661da3472f.jpg[/img]
The proud owner of the 7th fastest lap of the Super Lap Battle’s Unlimited Class time attack challengers, the 2005 Mitsubishi #1 Sierra Enterprises Lancer Evolution Time Attack is a handling and speed expert eager to get your name on the top of the Rivals Leaderboard. 

Powered by a mostly unchanged 2.2-liter Cosworth engine that produced 716 horsepower, the car took home the Super Lap's Unlimited AWD class in 2009 and then snatched 1st place again next year shattering the FXMD NSX’s record. 

If you are a fan of breaking records (and who isn’t, honestly) this is the car to unlock and leave your mark in racing history. 

[h3]2017 Porsche #92 GT Team 911 RSR[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3ef06a4f65b3abcd6f78195e1a4eb3c411c0e2c4.jpg[/img]
The mid-engine endurance racer from Porsche took home gold in 2018 from the FIA World Endurance Championship, with amazing wins at the 6 Hours of Fuji and 24 Hours of Lemans. Now, ittakes on the challenges of the Horizon Festival. 

Propelled by a 3.9-liter flat-six engine that produces 504 bhp and 360 lb-ft of torque, this car has earned 4 Teams’ Championships, 2 Constructors’ Championships, and 5 Drivers’ Championships.  

Become a part of Porsche’s legacy by dominating every race you can find in this iconic piece of endurance racing history. 

[h2]What’s Next.[/h2] 

A wave from the past floods the Horizon Festival. 

Next series will see a new Radio Station come to the Horizon Festival and new EventLab props will be available along with highway decorations. 

Join us when Horizon Retrowave arrives on May 23rd. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2ad1a3efc8316a42438621013582c579b22e1d0f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: GT Racers Rush Through Mexico’s Roads in Apex AllStars
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7d10ccb23c970dfc14ebbef81f3995edb163f4de.png[/img]
The Apex Outpost takes the spotlight with Apex AllStars, the latest update coming to Forza Horizon 5. In Apex AllStars you’ll be able to race in some of the greatest GT cars the Horizon Festival has ever seen as the 5 new reward cars exclusive to the Festival Playlist. 

The highly requested Asphalt Road and elevation Props are finally here! Builders will have the greatest time adding 23 new props to their EventLab creations. 

Blink and you might miss the Apex AllStars Car Pack driving along this update. Collect 7 new cars built for racing across Mexico’s greatest roads. 

A traffic-stopping outfit and the 2024 Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray appear in this update too! 

[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes.[/h2] 

[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes no inputs were registered after quick resuming the game  
[*]General performance and stability fixes  
[*]Fixed an issue with the 2019 Ginetta G10 RM: Vinyls will no longer show the car’s paint[/list] 
[h2]Hit the Road with Your EventLab Creations.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/cf4808ffb7470f9654fbe8ce4d451b2c51e9568a.png[/img]
They are finally here! Apex AllStars introduces new road pieces to add to your creations. 

You will be able to build roadways with the 8 Asphalt Road Props available in this new update.  

All road props come with a road-marked version, to add a bit of urban flare to your creations, and a non-marked version in case you are going with more of a track-oriented idea. 

Your EventLab tracks are getting to the next level, literally, with the elevated road pieces added with this update as well. The 15 Elevated Road Props are available in both road-marked and non-road-marked versions to choose from. 

Both new sets include snapping functionality! 

[h2]Chevrolet’s Thunder Strikes Twice![/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a76929d81a34eb338ff62141e7af6539c3326f5c.jpg[/img]
A hybrid thunder strikes the Horizon Festival once more to join the AllStar team that comes with this update.  

Initially only available as a loyalty reward for players who played Forza Motorsport, the 2024 Chevrolet Corvette E-Ray has returned! Starting April 23, the E-Ray will be permanently available in the Autoshow for 181,000 credits. Additionally, during the Festival Playlist’s fourth week, the fastest hybrid in Chevrolet’s arsenal will also be available as a reward for winning the “Going the Distance” Seasonal Championship. 

[h2]An Icon of The Road Takes the First Position (in Your Wardrobe)[/h2] 

Apex AllStars finally gives us the chance to get in the shoes of a road racing icon with a traffic stopping outfit that arrives as a Festival Playlist reward. 

Complete the Photo Challenge on the second week of the Festival Playlist to unlock the unique Traffic Cone outfit. 

Wear the true style of the streets and share your photos in our official Discord. ([url=https://discord.com/invite/forza]Discord[/url]) 

[h2]The Festival’s Mascot Goes for Gold.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6eeda1e1c7fbf359629a610b8cd38707059a3493.png[/img]
A new collectible celebrates your wins on the Apex Outpost! 

Find the Podium Tank collectible hiding around the Apex Outpost during the third week of Apex AllStars. 

Unlock this new version of the Horizon Festival’s favorite mascot and include it in your EventLab creations! 

[h2]Try the New Editor’s Choice tab.[/h2] 

In the PG Editor’s Choice tab in EventLab was sorted by the number of times a course was played. This meant that new picks would be relegated to the bottom of the list. Now, the PG Editor’s Choice tab is sorted by recency, so the most recent courses chosen by the team will appear first. 

This change will also mean that events will no longer be removed from the list, but rather we’re now able to continually showcase more and more of your creations and bring back some of our favorites. 

Explore our new selection of EventLab creations each week and try the amazing, curated catalogue of our favorite events!           

[h2]Apex AllStars Car Pack.[/h2] 

A collection of the world’s finest GT racers lines up at the starting line.  

Collect 7 new cars supercharged with loads of power and history to tour around the greatest roads México has to offer. Climb to the top of the Apex Outpost with the Apex AllStars Car Pack available from April 23 for 9.99$ / 9.99€ / 7.99 £ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2894270/Forza_Horizon_5_Apex_Allstars_Car_Pack/?curator_clanid=40722422

Not included with the Premium Version or Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass. 

[h3]2018 BMW #1 M Motorsport M8 GTE[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a144fb64b8429fc567f49266384363137910a59d.png[/img]
To make their return to the 24 Hours of Le Mans after six years of absence, BMW created the most efficient engine they have ever created and trapped it to the first M8 car ever made. The result was an endurance powerhouse racer named the 2018 BMW #1 M Motorsport M8 GTE. 

The M8 GTE used a BMW TwinPower Turbo Technology engine restricted to 4 liters by regulations, however this remarkable engine could produce 592 bhp. Over 700 pieces fitted into the engine came from other BMW Motorsport projects. 

This car finished 5th in the 2018-2019 FIA World Endurance Championships and came in second in the 2020 IMSA SportsCar Championship results. 

[h3]2015 Cadillac #3 Cadillac Racing ATS-V.R[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6cbd04dc1445facbb4c15f9281916ef423077a82.png[/img]
Taking the staff from the CTS-V.R Coupe, the 2015 Cadillac #3 Cadillac Racing ATS-V.R rushes in and takes the position as Cadillac's GT3 specialist. 

The ATS-V.R was fitted with a racing version of the LF4 3.6L twin-turbo V6, but what sets it apart from its commercial counterpart are the twin BorgWarner turbochargers, engine management, and intercoolers with larger capacity; those tweaks and upgrades produce 600 bhp  

Completing the fit and finish, the ATS-V.R got a body kit upgrade including new fenders, front bumper, a massive wing, and an under tray. 

[h3]2020 Chevrolet #3 Corvette Racing C8.R[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7881b947aaa71b8c735acae242a20705810554f5.png[/img]
Lined up on the grid as Chevrolet’s latest endurance competitor, the 2020 Chevrolet #3 Corvette Racing C8.R is a former champion who is getting used to sitting on the podium. 

The C8.R (racing version of the traditional mid-engine Corvette) started its path to glory in the 2020 24 Hours of Daytona during which it finished 4th in its class. The C8.R was eager to win the gold and ended up taking the entire championship that year and repeating the next one. 

Built to win, the C8.R comes with a 5.5 -liter V8 engine (mounted in the middle, of course) that produces 500 horsepower- 480 pound-feet of torque. Take this car around Mexico’s and hang more medals around its mirrors 

[h3]2018 Mercedes-AMG GT3[/h3] 

Mercedes-AMG came up with a surprise for those who thought the limit was reached with the AMG GT: the 2018 Mercedes-AMG GT3, a bigger, stronger, and faster car upgraded for racing performance. 

From the sheer looks of its front, you already know this ride is dangerously fast. Its enhanced version of the 6.3-litre naturally aspirated V8 engine that you can find in an SLS AMG 63 shoots up the car from 0-100 kmh in just 3 seconds. 

An engine fitted low for balance and handling, electronic assistance controls for precision, and the appearance of a champion, the Mercedes-AMG GT3 is in it to win it all. 

[h3]2020 Lexus #14 VASSER SULLIVAN RC F GT3[/h3] 

After scoring VASSER SULLIVAN’s and Lexus’ first victory at 12 Hours of Sebring 2024 in which the pilot Jack Hawksworth secured pole position with this car, the 2020 Lexus #14 VASSER SULLIVAN RC F GT3 is still hungry for more wins.  

To secure this and many more trophies, the RC was fitted with a 5.4-liter V8 engine that produces around 500 bhp inside of a lightweight chassis and a body built with carbon fiber. This equation results in a GT3 car that can reach 100 kmh in just 3 seconds. 

[h3]2019 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 488 GTE[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d06491705c36734d6cbdcea1478c63200af74710.png[/img]
Few car makers have as rich of a racing history as Ferrari, the famous winners of multiple endurance racing events come back with a win taking the 24 Hours of Daytona with one of their best machines: the 2019 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 488 GTE. 

The 488 GTE was built with a 3.9-liter V8 twin-turbocharged engine that produced over 600 horsepower and gave the car 538 lb-ft of torque. Its body, made from aluminum and carbon fiber provides a rigid but light structure to ensure every single one of those 600 bhp is put to good use. 

Excelling on grip, speed, pedigree, and so much more, 2019 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 488 GTE is waiting to take home new accolades in the Horizon Festival.  

[h3]2018 Porsche 911 GT3 R[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e8ca20068ac00c6ae551faa14d48120b66ff8c30.png[/img]
The 911 bloodline got a new heir thirsty to get set and go around the track. The 2018 Porsche 911 GT3 R is everything that makes the 911 line so legendary and a little bit more. 

Powered by a new naturally aspirated 4.0-liter straight-six engine reworked to include a new crankshaft, intake manifold, and valvetrain; the GT3 R’s response and torque output is almost unmatched.  

Even though this car only packs 500 bhp, the engine’s response, body panels, aerodynamics, and gearbox make this car accelerate like the greatest competitor’s you have ever seen. 

[h2]What’s Next.[/h2] 

A wave from the past floods the Horizon Festival. 

Next series will see a new Radio Station come to the Horizon Festival and new EventLab props will be available along with highway decorations. 

Join us when Horizon Retrowave arrives on May 23rd.

4.6-liter V-8 engine with an Eaton blower is what makes the venom of the 2003 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra so powerful.

Thanks to its mighty engine, this overhauled Mustang puts out 390 horsepower. The SVT puts all that power to work going from 0-100 kmh in 4.5 seconds and completing a quarter mile in just 12.9. 

To fit his much muscle into its engine, Ford traded its previous aluminum cast engine for an iron cast block and in the same fashion, aluminum replaced heavier metals from the car to allow it to achieve maximum performance. Combining a powerful twin-turbo V-6 engine and an all-electric power train, the 2023 McLaren Artura is a car that goes beyond hyper.

McLaren’s competitor in the hybrid category pushes its engineering to the limit, using the 671-horsepower provided by its electric & gas system to give the Artura a 0-100 time of 2.6 seconds.
