notes.title: Coming to Your Garage in Horizon Race-Off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a322115816927571b2006a4e0faddbd7f68949f4.jpg[/img]
A few examples of the next generation of machines looking to become synonymous with extreme speed and awesome power will be available to unlock on the 4 weeks of Horizon Race-Off's Festival Playlist. 

[h3]2023 McLaren Artura[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e1ceec43842766fb30a4320f294d60d52813adf9.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the Horizon Race-Off Festival Playlist. Available from March 28 until April 4. [/i] 

McLaren’s newest line of hybrid vehicles has its sights set on the Horizon Festival, and it’s ready to race. 

Putting together the loud and proud power of a twin-turbo V-6 and a silent but deadly electric power train, this car makes a combined bhp of 671 horsepower. Sitting in the highest level of performance, the Artura has a 0 – 100 kmh time of 2.6 seconds. 

To make the best use of the combined gas and electric systems, the new Artura was built using the brand-new Carbon Lightweight Architecture on its body as well as fitting air vents and the signature McLaren scissor doors. 

Experience the feeling of mad power that only a car maker with McLaren’s pedigree could imprint into a hybrid with the 2023 McLaren Artura. 

[h3]2020 Audi TT RS Coupe[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/371cfc2fed9b5f8267bdcd671a92b6677c8bb27a.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the Horizon Race-Off Festival Playlist. Available from April 4 until April 11. [/i] 

The 2020 Audi TT RS Coupe isn’t only the fired-up version of Audi’s small showpiece, it is also a joy to drive and ride into. 

The bubbly design we know, and love comes revamped and ready to roll with a turbocharged 2.5-liter five-cylinder engine that produces the very fun-inducing amount of 394 bhp. Paired with a fantastic seven-speed gearbox and the famous AWD Audi is known for, this car provides a heck of a time behind the wheel.  

This car’s excellent power transfer and marvelous grip will surely become your greatest allies when clearing the races featured on the Race-Off this series! 

[h3]2003 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1befa03a3269d31a21568e2489d78dd5052b9a99.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the Horizon Race-Off Festival Playlist. Available from April 11 until April 18.[/i] 

One of humankind’s most terrifying mythological creatures is coming soon to the Horizon Festival: A Mustang with the venomous fangs of a Cobra.  

The 2003 Ford Mustang SVT Cobra is a supercharged monster of a car; it has been fitted with a 4.6-liter V-8 engine that puts 390 horsepower that includes an Eaton blower to give it the bump in power the Cobra needed to outperform its 2001 sibling.  

Strategic changes to the Cobra’s build were made to enhance its performance. To handle its brutal power, the SVT had to replace its aluminum cast engine with an iron cast one to improve durability. On the other hand, aluminum replaced heavier metals to reduce its acceleration times that clock in with a 0 – 100 kmh of 4.5 seconds and a quarter-mile time of 12.9 seconds. 

With an exterior built to let in cool air from almost anywhere and that invites you to do some serious racing, the SVT Cobra is an accelerating experience you cannot miss.  

[h3]2020 Jaguar F-TYPE SVR[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/25c96356a703015182dbbabff5a0c15e3ff9fa5c.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 “Spring” Season on the Horizon Race-Off Festival Playlist. Available from April 18 until April 25. [/i] 

We encounter yet another specimen of the asphalt’s top cat, the 2020 Jaguar F-Type SVR. This particular feline shows off exquisite coating with its modern, aggressive lines, hood vents, and impressive aerodynamics. 

However, the most prominent characteristic of this wild animal comes from its roar. Produced by a purring 5.0-liter supercharged V8, the F-Type SVR can easily intimidate prey and mark its territory on the track.  

When on the hunt, this car puts its 575 bhp and marvelous AWD system to work, spitting out a 0-100 kmh time of 6.4 seconds. Coupled with a supreme grip and driving experience, and you we find ourselves in front of quite a predator for the Horizon Festival.  

[h2]What’s next?[/h2] 

Apex All-Stars are approaching Forza Horizon 5! 

This next series will feature new sets of EventLab props, an all-new collectible item, and new reward cars to add to your garage will be available to unlock on the Festival Playlist! 

See you on our next series, Apex All-Stars.

notes.title: Race Towards the Finish Line in Horizon Race-Off!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/772d5f9c161dda8599714ff59ef77a4fab38f471.png[/img]
A new timed event has arrived at the Horizon Festival. This time, the entire Forza Horizon 5 community will race together to unlock rewards in every player’s garage.  

The Horizon Festival will also receive a new moving outpost for you to locate in Free Roam. 

18 new props will become available for your EventLab creations including the latest collectible to join Forza Horizon 5’s gallery of smashable items.  

Aside from the cars unlocked by completing the Race-Off goals, 4 exclusive Festival Playlist rewards will be available to obtain as well. 

The race is on in Horizon Race-Off! 

[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes.[/h2] 

The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update. 

[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue with EventLab where “Disable Standard Scoring” rule was not working 
[*]Fixed an issue with EventLab where Players made events were automatically set to 5 minutes when launched from the shared events menu[/list][url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here.[/url] The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 

[h2]3, 2, 1...and the Horizon Race-Off is on![/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8834843f46ddaa5c7495be614d734e65e117c79b.png[/img]
Horizon Race-Off pitches two new community-wide goals for our players to complete, one for Asphalt Racing and one for Off-Road. After each goal has been met every player will receive a reward in their Message Center. 

Add points to the Asphalt Racing goal by completing events in the following categories: 
[list] 

[*]Mexico 
[list] 
[*]Drag Racing 
[*]Road Racing 
[*]Street Racing 
[*]Midnight Battles[/list] 
[*]Hot Wheels
[list]
[*]Speed Racing[/list] 
[*]Rally Adventure 
[list] 
[*]Apex Predators Races[/list][/list]When the Asphalt Racing goal has been completed, every player will unlock the 2024 Ford Mustang GT. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fd46b0f3bcb94ab6b22220c96328f894e7193653.jpg[/img]
[i]Unlock the 2024 Ford Mustang GT completing the Asphalt Racing goal.[/i]

You will be able to contribute to the Off-Roading goal by clearing these types of events: 

[list] 
[*]Mexico 
[list] 
[*]Dirt Racing 
[*]Cross Country Racing[/list] 
[*]Hot Wheels 
[list] 
[*]Hazard Racing[/list] 
[*]Rally Adventure 
[list] 
[*]Grit Reapers Races 
[*]Horizon Raptors Races[/list][/list]Once enough points have been gathered for the Off-Roading goal, the entire community will receive the 2023 Ford F-150 Raptor R. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4fc181c0e0541a33c6201d113d0abe29f98bd840.jpg[/img]
[i]Complete the Off-Road challenge to unlock the 2023 Ford F-150 Raptor R for every player.[/i]

Please bear in mind that Rivals, Mothly Rivals/Forza EV, Showcases, Horizon Stories, Expeditions, or EventLab events will not count towards the contribution of either goal.  

The entire Horizon Festival teams up to beat the goals and unlock rewards for every member in the community! 

Don’t forget to check each goal’s progress and look at your Message Center when they are cleared. 

[h2]Wear Your Team and Go for the Win![/h2] 

We couldn’t let the opportunity to let you show off your favorite team in style, so as early as March 28, you will receive the Horizon Race-Off outfits via in-game message as soon as the season switches. 

Hit the tarmac and feel the blue racing in the Asphalt Racers race suit. 

Get ready to get dirty with the Off-Road racers race suit. 

Both outfits will be available to redeem during the four weeks of Horizon Race-Off. Get yours and represent your team’s colors.  

[h2]An Adventuring Outpost Arrives.[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/68d651238ff687e01ed1bf15fc28d12d4644de11.png[/img]
Horizon Race-Off will feature a new, unique Outpost in this series. 

The Horizon Race-Off Outposts will be decorated with the distinctive colors and logos of each racing division featured in the same name; the blue is for Asphalt while the orange represents Off-Roading. 

What sets these Outposts apart from others found at the Horizon Festival is that these new ones will change locations on each week of the series. 

Once inside the Race-Off Outposts, you’ll be able to check up on the progress of the Asphalt and Off-Road challenges.  

Chase after this moving Outpost and share where you found it with the community! 

[h2]Piñatas for All, No Matter Your Team[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6c78ab1300a9b5414e6b39152d201d8ab66fe2c3.png[/img]
After you are done chasing and finding the moving Outpost featured in this series, the Horizon Festival will also get two new collectible items to search for.  

On week 2, find and collect the Offroad Helmet Pinata Collectible. Look for it in Playa Azul’s sands 

An Asphalt Helmet Pinata will also be available to collect, this one will be available during week 3. Start going round Ópalo de Fuego to find it! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/61216d153c59eb03efe1fb1f0ebed195051b0231.png[/img]
[h2]Racefy Your EventLab Creations[/h2] 

Creators will also be able to get their share of the Race-Off with the brand-new EventLab props added to the game in this series. 

Support team Asphalt, Off-Road or both using the themed flags, billboards, and other decorations featuring the colors and branding for each team.  

Furthermore, you will be able to include both Piñata Helmets scattered throughout the Festival to your EventLab races and events. 

The complete list of new props features:  
[list] 
[*][b]8 Signs & Flags[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Asphalt Billboard 
[*]Off-Road BillBoard 
[*]Asphalt Flags 
[list] 
[*]White 
[*]Blue 
[*]Dark Blue[/list] 
[*]Off-Road Flags 
[list] 
[*]White 
[*]Orange 
[*]Dark Orange[/list][/list] 
[*][b]2 Gameplay[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Asphalt Helmet Piñata 
[*]Off-Road Helmet Piñata[/list] 
[*][b]6 Festival[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Horizon Race-Off Display 
[*]Horizon Race-Off Entrance 
[*]Asphalt Entrance 
[*]Off-Road Entrance 
[*]Asphalt Festival Tower 
[*]Off-Road Festival Tower[/list] 
[*][b]2 Walls & Fences[/b] 
[list] 
[*]Asphalt Barrier 
[*]Off-Road Barrer[/list][/list]Both barriers include Snap Functionality! 

[h2]Acceleration Car Pack[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2a24b0c912cc42a88cf9d5b6e67b480c6751c755.png[/img]
Get four new rides to conquer the many races featured in Horizon Race-Off. 

The Acceleration Car Pack features four limited-build cars created to achieve the highest speed possible in the shortest amount of time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2868420/Forza_Horizon_5_Acceleration_Car_Pack/?curator_clanid=40722422

One classic drag-race titan and three modern super-fast racers are available for purchase starting March 26 for 4.99$ / 4.99€ / 3.99 £ on the Acceleration Car Pack!*

[i]*This Car Pack is not included in the Premium Version or in the Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass[/i] 

[h3]2021 McLaren Sabre[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/be4ea98a4a450eb2a62307a9440b4d0d77cc506c.png[/img]
What goes beyond a hypercar? We believe the answer to that question is “2021 McLaren Sabre”. Only 15 units of the Sabre will ever be produced, and each one will arrive at their owner’s garage with a unique livery. However, styling isn’t what makes this car shatter our hypercar parameters.  

The Sabre comes equipped with a twin turbocharged V8 engine that puts out 824 HP and can produce close to 800 Nm of torque. Put this engine into action to achieve this car’s top speed of 350 kmh, making it the fastest non-hybrid McLaren ever made. 

Of course, no hypercar is complete without a supreme exterior design. The Sabre takes some inspiration from previous McLaren designs (mainly the Senna) and adds a few upgrades that give the car the insurmountable aerodynamics it needs to make the best out of such a magnificent engine.  

[h3]2019 Ginetta G10 RM[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fdbce27b41f6ac44b9dea2bfecde6df1907ba488.png[/img]
The closest Forza Horizon 5 will get to time traveling is taking a ride in the 2019 Ginetta G10 RM. Just in case you were wondering, the RM stands for “remastered”, meaning this high-speed classman is a new take on the already amazing original G10. 

Built to put the modern touch into Ginetta’s already extraordinary racing pedigree, the RM brings the finest contrasts between vintage and modern. For starters, the finishes on the inside of the car are made from wood and leather, the entire car is built by hand; while its glorious 6.2-liter V8 comes from the brand’s most recent prototypes.  

Get a sense of what it feels like to travel to the past with the latest technology and atention to detail in the 2019 Ginetta G10 RM. 

[h3]2022 Ford Supervan 4[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/95023d68eb7508f64726b681914545e366b40146.png[/img]
A Ford utility vehicle fitted with a 2,000 hp producing electric train? Sounds like a superhero hiding behind the outfit of a reporter.  

It might not be faster than a speeding bullet, but the 2022 Ford Supervan 4 power train can still cover massive amounts of distance in a very limited time, Four electric motors fitted underneath a built-for-the-track body make the most out of the 50 kW producing battery included in the Supervan give this van the power to sprint from 0-100 kmh in just under 2 seconds.  

Rather than holding a symbol of hope on its front, the “S” in Supervan represents Speed.  

[h3]1967 Shelby GT 500[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a6e9b865fd99ec490febf69e7e4c62fabdffff91.png[/img]
Driving off a huge victory at Le Mans, Ford took a bunch of the lessons they learnt and applied them to a performance-focused version of their next powerhouse, the 1967 Shelby GT500. 

Powering Carrol Shelby’s latest creation was a 7.0-liter V8 engine called the Cobra Le Mans, a for-the-road version of the already great 427 cu- in. Engine made by Ford. It came with 355 bhp and a rumble that very few cars of the era could match. The GT500 could run a quarter mile in 15 seconds and go from 0 – 100 kmh in just 6.5 seconds. 

The exterior of this car matched its speed and loudness, precisely what you need to stand apart from other Mustang models. Its new fiber glass front and back, as well as headlights, and characteristic grill made this car a street racer with a very sportive, modern look. 

A classic muscle car ready to take on the challenge offered by its more modern counterparts will hit the Horizon Festival on the Acceleration Car Pack. 

[h2]What’s next?[/h2] 

Apex All-Stars are approaching Forza Horizon 5! 

This next series will feature new sets of EventLab props, an all-new collectible item, and new reward cars to add to your garage will be available to unlock on the Festival Playlist! 

See you on our next series, Apex All-Stars.

Another charisma king makes its way to the Horizon Festival; this time it’s a familiar face with a very different back.

The 1966 Volkswagen Double Cab Pick-up is a utility vehicle like no other; to put it simply, the people at VW had a remarkable idea: to cut the back of the VW Type-2 and create one of the most adorable and versatile cars out there. As time went on, the DoKa (as it was later referred to) became a collector’s item.

Different versions of this car saw the light of day, but our favorites will always be the ones you tune and adapt to take on the Different challenges and races featured at the Horizon Festival by unlocking it completing Lotus Leaf Seasonal Championship from March 21 until March 28!

If you have encountered any issue with this update, please make sure to report it on our [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. You will find other known issues we are currently investigating as well.

notes.title: Forza Community Hubs Update #3 – Let’s Talk Cars, Tracks, and Features
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/84a0aea650ad6cfde0bd5b83ae194bd2db8ed891.jpg[/img]
Over the past few months, for both Forza Motorsport and Forza Horizon 5, we’ve been fully focused on developing new content and fixes based on your reports. Today we wanted to reflect on some of the additions to both games over the past half-year and celebrate those inspired directly by your posts on the [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url] and [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url].

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-community-update-2]In our previous blog last July, we had 239,000 votes cast[/url]. Today more than 470,000 votes have been counted across both Forza Motorsport and Forza Horizon topics. That number breaks down into 450,500 votes on the Suggestions Hub and 19,500 votes on the Troubleshooting Hub. Thank you for participating in these topics – your feedback is invaluable and helps make Forza games better for everyone.

[h2]Car Voting[/h2]

Cars are the most popular forum in the Suggestions Hub! One primary reason for this is because there are so many cars to vote on – after all, we all have our favorite cars that we would love to see in Forza someday. Out of the 14,800 topics on the Suggestions Hub today, over 9,500 of those available to vote on are car model topics. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2b0573eaa41cf0a52ce8fde69d5c9b807c017fd6.png[/img]
Here’s a look at some of the most notable vehicles we’ve introduced in Forza Horizon 5 recently:
[list]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/557647]2012 Nissan Tsuru[/url] was the most upvoted topic in Community Hubs history with 4,086 votes before it was added to Forza Horizon 5 in October 2023 with the Dia de Muertos series update.  
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/557860]2023 Aston Martin Valkyrie[/url] was the 16th most requested with 826 votes when it was gifted to all players as part of the Secret Santa event in December 2023.
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/gordon-murray-t-50-2022/559299]2022 Gordon Murray T.50[/url] was a top 50 requested car with 451 votes when it was gifted to all players as part of the Secret Santa event last December.  
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/557747]2017 Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio[/url] reached 761 votes when it was added in August 2023 with the Italian Automotive series update.[/list]There are 15 Forza Horizon Car Voting topics with over 1000 votes each. These include some of the newest and fastest cars on the market today, as well as 1990s JDM cars, hot hatches, and cars seen in previous Forza games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a99f0559af44be037f0c364ee13a74c205ed095c.jpg[/img]
Always keep in mind that highly voted cars on the Suggestions Hub aren’t guaranteed to be added in future updates. Community input is just one aspect we consider when introducing new cars or features to Forza games. There are many steps required to introduce a new or returning car to Forza, from licensing agreements and sourcing of a pristine model to 3D scanning and modelling work – all necessary steps before integrating a vehicle into the game.

Forza Horizon 5 has reached a total of 823 cars over 129 manufacturers and counting. Manufacturers like Rivian, Automobili Pininfarina, Elemental, Czinger, Lucid Air, and Gordon Murray Automotive all debuted in Forza from September through December. Forza Horizon 5 has the most makes of any Forza game in history with the largest roster of production and racing spec models.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b37ea4f09e6635fb7f3a678f005a3b62b23f7434.jpg[/img]
Forza Motorsport also recently added the Aston Martin Valkyrie (and AMR Pro) and Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio, however Motorsport players are showing a strong interest in racing-spec models. Forza Motorsport responded to community requests for a focus on racing with 50 new racing models released across Showroom, Race Day Car Pack and Car Pass, including the following cars:
[list]
[*]Vintage to modern prototypes like the 1970 Porsche #3 917 LH, 1983 Porsche #11 John Fitzpatrick Racing 956, 1999 Nissan #23 NISMO Clarion R391, and 2023 Cadillac #01 Cadillac Racing V-Series.R.
[*]Touring cars like the 2020 Hyundai #98 Bryan Herta Autosport Veloster N.
[*]Factory race cars like the 2019 McLaren Senna GTR.
[*]Trans-Am series cars like the 2018 Chevrolet #23 Ruman Racing TA Corvette.
[*]GT3 cars like the 2019 McLaren #03 720S GT3 and 2018 Mercedes-AMG GT3.
[*]And finally, the [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/ferrari-488-gte/571518]2019 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 488 GTE[/url] was added as a top 30 requested car with 143 votes in January 2024 with Update 4.[/list]Forza Motorsport also debuted manufacturers BRM, Ginetta, and Oreca, as well as new-to-Motorsport Gordon Murray Automotive.

[h2]Track Voting[/h2]

On the topic of Forza Motorsport, let’s talk tracks! We've added four tracks since the launch of the game, starting with Yas Marina in November 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f33d8a79640a4a6e776bc6ba9831a320b8178fb7.jpg[/img]
We knew the Nürburgring-Nordschleife was a top community request and took the time to make it look great. Initially announced for Spring 2024, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-5]it was released in February 2024 with Update 5[/url].

[url=https://forums.forza.net/t/daytona-international-speedway/551070]Daytona International Speedway[/url] was the 7th most requested track when it was released in January 2024, with 572 votes. Following the addition of Daytona, players requested a revision to the [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/correct-daytona-road-course-pit-exit/663256]pitlane exit[/url], quickly making that the number one topic in the Environment category with 241 votes; [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-6]we included that change in Update 6 this month[/url]. Meanwhile, [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/hockenheimring/551049]Hockenheimring[/url] was ranked 11th with 448 votes when it was added to the game in December 2023.

The current top requested track is the iconic [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/interlagos-jose-carlos-pace/551040]Interlagos Circuit (Jose Carlos Pace)[/url] in Brazil, with over 1,750 votes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1e3018e985aa7f265851c26d0cfc925a2af4e33a.jpg[/img]
As a reminder, community voting is one element considered when a track location receives the green light for Forza Motorsport, and like cars, there are several steps required before it can be considered final and introduced to the game. Track development milestones include licensing approval, laser scanning and photogrammetry, environment art and 3D asset creation, as well as the integration of track limits, AI driving lines and other gameplay features.

[h2]Horizon Features[/h2]

With all the cars introduced to Forza Horizon 5 over the past few years, players naturally wanted more storage space for their vehicles and UGC creations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/dc4bce06e67c5f45b74b4f92ae8314920ee0f44c.jpg[/img]
[url=https://forums.forza.net/t/increase-file-limit-500-limit-for-a-game-that-launched-with-500-cars-fh5/553394/163]Italian Automotive increased tuning and livery save slots to 1,000 each[/url]. With 451 votes, this one was a top 5 feature request for Forza Horizon 5. We also increased garage space to 2,000 cars, [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/increasing-car-limit-up-from-1000-fh5/569715/66]an important quality-of-life update which had 204 votes[/url] on the Suggestions Hub. 

The European Automotive Series update in February 2024 [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/lower-classes-rivals-for-rally-expansion/591949/33]added the full list of classes to Rally Adventure Rivals[/url]. This was the 7th most requested Forza Horizon 5 feature, with 98 votes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1b89ce952342f09a79d517593aaba931e59dabb3.png[/img]
Top Forza Horizon 5 feature requests are typically focused on car customization; in the American Automotive series released in November 2023, we added 3 Forza Bodykits to the 1987 Pontiac Firebird Trans AM GTA, 2016 Shelby GT350R and 2017 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1. This was accompanied by 27 new rim styles from aftermarket wheels brand HRE.

We see you asking for additional building types in Horizon Mexico, and Partnerships with popular convenience store brands. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-creatives]With the addition of EventLab 2.0 features in the Horizon Creatives series[/url], players now have a petrol station prop and the ability to use prefabs from other players to create unlimited immersive landscape features and events.

[h2]Motorsport Features[/h2]

One of the top 20 feature requests we saw at the launch of Forza Motorsport was [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/98768]FOV (field-of-view) positioning[/url], with 146 votes. We continue to see voting for seat position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/06bbf87b10474fa852c62e8380465def4754d914.jpg[/img]
Following the launch of the game, we saw multiple topics [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/606264]suggesting changes to Car Progression[/url], with one of them reaching the #2 most requested spot. We believe the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-6]changes to Car Progression in Update 6 [/url]satisfy most of these requests.

Currently the most requested Forza Motorsport feature is [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/-/567743]Proximity Radar at 448 votes[/url] in place of the arrows currently available in the HUD, for awareness of other cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c4823fb4960cdd128a2ba9596e50e6b3c761ec7e.jpg[/img]
We're continuing to work on improving Forza Race Regulations and Drivatar AI behavior to help address issues around contact with other cars, and more of the things you care about.

[h2]Troubleshooting Hub[/h2]

Each content update released for both Forza Motorsport and Forza Horizon 5 introduce new fixes to improve overall game stability alongside experience improvements that make your gameplay better. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/51bc22c4e203c827c37136054ad2bf67185b38c6.jpg[/img]
At launch, Forza Motorsport players experienced an issue with the [url=https://forums.forza.net/t/stability-game-may-hang-on-applying-upgrades-and-does-not-save-career-mode-progress-1608827/626409]game freezing after applying car upgrades[/url]. This topic was the top voted topic in Troubleshooting Hub history with 657 votes before [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/22126464984851-Forza-Motorsport-Update-1-1-Release-Notes-October-24-2023]Update 1.1 fixed the issue[/url]. 

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-5]Update 5 introduced the ability to save Short Race replays[/url]. Work to improve replay save length is ongoing. Currently when racing against a full grid, short races should save most replays, while medium races will not save full replays but will save up to 11 minutes. This update also introduced PC-specific optimizations to improve framerate consistency and added the option to Skip Practice in the Career mode pre-race menu with save points for already completed practice sessions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/903f6b3429b1ed60311ff74aec2f9dbd9d3bee22.jpg[/img]
We review issues posted by players in the Troubleshooting Hub regularly and deploy fixes based on these reports with each update. [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/27283008634515-Forza-Motorsport-Update-6-0-Release-Notes-March-11-2024]Check out the Forza Motorsport Update 6 release notes[/url] which includes fixes and improvements for the Livery Editor and AI.

Most recently [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/27465562988691-Forza-Motorsport-Hotfix-6-1-Release-Notes-March-18-2024]we deployed Hotfix 6.1 to address HDR flickering[/url] for PC and Xbox console players under certain framerate conditions and decrease the sensitivity for Livery Editor decal movements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/edcd95dc164a676aa943c6ba6fefe42a0b88ed5f.png[/img]
We’ve crossed the finish line of this Forza Community Hubs Feedback Update! We will continue to track all your Suggestions Hub ideas and Troubleshooting Hub reports, so please keep them coming. Be sure to upvote any issues that you are also encountering in our games, and cast your votes on the cars, tracks and features you would like to see us include in the future.

notes.title: Coming to Your Garage in European Automotive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/403359d8689df4685dfeca4e40e329c683fa8290.jpg[/img]
From the days of yore to modern wonders, this series’ Festival Playlist brings 8 samples of the best vehicles Europe has ever produced. Whether you’re looking for electric, sports, or utility, there are two unlockable cars available every week to fit your mood. 

Unlock these exclusive cars by earning Festival Playlist points and by completing exciting events featured on the four weeks of the Festival Playlist. 

[h3]2022 Aston Martin Valkyrie AMR Pro[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4743f6dfef3b0d0c87ed15c8b1af6109789e2f76.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the European Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from February 29 until March 7. [/i] 

From the land of the ice and snow, a creature of legend storms the Horizon Festival.  

The 2022 Aston Martin Valkyrie AMR Pro wields a gobsmacking hybrid 6.5-liter V-12 engine that puts out 1,000 horsepower, 400 more than the version designed to run Le Mans.  

Its exterior design goes completely against what’s expected from an Aston Martin, instead of being the reserved car driven by secret agents, the Valkyrie’s outdoors is an expression of the same lunacy that’s kept under its bonnet.  

Drive into the Valhalla in this mostly extravagant chariot unlocking the Valkyrie AMR Pro on the first week of the Festival Playlist. 

[h3]1968 Lancia Fulvia Coupé Rallye 1.6 HF[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1b89ce952342f09a79d517593aaba931e59dabb3.png[/img]
[i]Complete “Lucky Lancia” Seasonal Championship Event during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the European Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from February 29 until March 7. [/i] 

From the same car makers that won every single rally Italian Rally Championship from 1965 until 1973, another off-roading racing legend arrives: the 1968 Lancia Fulvia Coupé Rallye 1.6 HF. 

Famous for doing crazy innovations with their cars, Lancia fit the Fulvia with the V4 engine that produced 114 bhp that propelled Sandro Munari and Mario Mannucci to take their own edition of the Monte Carlo rally in 1972. 

Not only is this car a remarkable off-roader, but it is also a piece of moving history and Italian racing legacy. 

[h3]2021 Volkswagen ID.4[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/373058c93dc5f9fe1931a1c60183aebe79c262cd.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the European Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from March 7 until March 14. [/i] 

One of the first cars to enter Volkswagen’s EV lineup comes in as a practical and powerful SUV.  

The 2021 Volkswagen ID.4 is a comfortable electric vehicle that doesn’t shy away from the acceleration we are used to seeing in electrically powered cars. The all-wheel drive system included in this SUV along with its 295 hp engine allows it to float from 0 – 100 in 5.4 seconds.  

As per usual, one of the best parts of featuring an SUV (electric or not) as a reward car is seeing what type of vehicle you can create with its tuning options. Take advantage of its amazing acceleration or go from the ground up to create the best off-roading EV in your garage. 

[h3]1975 Citroën DS 23[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/54372ac11771c8cb8c4d00e28ab70730007efa62.png[/img]
[i]Complete “Cult Legends” Seasonal Championship Event during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the European Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from March 7 until March 14. [/i] 

Ooh-la-la, a magnifique example of wonderful French engineering is available to unlock in the 1975 Citroen DS 23.  

One of the most prominent features that makes this car special is its central hydraulic system which makes the DS 23 ride like no other vehicle. This car doesn’t have springs as suspension, instead it uses an intricate system of fluid and gas stored in a sphere that moves around when cornering absorbing shock like an active suspension would. 

Being one of the fashion capitals of the world, France could not let one of its greatest cars go out without looking très chic. The almost futuristic outside design coupled with the aerodynamic lines encapsulated the groundbreaking ideas stored in its mechanical work. 

It was named DS after the French word for goddess, and yes, we can still see the divinity in it after 40 years. 

[h3]2021 Mercedes-AMG SL 63[/h3] 

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the European Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from March 14 until March 21. [/i] 

Great news, everyone: Mercedes has decided to transform their classic convertible into a piece of performance to rock you like a hurricane. Replacing the GT Roadster, the 2021 Mercedes-AMG SL63 is hitting the Horizon Festival to rock you like a hurricane. 

 As with the very best creations to come out of Germany, attention to detail is of the outmost relevance. Everything from the selection of materials to the decision to use a fabric top to save weight makes the car as light as possible, and as fast as you want it to be. Under the hood, the SL 63 proudly wears a 4.0-liter V8 twin-turbo engine that reaches 100 kmh from nothing in a mere 3.6 seconds. 

Then, there’s the looks. As beautiful as you want a convertible Mercedes-AMG car to be as well as details that pay homage to the car maker’s legacy such as the front grill.  

Discover the sensational feelings an AMG can put in your hands with the SL63 

[h3]2002 Lotus Esprit V8[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7162cf9bb257d9779eea13822ffd401e7be468bf.png[/img]
[i]Complete “Lotus Leaf” Seasonal Championship Event during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the European Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from March 14 until March 21. [/i] 

Another hero from the Union Jack headlines the Festival Playlist. Made an icon due to its popping headlights and mighty 3.5-liter V8 engine, the 2002 Lotus Esprit V8 is no stranger to racing and adventuring in difficult terrain. 

A hidden highlight featured in this car is its steering. This RWD handles nimbly and agilely through corners allowing you to make quick work of tight turns without needing any computer system to aid you in those endeavors. 

Experience the final version of an English classic unlocking the Esprit V8 on European Automotive’s Festival Playlist. 

[h3]1992 Mercedes-Benz 500 E [/h3] 

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 “Spring” Season on the European Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from March 21 until March 28. [/i] 

Make no mistake, what you are looking at is a proper racer hidden underneath the looks of a regular sedan.  

Back when this car was built, it was designed to have the lowest drag coefficients of the time. The same attention to detail can be found in things as small as the differently sized mirrors and as large as its recently tuned 5.0-liter V8 engine. 

Sturdy is one way to describe this car, as its heavy doors and built are almost guaranteed to never rattle if the 500 E can move. However, despite weighing approximately two tons, the massive V8 fitted in this car allowed it to nimbly shift from 0-100 kmh in about 5.5 seconds.  

Rediscover a car almost forgotten by time and build your own luxury racer with the Mercedes-Benz 500 E 

[h3]1966 Volkswagen Double Cab Pick-up[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c6b18676e04dd0bfbb16ff2c000ecfbab4cc9a56.png[/img]
[i]Complete “V Double You” Seasonal Championship Event during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the European Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from March 21 until March 28. [/i] 

Who would have thought that cutting the back part of a VW Type 2 could only make it better. The clever folks at Volkswagen did and that new utility vehicle was named the 1966 Volkswagen Double Cab Pick-up.  

Originally built to provide a comfortable family drive, the Type was transformed to fit different uses, among them one that is very dear to America: a pickup truck. Creating a flat space for cargo in the back while fitting a double cabin, the VW DoKa (as it came to be known) became a collector’s item as time went on. 

Collect and build your own version of an already unique pickup and take it to every podium available at the Horizon Festival. 

[h2]What’s Next[/h2] 

Wait for the light to turn green and floor the accelerator! The Horizon Festival is off to the races with Horizon Race-Off, the next update coming to Forza Horizon 5 

Get ready, set, and go for Horizon Race-Off!

notes.title: The Horizon Festival Takes a EuroTrip in European Automotive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2b0573eaa41cf0a52ce8fde69d5c9b807c017fd6.png[/img]
The Horizon Festival sets off on a Euro trip to celebrate Europe’s car-making legacy in European Automotive. Celebrate the European legacy with eight cars coming to your garage as Festival Playlist exclusive rewards; earn PTS and complete different challenges to unlock different icons from Europe. 

Complete your collection of European strikers with the European Automotive Car Pack available from February 27. This new Car Pack includes celebrated racers and comfortable cruisers from Germany, England, and Italy.  

Plus, new props are added to EventLab featuring ancestral creatures, different types of land, and a wide assortment of shapes to include into your creations. 

We are heading for the Motherland on the new update for Forza Horizon 5! 

[h2]Release notes & Game Fixes[/h2] 

The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update. 
[list] 
[*]Fixed an issue with the 1993 Nissan Skyline GTR and the 1995 Nissan GTR LM in which artifacts were visible when using Ray Tracing 
[*]It is now possible to remove the wing from the 2022 Porsche Cayman 718 GT4 RS 
[*]Fixed texture issues on the doors of the 2008 Aston Martin DBS 
[*]Fixed the cosmetic issues with the Hyundai Kona Forza Aero’s front bumper[/list]

[h2]Giants Walk the Earth Again with New EventLab Props[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fbb569beae067f9866ae520d8d2dd8a0ac01e82d.png[/img]

First, 5 platforms of different terrains will be added to incorporate into your events and game modes. Choose between the different ice, grass, asphalt, dirt, and snow structures to give your events texture and depth.  

We are adding 40 new shapes all with snapping functionality. You will now be able to add 4 new cubes, cones, pyramids, wedges, and more in both plastic and concrete versions. Every plastic version of these shapes comes in 8 different colors as well. 

Did you hear that rumble? The final addition for EventLab in this series is the dinosaur props. Add 6 different scaly giants to your events and create unique game modes featuring prehistoric reptiles. Your creativity is the limit to find the best use for these new titanic props!

[h2]Set Your Best Times in Rally Adventure![/h2] 

Sierra Nueva welcomes all racers looking for an off-roading challenge! 

European Automotive makes all classes (D, C, B, A, S1, S2, X) available to set lap times on every route on Forza Horizon 5’s second expansion Rally Adventure. 

Put your favorite rally vehicles to the test or see how good your tune ups turned out on the different stages of Sierra Nueva. 

[h2]European Automotive Car Pack[/h2] 

Celebrate Europe’s automotive legacy with a new car pack featuring four cars from some of the greatest car manufacturers Europe has gifted to the world. 

This new Car Pack contains four high-speed cruisers eager to take on the fastest courses and roads the Horizon Festival can put beneath their wheels. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2814020/Forza_Horizon_5_European_Automotive_Car_Pack/?curator_clanid=40722422

Germany, England, and Italy team up to give you some of their greatest automotive accomplishments on the European Automotive Car Pack available from February 27 for $4.99 USD/4.99€ /3.99 £. This Car Pack is not included in the Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass or in the Premium Edition. 

[h3]2021 Bentley Continental GT Convertible[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8051cb1a141eaf592e14b4a8a160359212a5c4ca.png[/img]
One of Grand Touring’s biggest icons has arrived. The power, style, and luxury of the 2021 Bentley Continental GT Convertible is here to ramble on at the Horizon Festival. 

Check that heavy metal underneath the hood; the 2021 Conti will get its indomitable power from a W12 engine that produces 626 horsepower that can hit 100 kmh from a standstill in just 3.3 seconds. 

That massive engine could only be covered with superb design. Really built with style, the luxurious heritage of Bentley shows in the door lines and headlights; the perfect way to wrap up the ideal GT ride. 

Feel the Conti’s power running through your hair when you lower this car’s top with the European Automotive Car Pack. 

[h3]1987 Mercedes-Benz AMG Hammer Wagon[/h3] 

A one-of-a-kind powerhouse, a family wagon turned into racer, a suburban king of the raceway; there are plenty of ways to describe the 1987 Mercedes-Benz AMG Hammer Wagon, but our favorite one is unique. 

This car started its lifetime as a regular wagon to drive around on Sundays with your family, until it got into the hands of AMG North America. It was then fitted with a 6-liter Mercedes V-8 and a body kit. This upgrade made the once-made-for-comfort car sprint from 0 – 100 kmh in just 5 seconds, the Hammer can also obliterate a quarter mile in mere 13.5 seconds. 

You know what they say: when in doubt, strike it with a Hammer.  

[h3]2019 Jaguar XE SV Project 8[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6446e6bce10229528fc441a6e23fb909fb11de26.png[/img]
An apex predator of the track, the Jaguar is a magnificent specimen of British automotive prowess. And this particular type of Jaguar, is not afraid to get its claws dirty when looking for a meal. 

In the wild the 2019 Jaguar XE SV Project 8 tends to find its prey racing. When it's ready to pounce, the Project 8 puts its carbon fiber upgrades, aerodynamic remodeling, and supercharged 5.0-liter V8 engine to work, surprising any unsuspecting opponent it finds on the road.  

Unsurprisingly, this big cat’s looks are as striking as its power. A rear wing showing its power, a grill that entices racing, and racing strips that ensure maximum speed.  

Like any other feline of this lineage, taming the Project 8 is near impossible. Do you dare? 

[h3]2020 Automobili Pininfarina Battista[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/6dec7603650e406b96c689024dd60ed9f6a87e3a.png[/img]
Zero emissions and unbelievable power come together to create the Automobili Pininfarina Battista – the fastest GT car to ever come out of Italy.  

Four electric motors send power to each wheel producing a combined total of 1900 bhp, a number that will stay in your mind until you experience it firsthand. Same with its 350 km/h top speed. The Battista can accelerate from 0 – 100 km/h in 1.89 seconds, quicker than you will be able to mutter arrivederci as it flies past you.  

Tradition in design and trend setting technology come together in the latest electric warrior joining the Horizon Festival, the 2020 Automobili Pininfarina Battista 

[h2]What’s Next[/h2] 

Wait for the light to turn green and floor the accelerator! The Horizon Festival is off to the races with Horizon Race-Off, the next update coming to Forza Horizon 5 

Get ready, set, and go for Horizon Race-Off!

This unique (and très chic) car had an incredibly special hydraulic system that worked with fluids and gas moving the car’s most important bits. No coils or traditional steering can be seen on the DS 23, only clever design, and innovation.
To match its intelligent design, the French car maker opted to dress the DS 23 on the most fashionable steel it could find. Putting together sporting aerodynamics and a futuristic look, this car is recognizable everywhere at any point in time.

notes.title: Hot lap the Nordschleife in Forza Motorsport Update 5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/3b381f60d7cf9bfd74de19257cb4a21297ac3b67.jpg[/img]
Bring your favorite cars to the Nürburgring and put them to the ultimate Time Attack test – the epic 20.8-kilometer Nordschleife track comes to Forza Motorsport in Update 5, free to all players. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440510/Forza_Motorsport/

[previewyoutube=L-m9gTspoQQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, the Ringer Tour introduces you to the cars that German manufacturers have perfected within their performance-focused divisions. 

[h2]Game Fixes & Release Notes[/h2] 

Forza Motorsport Update 5 is now rolling out for download on Steam with the Nürburgring Nordschleife available today. Spotlight cars and new events across the Career, Featured Multiplayer and Rivals will start from Thursday, February 15 at 12:00 AM UTC. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/dabcdffb5f8db65b28d76eb2aa4d4ce2c783e81b.jpg[/img]
Below you will find a snapshot of the fixes and improvements in Update 5. Head on over to Forza Support to find the full release notes. 
[list] 
[*]Players can now save Short Race replays. When racing against a full grid, Short races should save most replays; Medium races will not save full replays but will save up to 11 minutes. Work to improve replay save length is ongoing. [1655835] 
[*]Players are now presented with the option to Skip Practice in the Career mode pre-race menu. Furthermore, if the player previously completed Practice, the game creates a save point and gives the player additional options when returning to a series for replaying or skipping complete practice. [1635662] 
[*]Fixed an issue in Featured Multiplayer where players could encounter an infinite loading screen when attempting to change their Fuel and Tire setup at Grid Preview. [1611726] 
[*]Players are now prompted to save their livery if they attempt to exit the Livery Editor without saving. [1437864] 
[*]Added custom advanced zoom to the Livery Editor when applying decals to a car. [1621135] 
[*]On PC, we’ve made numerous under-the-hood improvements to reduce CPU spikes and better utilize the GPU, helping to improve framerate consistency while driving. [1536749, 1651623] 
[*]Fixed an issue causing custom wheel input layouts to reset to their default settings after relaunching the game with both a controller and steering wheel connected. [1593360][/list] 

[h2]New Track – Nordschleife[/h2] 

Get ready to tackle the exhilarating challenge of the Nürburgring Nordschleife! This iconic track isn't just about its 12.9-mile length or its daunting twists and turns; it's a testament to racing history.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/f33d8a79640a4a6e776bc6ba9831a320b8178fb7.jpg[/img]
Located in Nürburg, Germany, the Nordschleife is renowned for its challenging and unpredictable nature. Built in the 1920s, the track has over 170 corners, 300 meters of elevation changes and is famous for its long straights and the Karussell, a banked turn that gives the sensation of being in a giant bowl. Its production car lap record is held by the Mercedes-AMG ONE with a time of 6:35.183, with the overall lap record of 5:19.546 held by the Porsche 919 Hybrid Evo. 

Discover what makes this circuit an adrenaline-fueled crucible in Forza Motorsport, one which pushes drivers, manufacturers and cars to their limits. Experience the legendary Nordschleife and the combined GP Full Circuit in Career Mode and Rivals Time Attack or create your own track days in Free Play and Private Multiplayer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/88fe8d5fcca5339a62c3c22a6d56902a0b017c36.jpg[/img]
We can’t wait for you to experience the Nordschleife in Forza Motorsport! Looking ahead, Update 6 coming next month will introduce the changes to car progression we spoke about last week and other improvements based on community feedback, as well as Spotlight cars and events. We also wanted to let you know that Update 6 will not include a track, and our next track release is scheduled for Update 7, expected to be available in April. 

[h2]New Career Tour – Ringer Tour[/h2] 

German engineering is at the heart of the Ringer Tour, the new limited-time Featured Tour available in the Career as part of Update 5.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/ab035d9ed4f9ee9f3a657d9464268901ef294e2c.jpg[/img]
In the Ringer Tour, discover the acclaimed performance divisions of German manufacturers and race some of their most renowned and modern cars in epic showdowns, including the cutting-edge, high-performance machines of BMW M, Audi Sport, Mercedes-AMG and Porsche 911. 
[table]
[tr][th][b]Ringer Tour [/b][/th][th][b]Starts [/b][/th][th][b]Spotlight Car [/b][/th][/tr]

[tr][td]Audi Sport Showdown [/td][td]February 22 [/td][td]2013 Audi RS 7 Sportback [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Mercedes-AMG Showdown [/td][td]February 29 [/td][td]2011 Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Porsche 911 Showdown [/td][td]March 7 [/td][td]2014 Porsche 911 Turbo S [/td][/tr]
[/table]
Similar to previous Featured Tours, Series within the Ringer Tour do not have to be completed in a particular week – you have until March 28, 2024, to finish this latest Featured Tour. Spotlight cars are available at a discount for the week during which they are featured. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/6b4bc795a83f6fd076efbcf1afeee34dd3990a64.jpg[/img]
Complete all 4 series to unlock the 2022 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS – an ideal contender for the Nürburgring Nordschleife. 

[h2]New Open Tour – German Automotive[/h2] 

With each update to Forza Motorsport, the Open Tour gets refreshed with new events and a new reward car. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a138aa3e5ee24887f8a7a0a35a65de8227602de6.jpg[/img]
Open Tour is where you can continue the journey of your favorite cars. Cars that you’ve already built in a different Builders Cup series can be further levelled up and upgraded in the Open Tour. 

In Update 5, the Open Tour is all about German marquees, including manufacturers who have who’ve left their mark on the Nordschleife. Build your favorite cars, no matter their country of origin, and bring them to the track to race Drivatars who will be behind the wheel of some of Germany's finest examples of automotive engineering. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/393468db6b3e3bf181900c055b1194bc4011f8c0.jpg[/img]
All 4 refreshed Open Tour series (C, B, A, S) will be available on February 15. Complete all 4 series before March 14, 2024, to add the 1974 Porsche #1 911 RSR to your collection.

Here’s a look at your Featured Multiplayer calendar of upcoming events for Update 5:

notes.content:

Hyundai the N added at the end of Hyundai’s signature hatchbacks name isn’t just to make it catchier; to earn it, the 2020 Hyundai i30N had to undergo a serious transformation. 

This gassed up version of the i30 comes with a 2.0 - liter, 4-cylinder turbo engine that can reach a top speed of 250 kmh and produce 353 Nm of torque. This numbers add up to a 0-100 kmh speed of 6.1 seconds. 

The i30 performance focused redesign does not disappoint in the looks department, and we are sure it certainly won’t do it in the running department as well. 

Unlock this furious runner for 20 PTs on the third week of the Festival Playlist until February 22.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8a9a23502d03d41d10fd9e5639f1812c100d1c5f.png[/img]
The Hyundai Prophecy was a concept electric car that stirred up enthusiasts all over the planet when it was shown back in 2020. Two years later, its production version became a reality when the 2022 Hyundai IONIQ 6 came to life. 

The IONIQ 6 is an electric saloon built to be equal parts comfortable and powerful. The aerodynamic design put into this car makes it squeeze the most out of its platform allowing the car to go from 0 – 100 kmh in just 5.1 seconds.

Ready to hit the Horizon Festival, this futuristic looking EV becomes available to unlock from January 8 until February 29.

notes.title: Good Fortune and Good Adventuring Arrive During Lunar New Year!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7e3d1263b4403e6c292cf90a8f7e89adfa229f38.png[/img]
[i]“Amid the sound of firecrackers, a year has come to an end,”[/i] and what better way to welcome the good fortune that the new year brings than with a nice drive through the Horizon Festival’s new features. 

This celebration will not last two weeks, though; the Horizon Festival has four weeks of content to celebrate this new lunar cycle. Each of these weeks comes with a reward car featuring some of the greatest vehicles to ever come out of the Middle Kingdom! 

Take it a step further and purchase the Chinese Lucky Stars Car Pack which includes three cars destined for greatness made in China and a VW that stole the country’s heart. 

Your luck doesn’t end there; thirteen previous reward cars make their way back to the Festival as Autoshow cars are available from January 30. Another firecracker blast from the past sets in with the extended night cycle that makes a return for this series. 

Gather your family for an amazing, traditional dinner, and some laps around the Horizon Festival with the Lunar New Year Update! 

[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes[/h2] 

The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update. 
[list] 
[*]New Features: 
[list] 
[*]13 Previous Exclusive Reward cars added to the Autoshow   
[*]9 Lunar New Year EventLab Props   
[*]1 Lunar New Year Collector Accolade   
[*]Chinese Lucky Stars Pack becomes available for purchase 
[*]5 new unlockable Festival Playlist Reward Cars 
[*]Limited Timed Series Features 
[list] 
[*]Evolving World: Stadium Drift Arena  
[*]Evolving World: Dragon Drone Show  
[*]Evolving World: Fireworks collectible  
[*]2 Badges: Feeling Lucky, Lunar Dragon  
[*]Returning Extended Nights[/list][/list] 
[*]Bug Fixes 
[list]
[*]Improved the audio for the 2008 Aston Martin DBS 
[*]Fixed issues that occurred while trying to redeem a car through the message center 
[*]Fixed issues with players getting kicked out of the Weekly Trial 
[*]Solved the issue causing “Tropical Storm” and “Dust Storm” not to show up in Photo Mode during Spring Season 
[*]Fixed cosmetic issues on the 1970 Fast X Dodge Charger, 1966 Fast X Chevrolet Impala, and the 2022 Gordon Murray T.50[/list][/list] 
[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here.[/url] The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 

[h2]The Year of the Dragon is Here.[/h2] 

People born on a Dragon year are said to be full of energy and drive; the Horizon Festival is no different of course! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f1df147baf5491613373c096a9b4b353996bf299.png[/img]
From tracks to props, dragons will flood the Festival to celebrate the Lunar New Year along with many other features to discover. 

[h3]Crouching Tiger, Drifting Dragon[/h3] 

The Stadium twists and turns into a Drift Arena!  

Whatever path you decide to take on this track, be true to yourself. The Drift Arena’s curves and bends will have you using every ancient secret of drifting to go on a complete lap. Driving around certain areas of the raceway or near its corners will trigger a smoke effect. Hold your drift, don’t let it catch you off guard! 

Besides the myriad of tight corners, multiple red dragons dance through the course creating rings you can drive through. Keep exploring the Stadium and find the Fireworks Collectible hidden inside it. 

[h3]Watch a Dragon Dance Done the Horizon Way.[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8177d396e6e18854f2e28cef8aa2d4b889da277d.png[/img]
Once you are done burning rubber, the Drift Arena will be hosting a Drone Show at night during the four weeks of Lunar New Year starting on February 1. 

During daytime, drones will turn into traditional lanterns that will line up in the pattern of a dragon and prance along the sky as the drones do at night.  

[h3]Building Your Own Tradition.[/h3] 

The spirit of Lunar New Year celebrates creativity with nine new props to use for your EventLab creations all with a season motif.  

Give your tracks an impressive guardian and unique look using the Lunar Dragon. Provide the community with a place to moon gaze including the Lunar Lookout on your creations.  

These are the nine props and decorations added in this new update:  
[list] 
[*]Decoration 
[list] 
[*]Lunar Dragon Head 
[*]Lunar Dragon Body 
[*]Lunar Dragon Tail[/list] 
[*]Ramps & Platforms 
[list] 
[*]Lunar Lookout[/list] 
[*]Walls & Fences:  
[list] 
[*]Lunar Barrier Gold 
[*]Lunar Barrier Red[/list] 
[*]Signs & Flags 
[list] 
[*]Lunar Flag Gold 
[*]Lunar Flag Red[/list] 
[*]Gameplay 
[list] 
[*]Firework Box[/list][/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0c9191f1cc54f19c75f97478f673cd3b62d920d1.png[/img]
[h2]What’s in this Year’s Red Envelopes[/h2] 

The biggest hitters that ever came out of China make an appearance at the Horizon Festival as Lunar New Year’s Reward Cars. Go deeper into Chinese automotive culture and history with the Chinese Lucky Stars Car Pack which will be available for purchase for USD $4.99 / GBP £3.99 / EU €4.99 On January 30 

To top it all off, the cars our community chose to return are finally in the Autoshow; snatch these ghosts from the past before they fade away! 

[h3]Returning Rewards in the Autoshow. [/h3] 

It seems luck is in your favor this year, as the Autoshow will feature thirteen cars during these four weeks.  

The long-awaited returning reward cars are here. Our community picked ten previous reward-exclusive cars from a list of options to become available on the Autoshow, and they are finally here! Get those credits ready to grab the rewards you missed starting January 30. 

Make room in your garage for three Asian newcomers hitting the Festival’s Autoshow on Lunar New Year. From racing to family, these cars are waiting to be modified and turned into your favorite ride. 

[h3]10 Returning Cars (announced with Community Choice):[/h3] 
[list] 
[*]1990 Porsche 911 Reimagined by Singer 
[*]2010 Aston Martin One-77 
[*]2021 Lamborghini Sian Roadster 
[*]2021 Rimac Nevera 
[*]2010 Ferrari 599XX 
[*]1971 Porsche #23 917/20 
[*]1962 Ferrari 250 GT Berlinetta Lusso1990 
[*]1967 Ferrari #24 Ferrari Spa 330 P4 
[*]2018 Italdesign Zerouno 
[*]1965 Peel Trident 
[/list] 
[h3]3 New Cars[/h3] 
[list] 
[*]2019 Hyundai Veloster N – 30.000 CR 
[*]2020 Xpeng P7 – 60.000 CR 
[*]2021 Lynk & Co 03 – 40.000 CR[/list] 
[h2]Chinese Lucky Stars Car Pack[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/af7643da15f814fbdd4125776c94b457ae63e909.png[/img]
Collect and drive four of China’s biggest golden stars! 

The latest Car Pack for Forza Horizon 5 includes 4 cars made locally and VW’s biggest hit in China. Take a deeper look at the vehicles featured in the Chinese Lucky Stars Car Pack. 

[h3]2022 Lynk & Co 05+[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4a59bfabe9c1d0f4a631e1ebc50f49ae853d4da7.png[/img]
Reading a plus sign at the end of a car’s name can only mean one thing: it’s time to ramp up the crazy.  

Adding 14 more horsepower and 29 lb-ft of torque, the 2022 Lynk & Co 05+ does exactly that, turning a regular SUV into a crossover vehicle with a need for the track. 

The Co 05+ has been fitted with a multi-link independent suspension system and a new body kit with wings and a front lip to improve downforce.  

Lynk & Co’s signature SUV has the power, styling, and gear to take over the Horizon Festival this series! 

[h3]2023 MG Cyberster[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/70381ff4637c86f09eae597e4ee4d3c97a24b572.png[/img]
The spiritual successor of MG’s TF is finally here with a dash of Chinese spice and three times to power to make the wait worthwhile.  

Enter the 2023 MG Cyberster, an electric convertible equipped with an all-wheel drive system and an engine capable of producing 536 bhp. This automotive fist of electronic fury can accelerate from 0-100 kmh in just 3.2 seconds, putting it right with the big hitters of the Festival. 

MG’s legacy combined with the best of Chinese engineering make the MG Cyberster one of your best choices for a light cruise or the harshest of races. 

[h3]2022 Wuling Hongguang Mini EV Macaron[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/372693605a30f5751e0df73ac6b9480e475b16a9.png[/img]
What is not to love about the 2022 Wuling Hongguang Mini EV Macaron? Agile body, lovely name (translates to sunshine in English), electrically- powered, a paintjob you can almost taste...this lovely macaron is a warrior of the concrete jungle! 

They say, “simplicity is the key to brilliance”, and this small vehicle is designed to deal with everyday urban challenges took it as its core. This practical little car is in the race to become number 1 in your heart. 

Turn this panda into the ultimate Dragon Warrior with a few customization tweaks and skadoosh around the Horizon Festival this series! 

[h3]2012 Volkswagen Santana[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d85e5a528c04aa8f8f37075ec2f0c5b7cde7de27.png[/img]
The German wonder that stole China’s heart, the 2012 Volkswagen Santana is arriving to the Horizon Festival this series. 

Considered VW’s biggest hit on the Asian continent, the Santana was one of the first European cars affordable in China. This made it the first choice for taxis and government vehicles. 

Germany’s Chinese connection will provide you with a ton of charm, countless hours of fun, and (above all) a ton of customization opportunities. Snatch yours this series with our latest Car Pack.  

If you weren’t sure how to spend those red envelope earnings, this is your sign to get the Chinese Lucky Stars Car Pack for $4.99 USD available for purchase now. 

[h2]Festival Playlist[/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/bc946b80d54b614feb5456b5631816ddd18b9e67.jpg[/img]
Four weeks of great luck and rewards come in with Lunar New Year.  

This month’s reward cars feature Horizon newcomers from the Asian continent including Hyundai, Lynk & Co, and MG. 

Take a look at five amazing reward cars you will be able to unlock this series. 

[h3]2022 Hyundai Kona[/h3] 

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the Lunar New Year Festival Playlist. Available from February 1 until February 8[/i] 

The first week of this Festival Playlist brings a crossover SUV from Korea, the turbocharged and freshly overhauled 2022 Hyundai Kona. 

The 2022 model received a very fitting makeover with its exterior being almost entirely a new design with more sportive lines and finishes. To wrap up the changes and upgrades, the Kona was fitted with a 195-hp turbocharged four-cylinder engine. 

Whether you want to turn the Kona into an offroading legend or have it perform at its best on the road, you will be able to unlock and modify it to your pleasing for 20 PTS on the first week of the Festival Playlist. 

[h3]2022 Hyundai IONIQ 6[/h3] 

[i]Earn 80 PTS starting Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the Lunar New Year Festival Playlist. Available from February 8 until February 29[/i] 

The performance model in Hyundai’s line of electric vehicles will reach the Horizon Festival as a Series Reward for Lunar New Year.  

The 2022 Hyundai IONIQ 6 is an EV with an aerodynamic look and function that not only makes it run more efficiently, but it also allows it to perform like a sports saloon on the track. The IONIQ 6 can take off from standstill to 100 kmh in just 5.1 seconds. 

An electric car that screams performance with its flaps, aerodynamic mirrors, and wheel gap reducers, the Hyundai IONIQ 6 is a great pick for those looking to use less gas and still be fast. 

[h3]2022 Lynk & Co 02 HB[/h3] 

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the Lunar New Year Festival Playlist. Available from February 8 until February 15[/i] 

Yes, you guessed right: HB stands for hatchback, which is another word for “I’m going to have so much fun in this car”.  

The 2022 Lynk & Co 02 HB is the Chinese company’s shot at giving the world a hot hatch they can Phoenix dance in. This model is equipped with the Volvo Drive-E 2.0-litre turbocharged 4-cylinder engine that we have seen in the Swedish company’s S60, XC70, and V70. 

To put their own spin to it, the 02 comes with an overpower option that boosts its torque from 350 Nm to 380 Nm, and let’s this small powerhouse dash from 0 to 100 in 6.2 seconds. 

Drift Arena and a hot hatch, need we say more? 

[h3]2020 Hyundai i30N[/h3] 

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the Lunar New Year Festival Playlist. Available from February 15 until February 22[/i] 

More power, more responsiveness, and a sportier body kit; the 2020 Hyundai i30N is getting front of line to become your favorite hatchback to drive around the Horizon Festival. 

A 2.0 - liter, 4-cylinder turbo engine capable of producing 353 Nm of torque along with its brand-new 8-speed dual clutch transmission makes this car worthy of an invitation to the hot hatch party that takes place every day at the Festival.  

Not straying too far away from its five-door rivals, the i30N can hit a top speed of 250 kmh and reach 100 from nothing in 6.1 seconds. 

If not for all the fun a stock hatchback can bring, unlock this car for 20 PTS on the third week of Lunar New Year and see what kinds of sauce you can add with your own customization. 

[h3]2023 MG MG7[/h3] 

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 “Spring” Season on the Lunar New Year Festival Playlist. Available from February 22 until February 29[/i] 

Another one of MG’s staples makes a revamped comeback in the 2023 MG MG7. This new version of a classic comes with a design that puts together luxury and sportive performance. 

The new MG7 is geared with a 2.0-liter turbo engine capable of putting out 257 hp and producing 405 Nm of torque, catering to fans of speed; and packs it up inside a stylish outside design. 

The return of the MG should be celebrated along with the New Year, and we do not know a better way to do this than taking it to the track and scoring some fast times. 

[h2]What’s next[/h2] 

We travel back to Across the Atlantic in European Automotive.  

New reward cars from the greatest car makers on the planet along with a brand-new Car Pack to drive and collect. 

Along with new props and badges, this new update will bring every class to Rally Adventure Rivals !

notes.title: An Insane Hypercar and a Classic Convertible Make the Perfect Duo.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/593d15a953f86a92feb8bd112af9091b64085e40.png[/img]
Astonishing looks, name, and build are the three clues we needed to figure out we were heading into hypercar territory. But in case you still had a couple doubts, take a look inside the 2012 Pagani Huayra and awe in the tribute to speed that is its twinturbo 6.3 - liter V12 engine to convince yourself.  

The Huayra is built to be striking to look at as well as very efficient. Its hand-assembled lightweight body is the best aerodynamic pair for its massive engine. Every detail that went into designing this car such as using a single clutch to save weight or fitting a titanium exhaust was made thinking about its total weight and how the air flows when it drives. No wonder Pagani decided to name this one after an ancient god of wind. 

Unlock this monstrous car for 20 PTS on the third week of Community Choice until January 25! 

Let us know what you’d like to see in Forza Horizon 5 in the future. Send your ideas and suggestions to our team through the[url=http://aka.ms/SHUB] Suggestions Hub.[/url] 

If you into any issue on this update or others in the future, tell us about them [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]on the Troubleshooting Hub[/url].

The 1967 Mercedes-Benz 280 SL was no different, standing out from other cars of the era by its unique roof. This 280 SL was nicknamed “pagoda” due to the particular shape of the ceiling fitted in the convertible.  

Not a particularly strong competitor out of the box but try swapping that engine and adding race accessories and you might be on the right path to create a top-of-the-line racer.

notes.content:

A super extreme hyper car arrives as this week’s 20 PTS reward. Born in Sweden, the 2006 Koeniggsegg was built to complete in the top echelon of automotive history.  

This car is as light as you can find, incorporating Kevlar, aluminum, and carbon fiber to squeeze the best performance out of the blazing 4.7 supercharged engine homecooked in Sweden specially for this car. Light body and a quaking engine make this car reach above 300 KM/h when you step on that pedal. 

Unlock this striking rarity on the second week of Community Choice.

notes.title: Coming to Your Garage with Community Choice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/286ee59ec6a4f03045b263c1550c48ec3bdf5878.jpg[/img]
The votes are in!  

We asked what previous reward cars you would like to see featured in this Festival Playlist and now the results will show up on Community Choice’s Autoshow featuring your picks from the poll we completed a couple months ago.   

The selection of returning cars includes:
[list] 
[*]1990 Porsche 911 Reimagined by Singer  
[*]2010 Aston Martin One-77  
[*]2021 Lamborghini Sian Roadster  
[*]2021 Rimac Nevera  
[*]2010 Ferrari 599XX  
[*]1971 Porsche #23 917/20  
[*]1962 Ferrari 250 GT Berlinetta Lusso1990  
[*]1967 Ferrari #24 Ferrari Spa 330 P4  
[*]2018 Italdesign Zerouno  
[*]1965 Peel Trident [/list]Please be mindful that these Autoshow cars will only be available for purchase starting January 30.   

[h2]Festival Playlist[/h2] 

Eight exclusive cars are here to stir up the Horizon Festival!  

Conquer the different races and challenges each week has to offer and unlock super cars from the past and present in these four weeks of Festival Playlist. 

[h3]2011 McLaren 12C Coupé[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/dd3ae257f167f6692527c20865816e75925504e8.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the Community Choice Festival Playlist. Available from January 4 until January 11[/i] 

The first car created from top to bottom by McLaren and the first road-legal car they made after the legendary McLaren F1, the 2011 McLaren 12C Coupé is everything you would expect of a roar super car built with Formula 1 technology.  

All the F1 technology you could fit into a supercar is found in the 12C; ranging from the carbon fiber chassis to the steer-braking system, the pedigree of the 12C is impeccable and very noticeable.  

The McLaren 12C doesn’t stray away from the automotive accomplishments of its one-seater cousins and you can have your own go at this superbly engineered vehicle on Community Choice. 

[h3]2008 Aston Martin DBS[/h3] 

Whether you are working as a secret agent or just looking for a car to set unbeatable times in, the 2008 Aston Martin DBS is your best sidekick to accomplish both of those goals.  

510 horsepower and a license to speed, the Aston Martin DBS’s V12 engine can take it from 0 – 100 kmh in 4.3 seconds. Enough to foil any lurking evil plan that requires high-speed chasing.   

The looks of a gentleman and the power to snake through opponents all in one charismatic package. A ride on the DBS will have you calling it Sir as you sprint through the Horizon Festival in this piece of car royalty.   

[h3]2006 Koeniggsegg CCX[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/172736d53e955ab78bff74737f77a8c821003b23.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the Community Choice Festival Playlist. Available from January 11 until January 18[/i] 

One Swedish boy woke up one day and wondered how to make a car that could outrun the McLaren F1, a formidable task. Fast forward to 2006 and that dream came to reality; its name was Koeniggsegg CCX.  

806 horsepower produced by a 4.7-liter supercharged V8 brewed personally by the people of Koeniggsegg. A body made of Kevlar, aluminum, and carbon fiber. All that put together makes you wonder if you were meant to drive this car or fly it.  

Owner of many records at several tracks, the Koeniggsegg CCX is an automotive legend with dreams of speed as its real fuel. 

[h3]2016 W Motors Lykhan Hypersport[/h3] 

Four countries put their best men on the task of creating one of the world’s most exclusive cars. Considered a myth by many, the ultra-rare 2016 W Motors Lykhan Hypersport’s power on the track is worth going on an epic quest to find.  

Designed with aerodynamics that make the most use out of the middle-mounted 3.7 - liter flat - 6 engine that powers this monster with 740 bhp. All of that thought and engineering makes the Lebanese signature car able to reach 100 kmh from standstill in just 2.9 seconds.  

Putting your eyes on a Lykhan used to be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but now you can unlock and drive your own legendary supercar through the Horizon Festival.   

[h3]2012 Pagani Huayra[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/593d15a953f86a92feb8bd112af9091b64085e40.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the Community Choice Festival Playlist. Available from January 18 until January 25[/i] 

Being the follow-up to the Pagani Zonda is no easy feat. To help the 2012 Pagani Huayra successfully accomplish that task, they equipped it with a Mercedes – sourced twinturbo 6.3 - liter V12 engine that was designed to be used with the Huayra only.  

Speaking about design, every choice made in the creation process of this car was taken to make it the best hypercar available. A titanium exhaust was fitted to make the engine lighter, it uses a single disc clutch to save 70 kg of weight. And the looks are not only what you’d expect from the Italian maker, they also maximize aerodynamics like the vents molded directly into the structure and its signature reverse wing.   

Named after the Quechua god of wind, the Huayra has come to run like a gust and pass other racers like a breeze. 

[h3]1967 Mercedes-Benz 280 SL[/h3] 

Mercedes-Benz SL line has generations of amazing sports cars with a legacy has spawned amazing pieces through several generations. The last model to enter the SL lineup was convertible like no other, the 280 SL was nicknamed the “Pagoda” after its iconic roof styling.  

The 280 SL was fitted with a 2.8 - liter straight six engine, ideal for the person looking to spice up their weekends or their trips to work. Who knows, a cheeky engine swap and some other modifications and you might have your hands into a racer capable of going toe-to-toe with modern GT cars.   

Start tweaking, driving, and racing the Mercedes-Benz 280 SL unlocking it on the third week of Community Choice. 

[h3]2016 Spania GTA Spano[/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fef698bfa7b45e70092db8133556b46230458133.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 “Spring” Season on the Community Choice Festival Playlist. Available from January 25 until February 1[/i] 

The 2016 Spania GTA Spano was produced to make the dream of their director come true: to create an exclusive, fast, and elegant sports car.  

Born and raised in Spain, the Spano is a purebred hypercar. Boasting a V10 Twinturbo 7.9 - liter engine that could make the go from 0-100 kmh in just 2.9 seconds. This puts the Spano on par with any of its more famous hypercar equals.  

As for exclusivity, only 99 GTA Spanos were produced, so your chances of ever seeing one were close to none, until now that you can unlock and drive the 2016 Spania GTA Spano as one of the final rewards of the Festival Playlist. 

[h3]1969 FIAT Dino 2.4 Coupe[/h3] 

Two of Italy’s greatest car designers put their brains together to create a timeless classic. Designed by Bertone, the 1969 FIAT Dino 2.4 Coupe puts the best of Italian racing heritage and mass production cars together.   

The 1969 version of the Dino made several upgrades to previous models such as the ZF transmission in charge of bringing the power provided by a 2.4-liter V6 engine that was fitted on the Dino. The name of the game for this Italian classic was “torque” which it could produce tons of and made it better suited for everyday driving.  

Italian style, build, and power drive this car forward and made it one to be remembered for ages to come. 

[h2]What’s next[/h2] 

Lunar New Year is upon us!  

Celebrate the coming of the first new moon in the next series: Lunar New Year.

notes.title: Get behind the wheel of these top Xbox racing games with up to 85% off
notes.content:
There are plenty of brilliant Xbox racing games out there, but this only makes picking and choosing which pink slips to pick up all the more confusing. Fortunately, the Xbox store has felt your pain and is currently looking to salve it with big Xbox racing game deals on three top titles spanning the past few years.

Let's kick off with the most recent racer: The Crew Motorfest. Ubisoft and Ivory Tower's open-world arcade racing game looks to rival Playground Games and Turn 10's Forza Horizon 5, and while it takes a suspicious amount of inspiration from one of the best Xbox exclusives, the result is excellent. Melding all of its learnings from previous games in The Crew series with the vibrant island of O'ahu in Hawaii, the devs have managed to produce one of the best racing games of recent times, earning it a solid 8/10 in our The Crew Motorfest review.

In Echo's musings, they state that "The Crew Motorfest is an enjoyable racer that shows more developers can tackle the open-world arcade racer genre." Right now, you can grab the standard edition for $29.99, down 50% from $59.99. If you're in between console generations, then for an extra five bucks you can opt for the cross-gen bundle - better to be safe just in case you can't make the leap to current-gen hardware just yet.
