notes.title: 2023 Forza Year in Review
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/acc1affc14fe844081f99d0822fe8103e630d744.jpg[/img]
Welcome to the 2023 Forza Year in Review! Another 12 months have passed, which means in true Forza tradition, it’s time to look back at everything that’s happened over the last year. We released Forza Motorsport, celebrated the two-year anniversary of Forza Horizon 5, and introduced some of our biggest updates yet with EventLab 2.0 and the Rally Adventure expansion.

We also gave players [url=aka.ms/THUB]a new way to report issues directly to the team with the Troubleshooting Hub[/url] and continue to [url=aka.ms/SHUB]add new cars and features inspired by your input on the Suggestions Hub[/url]. In Forza Horizon 5, we introduced the number one community requested car, the 2010 Nissan Tsuru, and upgraded Photo Mode with time of day and weather settings, as well as placement of the driver character outside the car – [url=https://forza.net/news/community-hubs-update-2]all of which were highly requested suggestions by players[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/b32783c2e6cf28f1d5457e5a808b80a88bb800b6.jpg[/img]
[i]Forza Horizon 5 Photo by CCOCAS. (Share Code 553 567 882)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e32aafeb182d34cad5f167eb3532aed5fa3d08d7.jpg[/img]
[i]Forza Horizon 5 Photo by Durmell. (Share Code 157 817 253)[/i]

Before we dive into the game recaps, let’s celebrate the creative content you’ve been making over the past year. Every week, the Forza Forums hosts themed Photo and Livery contests open to all players. Thanks to everyone who continues to create and submit their content! To celebrate your creativity, we've handpicked our top 5 favorite community photos and liveries from Forza Horizon 5 over the year. You'll see examples in this blog, and we’ve put them together in our ‘Best of 2023’ collection on the Forza Forums:
[list]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2023-in-fh5-photos/658476]Best of 2023 in FH5 Photos[/url]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2023-in-fh5-liveries/658477]Best of 2023 in FH5 Liveries[/url][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c1f866cfe3d0bd8ec5e9aa07343144abf39f85ec.jpg[/img]
[i]Forza Horizon 5 "Glitch" livery created by FormFirm. (Share Code: 260 808 658)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/8e0e5248839af431062018dabff60d09a45c89db.jpg[/img]
[i]Forza Horizon 5 "Franken Brides Dually" livery created by Skogarmar. (Share Code: 88 107 114 199)[/i]

[h2]Community Leaders[/h2]

Community event organizers are central to Forza's community, inspiring competition, creativity, and ingenuity. With excitement around Forza Motorsport, 2023 saw organizers using all their expertise to craft events and schedules that could straddle the transition from one game to the next. Kudos to you all!

The year kicked off with the brilliant FTC Renault 5 Cup, seeing both great door to door racing and of course the amazing photography for which FTC have earned renowned across the Forza community. By late February the series was cinched by justScotty--despite close competition from Joeyst25. Look out for FTC in 2024 with Race Academy meets running each and every Sunday.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a5d80b11a27f98451543c373fc5dcf8d5f483476.png[/img]
[i]Captured by FTC Infernas81: FTC Renault 5 Cup on Forza Motorsport 7.[/i]

March saw Forza Share Your Creations (previously FH5 Livery & Designs) organize a tribute to the late Ken Block. Go Fast Risk Every Thang' attracted paints that were at once touching and astonishing. The top three liveries came from Kgree27, MrMugello, and SnakeEyes Friex but this was a contest where every entrant, from the Mercedes Tankpool24 Racing Truck to the Gymkhana 10 Ford Hoonicorn Mustang, meant the world. You're always in our hearts, Ken.

May was notable as the beginning of the marathon Envy Drift & PTG Street Masters Drift Championship which would see the community's finest skid-artists competing all the way through to August! Alongside congratulating EDM Atmospheric who took victory, and all the competitors in the drift and concourse contests, we also celebrate those working behind the scenes to put this incredible competition together for the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/52dd6d1ff926e397a4755ebd185da7ff3e0faa04.jpg[/img]
[i]Captured by onhellno1989: Envy Drift & PTG Street Masters Drift Championship on Forza Horizon 5.[/i]

It would not be a Year in Review without mention of the TORA 24 Hours of Mulsanne, which took place in late July. As many predicted, ESV Motorsport exerted their dominance in the event, and indeed TORA's entire endurance calendar. The record ESV carries into 2024 should strike fear into the hearts of the competition as we head into the first year of Forza Motorsport. But then again, there is nothing like a new game to mix up the pecking order!

2023 was the year of Racing Haven. While by October they already had some first events under their belts on Forza Horizon 5, it was their BMW Challenge which launched concurrently with Forza Motorsport that cemented their spot in the top echelon of the community's competitive scene. Huge congratulations to ESV Green who emerged to win from one of the largest set of entrants in recent memory. (And, as an aside, the whole community waits with bated breath for the return of the Racing Haven podcast.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2d428c46bce46fd104def95f9822ae6e91948ddf.jpg[/img]
[i]Captured by Chilsy: Racing Haven BMW Challenge on Forza Motorsport.[/i]

As the year closes out, we catch up with events that are still ongoing! AR12 is hosting both the AR12 Community Racing Series and the AR12 Racing Championship Presented by Thrustmaster, while Late Night Racing presents a Ford v Ferrari series for lovers of vintage sports cars. There is something for everyone in the Forza community, and we can't wait to see what 2024 has in store.

[h2]Forza Motorsport[/h2]

At the start of the year, we invited our friends at Xbox to Turn 10 Studios as part of Developer_Direct to give you [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-developer-direct]a technical showcase of Forza Motorsport[/url] with a behind-the-scenes look at the cars, tracks and audio in the game. We also participated in the Xbox Games Showcase in June, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-coming-october-10]opening pre-orders for Forza Motorsport[/url] and showcasing the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-builders-cup]Builders Cup Career Mode[/url]. Before launch, we flew to Cologne for gamescom, demoing new gameplay to our community at an in-person theater experience. Being in Germany, it was the perfect opportunity to [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-gamescom]reveal the Nürburgring GP circuit would be available in the game[/url], with the Nordschleife coming in spring 2024.

[previewyoutube=13Qzm2qqXA4;full][/previewyoutube]
Since the release of Forza Motorsport, we've been listening to your feedback about the game and where you would like to see improvements or changes made. Stay tuned, as we’ll have more to share about these topics early in 2024.

So far, we’ve shipped two major content updates to Forza Motorsport, introducing both [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-2]Yas Marina[/url] and [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-update-3]Hockenheim[/url] with multiple track layouts for each, new Spotlight cars and Car Pass deliveries, and new weekly events across Career Mode, Featured Multiplayer and Rivals. [url=https://forza.net/events]You can stay up to date with the current active events in Forza Motorsport at Forza.net/Events[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/5cc5b248cb5ecb4aa9b26fe022273643f4fe2756.jpg[/img]
Recently we celebrated two wins at The Game Awards! Thanks to you, Forza Motorsport won both categories it was nominated for: Best Sports/Racing Game and Innovation in Accessibility. We’re also honored to have won [url=https://www.ign.com/articles/ign-awards-2023-every-winner-announced]IGN’s Best Racing Game of 2023[/url] and [url=https://www.ign.com/articles/accessibility-innovation-games-2023]Accessibility Innovation in Games in 2023[/url]. We love hearing about the features in the game you are enjoying, such as the Featured Multiplayer structure and driving physics, and we’re proud to have our work on [url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2023/04/27/forza-motorsport-accessibility-features-blind-driving/]Blind Driving Assists and the wide suite of accessibility options[/url] recognized by the gaming community. We hope you enjoy building your racing skills in Forza Motorsport for many years to come.

[h2]Forza Horizon 5[/h2]

What a year this has been to adventure through the Horizon Festival in México!

Through 12 game updates you have explored Mexico in different cars, customized your vehicles to truly make them your own, completed thrilling challenges to unlock new, exciting cars, snapped breathtaking pictures for our contests, and created the most amazing events for the community to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/911b825b874192221cca9bd72c8368054f83438c.png[/img]
We are very thankful that you chose to spend 2023 in Forza Horizon 5. Here are some of our favorite moments in the Horizon Festival.

[h3]Welcome Our Newest Expansion[/h3]

March saw the release of the second expansion that came to [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure-now-available]Forza Horizon 5: Rally Adventure[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2d6ffc6aaafe8d41ae522bd77c6b9ad29542decf.jpg[/img]
Rally Adventure gave our players [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure-map-reveal]a completely new area to explore called Sierra Nueva[/url]. This new zone has different biomes that include sand, asphalt, jumps, inclines, forests, and more. Players were now able to enjoy racing and exploring Pueblo Artza, the Abandoned Quarry, Sand Dunes, Desert Gorge, Green Hills, and an entirely smashable Palm Forest.

To go on the perfect off-roading trip, you need the perfect off-roading vehicle, which is why Rally Adventure featured all-new rally parts for car customization as well as the anti-lag system to get those perfect starts. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-rally-adventure]This expansion also brought 10 new-to-Horizon cars[/url] made to get a blast on the dirt, mud, and other difficult terrains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/45be680605241ed9771601c2584aab00bf11a1a5.jpg[/img]
Rally monsters, new biomes, and an interactable environment; if you haven’t had the chance, this is your sign to close 2023 with Forza Horizon 5’s second expansion. 

[h3]New Permanent Features[/h3]

Every update we release for Forza Horizon 5 brings features we hope our players love using. We like to focus on unique themes that enhance your gameplay experience each month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/9bda66f8a9c0dff02ed6ccaf72e3707f02c806f9.jpg[/img]
Although most updates are intended to last only for a single month, we listen to our community very closely and have made some of your favorite additions permanent.

This year, for example, the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-summer-party]Summer Party update[/url] made the longer night cycles ([url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-midnights]introduced in Midnights at Horizon[/url]) a permanent feature. Even though they do not last as much as their original counterpart, the longer night cycle allows players to explore Mexico’s unique landscape and biomes under a different light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/2d66d730a99058d752fbea253fb9a8823785e8dd.jpg[/img]
It’s round, it’s fast, and it’s permanent! [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-high-performance]First introduced on the High-Performance series in April[/url], the Oval Track was a huge success with our players, and we were ecstatic you enjoyed it! The Oval Track is always available to host a Road Racing event at any time.

[h3]Snapping the Perfect Year[/h3]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-explore-the-horizon]Explore the Horizon was released in May of this year[/url], and with it came a feature many of our players were asking for: an upgraded Photo Mode to take front cover-worthy photos of their favorite cars in the many gorgeous backdrops Mexico has to offer.

Of course, our community of talented creators put the new features implemented in this update to good use as you can see on our many Photo Contests held on our social media accounts. We are very eager to see what you guys come up with for next year and many more to come. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/7c7f98b0765545273ef5ec869cbe8e0405deddd8.png[/img]
If you want to learn how to take advantage of the new features added to Photo Mode and upgrade your snapshooting skills, take a look at our [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-photo-guide]Forza Horizon 5 Photo Mode Guide[/url].

[h3]Fueling the Community’s Creative Spirit[/h3]

Our community members never stop creating awesome and unique events that everyone can enjoy. We have seen everything from extreme challenges, fun tours, and completely new game modes designed in EventLab. However, we wanted to step up the creation game and give you better tools to create the huge events you always dreamt of making, which is why [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-creatives]we built an entire series around inventing: Horizon Creatives[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/ee73e619c7054636062eea63f3c0a358341379d0.png[/img]
This new update put EventLab 2.0 in the hands of our creators to help with their creation process. The multi-selection mode allowed Props to be mass selected and then edited in a group. Players could grab several individual props and then rotate them, move them around, and duplicate them. You could now group props together into a new “mega prop” called a Prefab that could be easily saved, reused in your events, and shared so others could use them as well.

A new location made for creating events was also added in this update, EventLab Island provided creators with a massive blank canvas to put together larger and more exciting events and game modes.

[h3]Our Most Requested Car Makes Its Appearance[/h3]

The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-dia-de-muertos]Día de Muertos update[/url] meant to recreate this iconic Mexican holiday and include as many references to Mexican folklore as possible. We had marigold stands and petals lying around the Festival, inflatable skulls decorating the streets, and alebrijes of many different forms to find. 

[previewyoutube=9n_2nx6ispw;full][/previewyoutube]
This celebration of Mexican culture and folklore would not be complete without Mexico’s automotive sweetheart: the 2010 Nissan Tsuru which we brought as a Festival Playlist reward car for the Día de Muertos update. 

The Tsuru, as unbelievable as it sounds, was our most requested car on the Suggestions Hub, and what a more fitting time to bring it to the Horizon Festival than Día de Muertos. 

[h3]Rolling Out the Red Carpet for Our Partnerships[/h3]

The Horizon Festival was starstruck this year, as we had the fortune of collaborating with two brands of huge relevance in automotive history. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/1190fb4cf594a7615e9ec98da6f088d3d4062a9d.jpg[/img]
The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-upgrade-heroes]Upgrade Heroes update in July[/url] gave us the chance to be everything we wanted to be, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-barbie]adding memorable pieces from Barbie’s history to Forza Horizon 5 as limited-time free gifts[/url]. A blast from the past came with Barbie’s pink 1956 Chevrolet Corvette. This Barbie can also go off-roading with the 2022 GMC Hummer Barbie Edition.

This December, [url=https://forza.net/news/Winter-Wonderland]we planned our next heist with the Fast X Car Pack[/url], which included five cars from Fast X including the 1970 Dodge Charger and 2022 Flip Car 2.0. You can drive these two, and three more cars from the Fast X film with the Fast X Car Pack available now for $9.99 USD.

[h2]Start the New Year with a Huge Throwback[/h2]

What better way to start the new year than with a series co-created with you! Community Choice is one of many ways we have to show how much we appreciate our fans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/0cfdd931a3abc7dd782518d6200d536fd08fc653.png[/img]
We sent out a survey asking our players what rewards, challenges, and other features they would like to see in the next series, and their response was amazing!

See us in January when Community Choice goes live featuring the highly acclaimed and requested neon decorations and Neon Cube collectible from Midnights at Horizon as well as plenty of other returning stunts, challenges and rewards on the Festival Playlist and coming to the Autoshow.

[h3]Celebrating Our Community[/h3]

The Golden Tank Awards are just around the corner!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/a980ef8ca3dfcc46cdbc0b017a7be540b6dd1fdc.png[/img]
Celebrate the magnificent creations of our community and vote for your favorite EventLab creations, Prefabs, and more content made entirely by players and for the players.

Make sure to cast your vote at [url=https://aka.ms/GoldenTankAwards2023]aka.ms/GoldenTankAwards2023[/url] and help your favorite creators take home the coveted Golden Tank Award.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/74808ad932e5752631ed376c43542b579c13a97b.png[/img]
Keep creating and we might see you in next year’s shortlist!

[h2]Thanks for Racing![/h2]

The biggest highlight we have is and always will be our amazing community. Whether you are a player, a builder, creator, event runner, or anything along those lines, we celebrate all the passion and love you have for the entire Forza franchise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/c4823fb4960cdd128a2ba9596e50e6b3c761ec7e.jpg[/img]
We hope you have enjoyed the content we put out and that you spent wonderful hours racing in the world’s most famous tracks, going on adventures around Mexico, or customizing your favorite vehicles.

[i]Keep adventuring and we’ll see you at the starting line![/i]

notes.title: The Final Winter Speedster is Jolly To Go!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/73abf76fd93b7be97cabb9773bbe2a27736e52ae.png[/img]
Another Lotus pocket rocket lifts off the Horizon Festival to close the holiday season. 

The 2000 Lotus 340R is a spiritual successor to the already great Lotus Elise. This car’s 1.8-liter, four-cylinder engine was perfectly fitted in a lighter-than-a-snowflake body with no doors or roof but with a 0-100 kmh time of 4.4 seconds.  

Only 340 units of this car were made and are, accurately, mostly used for racing and as track toys and now you can pa rum pum pum pum the track with the 340R for 20 PTS on the final week of the Festival Playlist.  

If you have encountered any issue with this update, please make sure to report it on our [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. You will find other known issues we are currently investigating as well.

notes.title: Dashing Through the Snow in a 228-horse Car
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9b888d4ed907066f3bc0b23843edf9ed81e38ad5.jpg[/img]
Teamwork makes the dream work, and so Toyota and Subaru got together to create two cars built to spread the joy of driving. On their side, Subaru created the exciting BRZ and here we have its successor: the 2022 Subaru BRZ. 

Nothing makes the winter cozier than the warmth of burnt rubber, and the new BRZ is a small car dying to make its tires screech around tight corners; a few simple tunes and changes, and you got yourself the perfect drifter to stay warm for the rest of the week.  

Unlock and create one of the best drifting machines the Horizon Festival has ever seen for 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist from December 21 until December 28. 

Let us know what you’d like to see in Forza Horizon 5 in the future. Send your ideas and suggestions to our team through the [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url]. 

If you into any issue on this update or others in the future, tell us about them on the [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url].

notes.title: Coming to Your Garage This Holiday Season
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/911b825b874192221cca9bd72c8368054f83438c.png[/img]
Starting December 5, you will be able to acquire four new cars in the Autoshow that we have introduced for Winter Wonderland. Plus, each week of the Horizon Festival brings one of four exclusive hypercars to unlock for your garage. 

This collection of retro racers will get the holiday spirit running and the racing going through the Horizon Festival. 

[h3]1958 Aston Martin DBR1 [/h3] 

An absolute legend of a car, the 1958 Aston Martin DBR1 won the Nürburgring 1000km race and ran through Le Mans four times.  

Without the restrain of having to compete with cars that were available to the public or based on a road-legal car, Aston Martin went on and designed a champion and hero of British automotive in the DBR1. 

A complete 2.9-liters and 255 bhp of racing’s finest history could be yours in the Autoshow of Winter Wonderland.  

[h3]1953 Jaguar C-Type [/h3] 

Remember this well: the “C” Stands for competition, and the 1953 Jaguar C-Type sure knows how to burn rubber and take home the crown.  

Having been a two-time winner of the gruesome Le Mans race, the C-type has earned its place in racing’s hall of fame.  

Pioneering disc brakes and striping off as much weight as possible from places such as the gas tank, the 1953 Jaguar C-Type still has some force left in it to pounce its way through the Horizon Festival.  

[h3]1970 Ferrari 512 S [/h3] 

The 1970 and 1971 winner of Sebring and Kyalami, the 1970 Ferrari 512 S knows racing even before it had hit its first track. Back in 1970, to be able to compete in the World Sportscar Championship, 25 units had to be built against the clock in just 3 months.  

Having raced in the world’s finest courses with some of the greatest drivers of all time behind its wheel, this classic Ferrari is a true challenger for the best in automotive history.  

[h3]1966 Porsche 906 Carrera 6 [/h3] 

The winner of its class at Monza, Daytona, Spa, and Nürburgring, the 1966 Porsche 906 Carrera 6 had the challenge of being the best when it mattered the most.  

Originally destined for the 904, the 906’s flat six engine along with the wind tunnel-designed body made this car reach a top speed of 280kmh on Le Mans. 

A winner from any angle you look at, the Carrera not only held Porsche’s racing legacy, but it also heralded a new era for the German makers. 

[h3]2009 Lotus 2-Eleven [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ede125ff0e06f4f8de4e2c6c1fdd3c45916ddd02.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 Season on the Winter Wonderland Festival Playlist. Available from December 7 until December 14 [/i] 

Mightier than the collective power of nine magical reindeer, the tiny track master 2009 Lotus 2-Eleven is a light and nimble wish come true.  

It comes with a supercharged, 1.8 - liter, four-cylinder engine mounted on a super light aluminum tub, this makes it so that this car can reach 100kmh from zero in 4.3 seconds.  

Built for the racing enthusiast that exists in all of us, the unmatched experience of Lotus quality in a modern track day car is an experience car fans must try at least once.  

[h3]2019 Morgan Aero GT [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5e015b0b5f9c39346ee5ff0d5d195e076ea85bf9.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 Season on the Winter Wonderland Festival Playlist. Available from December 14 until December 21 [/i] 

A large and charge GT racer with a classic look? The 2019 Morga Aero GT is the true Polar Express in our eyes.  

Morgan’s most extreme and intense road car released was designed with every note they took on their years taking over the GT3 world. These learnings are reflected in the improved body of the car with augmented aerodynamics and air flow.  

The engine isn’t too far from the original Aero 8, it is almost the same 4.8-liter V-8 we all know and love and sometimes, sticking to the classics is the right move to make. 

Find out how fast this retro-inspired extreme racer can reach the North Pole with 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist.  

[h3]2022 Subaru BRZ [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9b888d4ed907066f3bc0b23843edf9ed81e38ad5.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 3 Season on the Winter Wonderland Festival Playlist. Available from December 21 until December 28 [/i] 

Ditching the rear wing and the hood intake was a bold move, but certainly the right one when designing the 2022 Subaru BRZ, an ice-cold successor to a 2020 classic. 

This revamped version has superior grip and handling as well as an overhauled outside that significantly improved the aerodynamics of the car. Built in collaboration with Toyota, Subaru made the decision of increasing the capacity from 2.0 to 2.4-liters which now produces 228 bhp of pure jingle bellin’ fun.  

The weather might be frightful, but the BRZ’s so delightful. Even if you have nowhere to go, let it run, let it run, let it run! 

[h3]2000 Lotus 340R [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/73abf76fd93b7be97cabb9773bbe2a27736e52ae.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 4 Season on the Winter Wonderland Festival Playlist. Available from December 28 until January 3 [/i] 

We are closing out the Winter Wonderland Festival Playlist like we started it: with another Lotus pocket rocket ready to pa rum pum pum pum the track. 

The 2000 Lotus 340R was created with the Lotus Elise as reference, which is one of the best places to start when creating a new model. The 340R came equipped with a 1.8-liter, four-cylinder engine, the perfect tag team partner for its almost non-existent weight.  

Only 340 units of this frosty ride were made, however the chance has come for you to have a wonderful life with your very own Lotus 340R on the Festival Playlist! 

[h2]What’s next [/h2] 

We asked for your help to create the Festival Playlist you wanted to see with Community Choice!  

We gave you a list of options to put into our next series featuring returning decorations, PR Stunts, reward cars, and hard-to-find Autoshow cars, and you will be able to see the results in the next series’ Festival Playlist.  

The “Purrrfect Collection” Badge will be available for all players that have collected 800 unique cars.  

Get ready for our greatest hits collection this January.

notes.title: Have a Merry Racing Season in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
[i]‘Twas night at Mexico when all through the Festival  

every car was stirring, even the rentals. 

The next update was coming with features galore:  

Four new cars, and a collectible we had seen before. 

Exciting new props for EventLab creations 

and fitting Winter Wonderland decorations. 

Four entire weeks of the Winter Season 

Secret Santa returns with two cars to feast on. 

New race routes, accolades, and a Car Pack from a movie 

And a Winter Stadium to race in snow fluffy. 

Winter Wonderland is here when the year culminates 

As Forza Horizon 5’s latest update! [/i] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3cba93edf32af99ca9f6b3e834cb9f897ad35ad1.png[/img]
[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes [/h2] 

The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update. 
[list] 
[*]New engine audio for the 2023 Corvette Z06 
[*]PC – Performance drop while driving in the Audi e-Tron has been improved. 
[*]PC - BMW i4 / Czsinger 21C’s Windshield works correctly under rain. 
[*]Solved 2022 Porsche GT4 RS’s hoods issues with liveries. 
[*]You are now able to tune the gear ratio of the 2023 Meyers Manx 2.0. 
[*]Fixed ASL/BSL videos missing in some chapters of Donut Media and Icons of Speed 
[*]“Purrrfect Collection” badge added. [/list] 
[url= https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating here[/url]. The [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have. 

[h2]The Horizon Festival Gets the Chills [/h2] 

[h3]Winter All Day Every Day [/h3] 

The season of joy sets in the Horizon Festival and what better way to celebrate than with four weeks of winter. Enjoy the chilly and cozy ambiance of an all-winter Festival for holiday season. 

A very frosty collectible shows up once again at the Horizon Festival.  

The snowman collectible will be available once again this year for you to add to your ornament collection during Week 2 of the Festival Playlist. 

Find this jolly, happy soul around the Winter Wonderland Stadium starting December 14. 

[h3]Winter Makeover for the Stadium [/h3] 

The Stadium gets its share of holiday cheer and transforms to welcome the occasion. Watch it flourish with candy canes and Christmas trees all over it while you race through its snowy course.  

[h2]Season of Giving, Making, and Collecting[/h2] 

[h3]Spread the Cheer...and EventLab Creations [/h3] 

Gift the community new and amazing events with the six new props we are adding for EventLab. This new set of materials includes:  
[list] 
[*]Racing: 
[list] 
[*]Six types of curbs 
[*]Star Lights 
[*]Checkered finish line [/list][*]Walls & Fences: 
[list] 
[*]Three different race barriers 
[*]Two concrete barriers [/list][*]Signs & Flags: 
[list] 
[*]Brake markers (50, 100, 150, 200 meters) [/list] [/list] 
But that is not all! If you are looking to create seasonal events, you will be able to add festive decoration items such as: 
[list]  
[*]Decoration:  
[list] 
[*]Wooden Tree (Small, Medium, Large) featuring eight different patterns  
[*]Igloo 
[*]Houses with three different patterns 
[*]Chimney with three possible patterns [/list][*]Signs & Flags: 
[*]Winter Flag [/list] 
We are sure your Winter Wonderland creations will not disappoint us, or the Forza Horizon 5 community, so get creative with the holiday spirit! 

[h3]Secret Santa is Coming (Back) To Town[/h3] 

Secret Santa is back on this season of giving featuring the 2022 Gordon Murray Automotive T.50 and a mysterious car. 

In case you weren’t around to celebrate last year, here’s how Secret Santa works:  

Starting December 5, players can fill a meter by giving gifts to each other. Once the meter gets 50% completed, everyone will receive the T.50. And once we hit 100% completion, a secret new car will be unlocked for all players. 

Don’t miss out on the chance to unlock these two exclusive cars and to make other members of the community happy with your gifts during this holiday season! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9c7eb06d00599780a19a26a58168941376ead0dd.jpg[/img]
[h2]Run on the New Race Road and Hang New Accolades on the Tree [/h2] 

The doors of the Winter Wonderland Circuit are now open! 

Take a lap at the new Race Road available from December 5. The Circuit will be available to run in Rivals Mode from that same time that, however, you will have to wait until December 7 to sleigh on it in the Open World. 

Once Winter Wonderland ends, this new road race will become permanent in the game, however it will only be available during the Winter seasons of future series. 

New accolades are also coming to Forza Horizon 5 this series, you will be able to unlock 3 of them running the Winter Wonderland Circuit and get another one for collecting every exclusive car on the Festival Playlist.

[h2]The Fast X Car Pack [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/127b4c4b8d7fce6705c7fa95d0b50c9c96673964.png[/img]
From the big screen to your game, some of our favorite   cars from the latest installment in the Fast & Furious saga show up at the Horizon Festival. Enjoy driving Dom’s supercharged Hellcat, Dante’s custom purple Impala, and more with the Fast X Car Pack available for 9.99$ / 9.99€ / 7.99 £. 

(Not included in the Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass or Premium Edition) 

[h3]1970 Dodge Charger Fast X [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3f6d341aee7709bf72b9eb1d1702bf74b48561de.png[/img]
We can still remember how we felt when we first saw Dominic Toretto take off in this icon of the 1970s for the first time in the Fast & Furious saga. The signature black color and air scoop supercharger is the dream of many car fans all over the world!  

At a massive 980 horsepower, the 1970 Dodge Charger is well deserving of being the poster car of your garage as it is for the movie. Become the main character of your own adventures in the Horizon Festival with this Fast X version of the Dodge Charger. 

[h3]1966 Chevrolet Impala Super Sport 'Fast X' [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2b1345addc1d99f462abbbbeeab419fbc1f6ed74.png[/img]
For the evil mastermind (with gorgeous hair) that lives inside all of us, the 1966 Fast and Furious Chevrolet Impala is here in all its purple glory.  

Aside from the flamboyance and sheer size of the Impala SS, this car packs a big block V8 engine that produces 1100 bhp to take on your opponents one race at a time.  

Being custom built from a drag racer, this Impala is a unique take of an all-time classic that can now drive you to victory at the Horizon Festival. 

[h3]1973 Datsun 240Z 'Fast X' [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/606471879b49cc29e00d4f2833629a68da0fd207.png[/img]
A customized Japanese wonder takes its spot for the street race of a lifetime. The 1973 Datsun 240Z Fast X makes its way to Forza Horizon 5 in the Fast X Car Pack!  

Fitted with a widebody kit and a turbocharged engine to play the part, this car is sure to leave its mark putting its 737 bhp to work on the streets of the Horizon Festival.   

[h3]2022 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Redeye Widebody 'Fast X' [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7078a927be7b957614da7fa5a2f27106d8566289.png[/img]
Massive power from a V8, rear wheel drive, 1000 brake horsepower, the 2022 Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Redeye Widebody has all the features you are looking for in a modern muscle car.   

You might not need its power to catch a rolling bomb, but it will come in handy in your adventures through the Horizon Festival. This soon-to-be-classic muscle car looks, sounds, and drives like the powerhouse it is, being able to reach a quarter mile in just 10 seconds. 

[h3]2022 Flip Car 2.0 'Fast X' [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0cfdd931a3abc7dd782518d6200d536fd08fc653.png[/img]
A car capable of ramming into other cars and turning them upside down is exactly what we would expect from car fans’ favorite movie franchise. And now, the 2022 Fast and Furious Flip Car 2.0 Fast X is at the Horizon Festival too. 

Not only is this car unique in its shape, but its specs are nothing to ignore. This car’s V8 engine can produce 700 horsepower which will make them a protagonist in every race you enter (in a tunnel or not).  

First for Forza, this car has steering on all three axles! The rear axle is steered via a hydraulic ram and controlled by the driver and theoretically allows it to move sideways. It is a unique ride that’s a must have for lovers of cars and of the Fast & Furious franchise.

The Forzathon Shop will be hosting a huge sale on December 24 – December 26 and December 31 – January 2! 

Get cars featured as previous Festival Playlist rewards from 50-200 PTS in the Forzathon Shop on these four days of the holiday season.

We just wanted to take a moment to say a special thank you from everybody at Playground Games and Turn 10 Studios to all of you in the EventLab community who published events this year.  

You all continue to amaze us with your passion, creativity, and artistic talents with many of your creations being shared amongst the development team throughout the year. notes.title: Classic Legends and Modern Wonders Clash at the Horizon Festival
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d55bab46e4a70996a246ba93bd87f0161311caf9.jpg[/img]
The silent electric powerhouse that is the 2024 Lucid Air Sapphire makes its way through the Horizon Festival on the second week of American Automotive. 

There are many reasons to unlock this American luxury sports car, the first one is 1,234 bhp it can produce, second is how little time it takes it to go from 0 – 100 kmh: 1.89 seconds.  

Unlock this thunderstorm for 20 PTS until November 30 on the Festival Playlist.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9242555d032d159ee2c6a17c81568d356c0ef67c.png[/img]
A jury of 12 men could not condemn the 1969 Pontiac GTO Judge of anything other than being one of the very best muscle cars of the 60’s era. 

The judge captured the psychedelic trend with its funky graphics and groovy label as well as its design that stayed away from what a conventional muscle car should look like. 

But as we all know, the greatest American cars of the Rock n Roll era needed to have an engine to prove their worth on the track and the Judge’s hammering 6.5 - liter V8 sure got the job done. 

The verdict is in, the GTO Judge is an iconic muscle car that sure knows how to make a scene and it can be yours with 40 PTS on the Festival Playlist. 

Let us know what you’d like to see in Forza Horizon 5 in the future. Send your ideas and suggestions to our team through the [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url].

notes.content:

The 1966 Chevrolet Nova Super Sport is one of the muscle car era’s brightest stars and it’s showing up at the Horizon Festival during its second week!  

The 5.3 - liter V8 engine fitted in the Nova along with its AWD system that makes it a superstar racer secures a well-deserved spot in Muscle Car Mount Rushmore.  

Get a load of the power the Nova Super Sport until November 23 for 20 PTS. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d22547997e6559d7ecd005908060807e88096d28.png[/img]
As with its namesake, there will be tales told about the 1968 Pontiac Firebird for years to come. 

The uniquely designed headlights and hood hide the fire that pushes this bird forward: 343 horsepower and 430 torque brought to you by means of the enormous 6.5 - liter V8 engine fitted in this mythical beast. 

Let this classic Pontiac try to set your nights on fire for 40 PTS on this week’s Festival Playlist! 

If you have any suggestions to make the Forza Horizon 5 experience better than it has been, visit our  [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url] and let us know! 

Contact the team on the [url=http://aka.ms/THUB]Troubleshooting Hub[/url] if you see any issues with this new update or its features.

notes.title: Put the “US” in Muscle Car with American Automotive.
notes.content:
Gasoline is burning and the muscle of American car tradition bursts into the Horizon Festival with American Automotive. It’s time for the finest hot rods, pickups, muscle cars, and performance vehicles to take the roads of the Horizon Festival by storm.  

Eight of the biggest and meanest machines to ever come out of the Land of Freedom will be available to unlock in the Festival Playlist, including all-time favorite muscle cars and new performance supernovas.  

Super charge the power this series has to offer with the American Automotive Car Pack:, a gallery of four more American hot rods, pick-ups, and racers. This new Car Pack will be available for purchase from November 7.  

Get that muscle lifting with the return of the Oval Track and the addition of four new Road Racing Routes.  

The new giant inflatable football will be available to use as a prop in EventLab, as well as a new collectible to hunt for at the Horizon Festival. 

The Golden Tank Awards are back! And with them come new categories like “Best Prefab” and “Best EventLab Island  Event”. Keep reading to know how to get to choose the winners this year. 

Rev up those engines and step on the gas, 'cuz American Automotive is here to show you what the US of A has got to offer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/34cb1fe87cf3027f7a4ce93eb6803399bfa70793.png[/img]
[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes[/h2]

The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update. 
[list]
[*]Solved an issue that caused the camera to shake in EventLab Route Creation 
[*]X button to Delete Prefab has been added to the UI 
[*]Fixed an issue in which Eliminator sessions would crash if you went to EventLab Island after creating them 
[*]Fixed issues with the 1996 BMW 850 CSi’s interior speedometer and roll cage 
[*]Fixed the issue in which the 2010 Nissan Tsuru’s doors and boot would not close in ForzaVista 
[*]Fixed cosmetic issues on the 2022 Porsche Cayman GT4RS 
[*]Logo on the 2021 BMW’s rims will no longer increase in size when accelerating [/list]
You can find a list of issues we are currently investigating [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues]here[/url]. [url=https://forums.forza.net/c/troubleshooting/247]The Troubleshooting Hub[/url] is always open for you to leave any reports you have.

[h2]New Tracks and Roads to Race in[/h2]

From the mountains to the jungle, across valleys, into the sea, and inside a beloved returning track, compete in the four new routes and the returning Oval Track. 

[h3]New Road Races  [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/80a8f1b61e0c0343fa0df8ad17e918419bc23b0d.png[/img]
[i]Race on these four new routes to unlock new accolades[/i]

Experience four new road race routes, which will be permanently added to the game via this update.  

Vista del Mar Sprint (4.2 mi) will have you driving through the jungle and glancing at the sea views before wrapping up the tour at Los Jardines. 

In the Aeródromo Sprint (3.9 mi), you will visit Aeródromo en La Selva and make your way towards Mulegé, only to make a detour and finish the course towards Atlantes De Tula. 

The magnificent view of Gran Puente will be the backdrop for Marigold Sprint (3.9 mi) before you switch to the gorgeous fields of La Cordillera in this  race. 

Drive by the seaside and head towards Club de Ópalo de Fuego, then close Línea Costera Sprint (5.0 mi) at the base of La Gran Caldera. 

Completing each route will get you one of the brand-new accolades included with this update as well as winning a race on them. These routes will also appear in Rivals Mode and Horizon Open. 
 
[h3]Oval Track Is Back! [/h3]

Making its way back to the Horizon Festival after previously debuting in the High Performance series, the Oval Track will be available in freeroam during the four weeks of American Automotive’s Festival Playlist. Find the Oval Track over at the Stadium, and post a clean time to earn the respective accolade. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a0aaf9a2ba114d821790beb304ed5b3c53733484.jpg[/img]
[i]The Oval Track is back in freeroam mode! Dive deep into its center to find the brand-new football collectible.[/i]

[h2]Spice your garage up [/h2]

[h3]20 new rims by HRE[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9446403e1e982ef4c2634644bed5ead5b5f65e22.png[/img]
[i]15 new rims to customize your car collection![/i]


American Automotive could not stay behind in customization. HRE is bringing 27 rims for you to stylize your favorite cars. Get your customization on with these new kicks:

[*]HRE3D+ 
[*]P101SC 
[*]P103 
[*]P104SC 
[*]P107SC 
[*]P111SC 
[*]R101 Lightweight 
[*]RC100 
[*]RC103 
[*]RC104 
[*]Recoil with Ring 
[*]RS205M 
[*]RS208M 
[*]RS300 
[*]RS307M 
[*]S200H 
[*]TR107   [/list]
[h3]Flex Your Muscle In New Body Kits[/h3]

We have also added three Forza widebody kits to fashion some American muscle.   

A brand-new widebody kit will be added for the: 
[list]
[*]1987 Pontiac Firebird Trans AM GTA 
[*]2016 Ford Shelby GT350R 
[*]2017 Chevrolet Camaro ZL1.  [/list]
Customize a power legend and two soon-to-be classics with the new customization options available with this update. 

[h2]ASL/BSL Now in Every Horizon Story [/h2]

Taking one more step towards making Forza Horizon 5 a more accessible game, we have added BSL (British Sign Language) and ASL (American Sign Language) to the Donut Media and Icons of Speed Horizon Story chapters.  

This means every story chapter for Forza Horizon 5 to date now has ASL and BSL features.  

We are very excited to make the game more accessible for everyone who wants to experience Horizon Stories to the fullest.

[h2]American Automotive Car Pack [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a6d780487f23ec152e913c5e51d216c95c35a64f.png[/img]
Four high-octane, adrenaline-pumping, all-American vehicles are coming to the Horizon Festival this November. 

Hot rods, super cars, and pickups take over the Festival with the American Automotive Car Pack, available starting November 7 for $4.99! 

[h3]2017 Saleen S7 LM [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7de583f7f3c6946580326143e0addf3a33973acf.png[/img]
Built to celebrate the seven years of victories the original S7 had, the 2017 Saleen S7 LM is a tremendous hypercar all around.  

As one of the most remarkable examples of American car manufacturing, the S7 LM produces a staggering 1,300 bhp brought to you by a 7.0 - liter twin turbo V8 engine. It is said that the new and improved body of the S7 LM can produce enough downforce to make it able to be driven upside down in a tunnel. 

Whether you want to drive it wheel-side up or down, you cannot miss out on the storm of power the Saleen S7 LM will bring to the Horizon Festival. 

[h3]1961 DeBerti Ford Econoline ‘Shop Rod’[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d700e9fc99235376a1c949ef577c48bb02c4d500.png[/img]
When you see flames in front, you already know this custom car is going to be fast. 

Originally built to work, but customized to leave skid marks at every red light it stops, the 1961 DeBerti Ford Econoline ‘Shop Rod’ is a monstrous hot rod that can (and will) take you by surprise.  

The custom work on this van is remarkable, it has been fitted with a 5.8-liter Coyote V8 engine that puts 850 bhp on the tip of your toes.  

The only thing this van will deliver at the Horizon Festival will be Ls to every car that dares challenge it.  

[h3]2020 Chevrolet Silverado LT Trail Boss [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/20c0f7fe7017c7b6052848f240cd38aa0a28645d.png[/img]
Sporting a 5.8 - liter V8 engine, the 2020 Chevrolet Silverado LT Trail Boss wants to be your vehicle of choice when trying to have some fun in the mud.  

A two-inch lift and locking differentials help this truck switch from pavement to basically anything else seem meaningless. 

A powerful truck that can mudsling with the greatest, the Silverado LT Trail Boss makes an off-road detour sound like a great idea.

[h3]2024 Czinger 21C [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a4c76165949720df2a296dccdc4514ab0a5dbadb.png[/img]
The future is here and with it come cars designed by A.I. such as the 2024 Czinger 21C. 

Built in California, this American hypercar is built of lightweight but robust materials that are 3D printed by a computer in the most sci-fi process we have heard of. 

Even if you don’t get terms like “pareto optimization”, there’s one thing you will understand: speed & power. The 21C boasts 1,350 hp, a number we only saw on the car drawings we made as kids. 

And when all is said and done, the 21C shatters lap times and records. It clocked in 1:25:44 at Laguna Seca and it is said to reach 100 kmh in 1.9 seconds. 

Fulfill your childhood dreams driving this piece of the future, today. 

[h2]Get The Complete Racing Experience This Holiday Season[/h2]

Two unique offers are coming this Holiday Season for Forza Motorsport and Forza Horizon 5: 

Expand your driving adventures and start your racing legacy with the Forza Motorsport + Forza Horizon 5 Premium Editions Bundle that includes both complete games and their Premium Add-ons for a discounted price. 

You will also be able to purchase the Premium Add-ons Bundle that comes with all of the Add-ons for both games in one single package. 

Both bundles will be available starting November 16 and until November 30 don’t miss out on this unique opportunity. 

See you on the starting line this Black Friday! 

[h2]Autoshow Car Vouchers [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2939e7d4257aff36d0c524d921d442e539875e0f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Festival Playlist [/h2]

[i]Get your pistons pumpin' for these eight exclusive cars coming to the Festival Playlist on American Automotive.[/i]

This series we are bringing a phenomenal Festival Playlist packed with eight exclusive cars! 

Eight horsepower  maulers are waiting for you to collect those Playlist points and unlock some of America’s finest creations ever. 

Explore around the Oval Track to find the Inflatable Football collective on the first week of the Festival Playlist. Remember that you will also be able to use this collectible in your EventLab creations. 

The challenges start on November 9, start collecting and unlocking!

[h3]2023 Chevrolet Corvette Z06[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f63335b1872ed5b7f9306189d5b2518f89fb3667.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the American Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from November 9 until November 16 [/i]

The 2023 Chevrolet Corvette Z06 is an American soon-to-be legend created to change the supercar game. This Corvette is both surprisingly affordable and impeccable, being able to go toe-to-toe on the tarmac with other cars that are twice the price.  

It’s middle-mounted, massive 5.5-liter V8 engine blasts the car from 0 – 100 kmh in 2.6 seconds only. All that power does not compromise the experience of this car as its supreme grip and braking make it a dream to drive.  

The Z06 is a more affordable super car that has everything car heads around the world love with an American feel. 

[h3]1964 Plymouth Belvedere [/h3]

The shortest version of the classic Belvedere still packs a massive punch! 

The 1964 Plymouth Belvedere was fitted with a humongous 7-liter V8 engine that made this car a wonderful drag racer due to its big power and lighter weight.  

Not only gaining notoriety on the streets, the ‘64 Belvedere did a complete sweep of the 1964 Daytona NASCAR race taking all three positions. 

Relive its old glories going round the Oval Track or take it to the Street Scene and see what a classic muscle drag racer can do! 

[h3]1966 Chevrolet Nova Super Sport [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ba3c00fb3a7f78177afb9c5fa3964740fc5e1ed4.png[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the American Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from November 16 until November 23 [/i]

Some cars are born made to wave the flag, like the 1966 Chevrolet Nova, one of America’s (and the world’s) most beloved muscle cars of all time. 

The Nova’s massive 5.3 V8 engine sends power to an AWD drive system that makes it the perfect contender for the next race occurring at your nearest traffic light.  

Paying honor to its name, the Nova is one of the muscle car era’s biggest stars and completely deserving of a spot in your garage during this series. 

[h3]1968 Pontiac Firebird [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d22547997e6559d7ecd005908060807e88096d28.png[/img]
[i]Earn 40 PTS during Week 2 “Autumn” Season on the American Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from November 16 until November 23 [/i]

Nothing screams “Born in the USA” louder than the iconic headlights of a Firebird dashing in front of their opponents.  

The 1968 Pontiac Firebird does an extremely good job accomplishing this thanks to its loud and mighty 6.5 - liter V8 engine that marked what is considered muscle car peak. 

Time to set the night on fire with an icon of the 60’s, the Firebird! 

[h3]2024 Lucid Air Sapphire [/h3]

Designed in California and assembled in Arizona the 2024 Lucid Air Sapphire is the world’s first fully electric luxury super-sports car. 

The thunderous roar of petrol engines now make way for this silent electric powerhouse, challenging the traditional image of American automotive wonders. With an impressive 1,234 hp, the Lucid Air Sapphire does not hold back, sprinting to 100 km/h in just 1.89 seconds. 

The Lucid Air Sapphire makes it very clear — the definition of an American supercar will never be the same with this electric all-rounder in the game, and it will stir the competition. 

[h3]1969 Pontiac GTO Judge [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9242555d032d159ee2c6a17c81568d356c0ef67c.png[/img]
[i]Earn 40 PTS during Week 3 “Winter” Season on the American Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from November 23 until November 30 [/i]

In the 60’s race for creating the fastest car possible, the 1969 Pontiac GTO Judge is guilty of stepping up the game.  

Its exterior design captured the funky-psychedelic vibe of the era and on the inside, a hammering 6.5 - liter V8 engine that could put 365 bhp at your service. 

The verdict is in, the GTO Judge is a must have for muscle car lovers and enthusiasts of speed alike. 

[h3]2010 Rossion Q1 [/h3]

The most fun you can get from a box with the label “assembly required” has a name, and that is 2010 Rossion Q1. This unhinged DIY super car is super sizzling to be put onto the track and run like there’s no tomorrow. 

The Q1’s recommended engine, a Ford twin-turbocharged Duratec V6 engine, puts out 508 bhp and, much like its predecessor (the Noble M400), it can spew some gasping times on the track such as its 0-100 kmh clocking in at 3.4 seconds.  

This car will be available as a reward for 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist, and luckily, you will not have to lift a single wrench to start doing laps around Mexico. 

[h3]1962 Lincoln Continental [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0c815ce2e42d85df804c2a6b9f6513e775b7ff65.png[/img]
[i]Earn 40 PTS during Week 4 “Spring” Season on the American Automotive Festival Playlist. Available from November 30 until December 7 [/i]

Take a deep breath and engulf all the style of the 1962 Lincoln Continental, its not for nothing that this car was used to transport presidents and royalty alike. 

And if the outside is not enough, wait until you crack those doors open in the coolest way known to mankind: the opposite one.  

But as we all know, it’s the inside that counts the most, and what an inside does this Lincoln have! Like every other amazing icon of the era, this Continental is hiding a burly V8 that can put out 300 bhp. 

Style and speed are the bread and butter of this car, and they can be yours too for 40 PTS on the Festival Playlist. 

[h2]Golden Tank Awards [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a980ef8ca3dfcc46cdbc0b017a7be540b6dd1fdc.png[/img]
[i]You still have time to submit your creations and enter the shortlist![/i]

The time has come to applaud the creativity of our players, bow before the imagination of creators, and celebrate the many accomplishments of the Forza Horizon 5 community in the second edition of the Golden Tank Awards. 

This time around you will be able to choose who takes the award home in one of the six categories we are awarding this year:  
[list]
[*]Eventlab Creation of the Year 
[*]Most Creative Event 
[*]Best Photo Location 
[*]Best Prefab 
[*]Best EventLab Island Event 
[*]Best Race Event [/list]Choose from among the five nominees in each category and vote for the one you think deserves the prize the most! Shortlists for each category will be announced early December along with the voting method. Winners will be declared in late January. You still have a few weeks to publish your creations to be eligible for the shortlist. 

Good luck to everyone participating.  

We are once again thrilled to celebrate the effort and love the entire Forza Horizon 5 community put into the game with this event that brings us all together. May the best creations win! 

[h2]What’s next? [/h2]

We are happy tonight walking in a Winter Wonderland! 

Four holiday-themed items make their way into the Horizon Festival including the return of Secret Santa, a Stadium Makeover, new racetrack, and of course, new cars to explore the Winter Wonderland in. 

Stay tuned for more information on the Golden Tank Awards and the new rewards this season brings as Winter Wonderland Launches in Forza Horizon 5.

notes.title: Arriving in your Garage this Día de Muertos
notes.content:
More exciting cars are coming to Forza Horizon 5 as rewards for the Festival Playlist during Día de Muertos including two of Mexico’s most versatile stars, the 2010 Nissan Tsuru and the 1964 Volkswagen Sedan, as well as the completely Mexican lightweight speedster, the 2017 Vuhl 05RR. 

Additional unique challenges are also coming, such as finding and collecting 10 of the newest collectibles, the Mariachi Gas Tank, hidden all over the Horizon Festival in the Autumn Week 2 season. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7675fbe0e42ecf52e92913879bc47892d222544c.png[/img]
Take a closer look at the reward cars you will be able to unlock using your hard-earned PTS. 

[h3]1962 Ferrari 250 GT Berlinetta Lusso [/h3] 

[i]Earn 80 PTS during the Día de Muertos Festival Playlist series. Available from October 12 until November 12. [/i] 

A super model on wheels, the 1962 Ferrari 250 GT Berlinetta Lusso is a slick, cool dream of a car every boy wants to see parked in its driveway. With a body designed by Pininfarina, it is not a surprise the 250 was owned by the likes of Eric Clapton and Steve McQueen. 

With all the talk about its looks, you would almost forget it is a GT car as well. Even though it was not made for running, the Lusso sported a 3.0-liter V12 engine that could produce 240 bhp and it put them to work, earning the title of the fastest passenger car of the period. 

This jet set icon spearheaded a new era of Ferrari production cars that were built for racing and traffic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/3d2d47e313f71072a58cd05e0bf2156aae0cfaae.jpg[/img]
[h3]2010 Nissan Tsuru [/h3] 

[i]Earn 20 PTS during Week 1 “Summer” Season on the Día de Muertos Festival Playlist. Available from October 12 until October 19.[/i] 

Few cars are loved on a foreign land so much as the 2010 Nissan Tsuru is on Mexico; you can find one at almost every red light you stop at.  

They can be famously seen as taxis all over the country (specially in Mexico City) and as highly customized street racers, versatility is what makes this car great.  

Whether you are looking forward to putting neon lights underneath it and fit it with a massive wing (a classic Mexican take on this car) or just want to unlock it for its undeniable charm, an icon like the Nissan Tsuru might be the perfect way to celebrate Día de Muertos on its new home, Mexico. 

[h3]2023 Meyers Manx 2.0 [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/24180da4f089e0aa146f8c7b3022419f807e1274.png[/img]
Nothing screams “car nostalgia” more than a sand buggy running wild on its favorite terrain. And no one knew how to do that better than Meyers Manx. Lucky for us, they are back after more than 50 years with an all-new electric sand buggy that puts new EV tech on a retro body. 

While this vehicle is designed to have some fun in the sand, it does not shy away from power. The Manx 2.0 is equipped with 202 bhp which will be able to produce 240 pound-feet of torque to enjoy on any sandy landscape. 

This icon of the past is ready to get groovy at the Horizon Festival in the Autumn season. 

[h3]2022 Ford Bronco Raptor [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5351b70c81991e927cd2972f6511e6de5ebec835.png[/img]
The name may say “raptor”, but the 2022 Ford Bronco Raptor resembles a T-rex better. Massive muscle built on top of even more muscle, this all-terrain vehicle has the soul of a muscle car and the body of a mountain.   

Under the bonnet of this dino you’ll find a turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 that powers an indomitable special long travel suspension built to be put to the test any surface may bring or even jump in the air.  

Hear the mighty roar of the Bronco Raptor with 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist. 

[h3]1951 Porsche 356 SL [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7be71cd2783275cb3fc277e1dd0df7207e1c5426.png[/img]
Racing history in car form is the best way to describe the 1951 Porsche 356 SL. This vehicle has done it all. Run and win Lemans, do the Liege-Rome-Liege rally, and set an alarming number of records.   

This car was fitted with different engines and could be set to different configurations according to the race it was about to run. Notably, three different chassis of this car were fitted with a 1.2-liter engine and the only one that remained won the 1,100-cc class on Le Mans.  

One of the very first cars to run under the Porsche name, this coupe is a historical wonder worthy of any museum and even more so of your very own garage. 

[h2]What's Next? [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d726c9746af9099f9cb947da6bed062fcbbd89aa.png[/img]
The Horizon Festival welcomes the biggest and most muscular cars from American Automotive history as well as 4 new Road Racing routes that will also be available in Rivals and Horizon Open. More details to come in November!

notes.title: Forza Motorsport Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237489/e0ab552198b215d8b20e43376503aa60bf559bcf.jpg[/img]
Today is an exciting day for all of us here at Turn 10 Studios as Forza Motorsport is now officially available worldwide on Steam.

Forza Motorsport introduces the [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-builders-cup]car building focused Builders Cup Career Mode[/url] for single-player racers and [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-multiplayer]a race weekend-structured Featured Multiplayer[/url] for online competition. There’s also Free Play to create your own races using the more than 500 cars and 20 tracks in the game, and Rivals with Time Attack where you can rise the global leaderboard. 

[previewyoutube=13Qzm2qqXA4;full][/previewyoutube]
Start your racing career in Forza Motorsport by selecting one of the below bundles, each of which will allow you to build new skills and hone your race craft through competition: 

[h2]Forza Motorsport Standard Edition[/h2] 

Immerse yourself in over 500 real cars across 20 world-famous tracks, including fan favorite locations and multiple track layouts, each featuring fully dynamic time-of-day with weather and unique driving conditions.  

Out-build the competition using more than 800 performance upgrades in the all-new, fun and rewarding single-player experience, the Builders Cup Career Mode.  

Race alongside your friends in adjudicated multiplayer events with tire and fuel strategy, a race weekend inspired structure and new driver and safety ratings.  

Compete with cutting edge AI opponents, advanced physics, powerful assists, new damage and dirt accumulation systems and photorealistic visuals with real-time ray tracing on-track.

If you have any ideas for future cars, tracks or gameplay features, [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]let us know on the Suggestions Hub[/url]. We’ve also [url=http://aka.ms/FMGetStarted]updated our Forza Support site[/url] with a host of new resources to help you get started with the game, including a [url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/21456702310931-Known-Issues-Forza-Motorsport]Known Issues tracker[/url] which will be frequently updated. 

[h2]Live Content[/h2]

Look out for the 2022 Subaru BRZ in Track Day available now, the 2020 KTM X-Bow GT2 in Built to Race available starting October 12, the 2014 Ferrari FXX K in Track Exotics available starting October 19, and the 2019 Ginetta #6 Team LNT Ginetta G60-LT-P1 in Prototype Power available starting October 26. Also, if you’re looking to bring your favorite upgraded cars into both Career Mode and Featured Multiplayer, check out the Open Tour and Open Class Series, respectively. In October, the Open Tour celebrates German manufacturers, while the online Open Class Series allows you to bring the upgraded car of your choice within the designated class.

notes.title: A New Hot-Hatch Appears at the Horizon Festival with an Eletric Twist
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2004e220b6bcbf913819f171d79a669cd2c23550.jpg[/img]
The 2022 BMW i4 eDrive40  is BMW’s very first completely electric powered hatchback. Following suit to the German brand’s legacy, the eDrive40 is a rear-wheel drive street racer eager to shock the roads.  

Although it’s an EV, this car’s 335 bhp motor will leave you stunned as you see it take from 0 – 100 km/h in just about 4 seconds, not bad for what’s thought to be BMWs entry level electric model. 

The i4 is a true testament to putting a modern touch on the speed and precision legacy that we are used to seeing in a premier brand like BMW. 

Unlock this marvelous ride from October 5 until October 12 with 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist. 

If you’d like to see something special added to the Horizon Festival, let us know through the [url=http://aka.ms/SHUB]Suggestions Hub[/url].

notes.title: Celebrate Día de Muertos Horizon Style
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5185f8f0117eb98bda18b20c54bcf6f9d781aeb0.png[/img]
The unique smell of Autumm has a particular scent in Mexico, its one that indicates the return of our loved ones on the night of Día de Muertos. This iconic Mexican tradition has hit the Horizon Festival bringing huge surprises to celebrate the season.  

Along with dressing Mulegé with the traditional colors and decorations of the holiday, you will be able to celebrate with the Día de Muertos Dress & Suit that we will be giving away on November 2.   

Since we are celebrating one of Mexico’s most emblematic traditions, this new update also brings one of the biggest and most versatile automotive icons of the country, the 2010 Nissan Tsuru, into the Horizon Festival. The Tsuru is the community’s most requested car to date on our Suggestions Hub with over 4,000 votes and introducing it to Forza Horizon 5 has been an unforgettable journey for us. It all started thanks to you, our players! From sourcing a pristine-quality model to preparing it for you to drive around Mexico, we’re so excited to introduce this eagerly awaited and iconic car for our community to enjoy and we can’t wait to see what you do with it.  

Get ready for track day as the Super Speed Car Pack becomes available for purchase on October 10. This new Car Pack features speedsters from the modern era including the 2022 Volkswagen Golf R, 2022 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS, 2020 KTM X-Bow GT2, and the 2019 Elemental RP1.  

Get your ofrendas and Pan de Muerto ready to celebrate the mythic Day of the Dead from October 10 until November 10 with this new, free update for Forza Horizon 5.  

[h2]Release Notes & Game Fixes[/h2] 
[list] 
[*]The following list details some of the fixes and changes we are implementing with this new update.  
[*]Fixed props in EventLab moving randomly when in placement mode.  
[*]EventLab Prefab thumbnail won’t change to prop image when trying to move or copy that Prefab.  
[*]EventLab Island Event map pin image will always show on the map and mini map.  
[*]Snap nodes will no longer disappear when moving pieces.  
[*]Fixed EventLab Island displaying black textures when playing through Cloud Gaming.  
[*]Players will be sent to EventLab Island when choosing an event that takes place there.  
[*]Fixed an issue where Attachment Nodes stopped working for other props.   
[*]2021 BMW M3 exterior windows can now be tinted.  
[*]2021 BMW M4 has the correct driver position.  
[*]Fixed issues with the 2018 BMW M5 AC Schitzner and 2015 BMW i8 AC Schnitzer widebody kits.  
[*]1996 BMW 850CSi vinyl mapping issues when using bodykits. [/list]You can find a list of issues we are[url=https://support.forzamotorsport.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409616884883-FH5-Known-Issues] currently investigating here[/url]. Report any issues you encounter with this update and others in the [url=https://forums.forza.net/c/troubleshooting/247]Troubleshooting Hub[/url]. 

[h2]Día de Muertos takes over the Horizon Festival [/h2] 

Forza Horizon 5 is thrilled to host a massive celebration of one of the most important Mexican traditions and holidays: Día de Muertos. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b4a5222e85861f3e75e78a7ade34d922c739920f.jpg[/img]
On this magical day, spirits of our loved ones come back to say hello for one night and to enjoy a feast specially created for them, and while they are busy eating the snacks on their ofrenda, you will be too enjoying our unique celebration. 

[h3]Flowers and Decorations over Mulegé [/h3] 

Mulegé knows how to get down for Día de Muertos. For the entire duration of the four weeks of the Festival Playlist, you will be able to spot Día de Muertos-themed decorations such as Alebrijes, inflatable skulls (calaveritas), and other details to get in for the festivities.   

Admire the unique colors and shapes that will be created by the Día de Muertos Drone Show that will make an appearance on Día de Muertos Nights over the Mulegé night sky.  

[h3]EventLab Props & Collectibles [/h3] 

During the second week of the Festival Playlist, you will be able to snatch an icon of Mexican folklore and tradition. Sing away and collect the Mariachi Tank Piñata! Along with this fabulous new prop, 15 new colorful objects will be available in the EventLab Blueprint Builder to create thematic events. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/55d410801931c6ba3de471726bb3c8c25f5e69a4.png[/img]
Under the “Decorations” tab, you will see: 
[list] 
[*]Marigold Stall 
[*]Orange/Blue Inflatable Skulls 
[*]Dog Alebrije 
[*]Yellow & Blue Armadillo Alebrijes 
[*]Red & Yellow Armadillo Alebrijes 
[*]Red & Blue Armadillo Alebrijes 
[*]Ram Alebrije 
[*]Chicken Alebrije 
[*]Dragon Alebrije 
[*]Bipedal Alebrije [/list]Click on the “Horizon Story” tab to find:
[list] 
[*]Yellow Día de Muertos Barrier 
[*]Purple Día de Muertos Barrier [/list]And finally, the Mariachi Tank Piñata will be available to use under the “Gameplay” tab. 

[h3]Suit up for the Season [/h3] 

Not only will the Horizon Festival change its appearance to celebrate Día de Muertos, but you can also follow suit with the new cosmetics we are giving away in this series. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8431ee6f13125c291e462437364afe103fe19100.png[/img]
Starting November 2, you will receive the Día de Muertos Suit & Dress in your in-game Message Center: two different outfits with very traditional looks that will let your character wear the colors of the festivities and match the surroundings of the Horizon Festival.  

And to celebrate the newest milestone for the Forza franchise, we will be giving away the Forza Motorsport Outfit when the new Forza Motorsport launches for everyone on October 10. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/98c61d247e9fcc8de3decd6f31f455fbff8c047c.jpg[/img]
You will be able to redeem these three presents from your “Gifts” tab on the Message Center. Stay tuned and unlock them as soon as you receive the notification. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440510/Forza_Motorsport/

[h2]New Achievements [/h2] 

Día de Muertos brings 12 new achievements for you to obtain in this new update. Compete, collect, and complete different challenges to obtain them all. Here is the Iist of the new achievements coming with on Día de Muertos: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c79bb1eae5614c8675f07c175e28e78806a43a7d.png[/img]
[i]Unlock 12 new achievements coming to Forza Horizon 5 on October 10!_[/i]
[table]
[tr][th][b]Gamerscore [/b][/th][th][b]Title [/b][/th][th][b]Description [/b][/th][/tr]
[tr][td]10 [/td][td]Get My Good Side  [/td][td]Take a photo of your character outside a car [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]10 [/td][td]Juuuuust Right [/td][td]Take a photo using any guidelines 3 times [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]15 [/td][td]Timeless  [/td][td]Take a photo at every time setting [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]10 [/td][td]On the Road Again  [/td][td]Complete the first chapter of the Donut Media HiLow Story [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]20 [/td][td]Hi Five [/td][td]Complete all chapters of the Donut Media Hi Story [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]20 [/td][td]Low Five  [/td][td]Complete all chapters of the Donut Media Low Story [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]30 [/td][td]Give it the Beans! [/td][td]Earn 3 Stars on all chapters of both Hi and Low stories [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]20 [/td][td]Back To School  [/td][td]Complete the first chapter in the Icons of Speed Story [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]20 [/td][td]A New Era [/td][td]Complete all chapters in the Icons of Speed Story [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]30 [/td][td]A True Icon [/td][td]Earn 3 Stars in all chapters of the Icons of Speed Story [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]20 [/td][td]Give Me Five! [/td][td]Apply and purchase an upgrade to 5 cars at the Horizon Test Track [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]20 [/td][td]Leaving Tracks [/td][td]Drive 50 miles (80.5km) at the Horizon Test Track [/td][/tr]
[tr][td]10 [/td][td]Maxing Out  [/td][td]Maintain a speed of 200mph (321.8km/h) for 10 seconds at the Horizon Test Track [/td][/tr]
[/table]
[h2]Tsuru Gets Thrashing [/h2] 

The 2010 Nissan Tsuru is coming to Forza Horizon 5 not only as an unlockable reward in the Festival Playlist, it is now also a new starter option for The Eliminator. Next time you enter this battle royale game mode, you will be able to start the competition behind the wheel of the Tsuru. Good luck becoming the last car standing! 

[h2]A New Perspective for Drifting [/h2] 

The newest feature to improve your Horizon Festival experience is here: experience the brand-new Drift Camera feature available for the Chase View. Access this feature through “HUD and Gameplay” in the Settings Menu. You will be able to tweak and customize your experience by changing different settings. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1f65237509ba06cc5b817eecfa6cd012dc1449ed.jpg[/img]
Adjusting the sensitivity of the camera will modify the ratio of car angle to camera angle. Reducing the Look Speed setting will smooth out the camera’s movement due to changes in direction. Finally, the Drift Camera Range changes how the camera moves when the car is at peak angle. 

[h2]Super Speed Car Pack [/h2] 

A brand-new Car Pack is hitting Forza Horizon 5! These four super-powered cars are here to do what they do best: lift some dust. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5ef8d83fe04d12c46c61e0eb970c38775b3c9d04.jpg[/img]
Plan your ideal track day and race away with the vehicles available in the Super Speed Car Pack. 

[h3]2022 Volkswagen Golf R [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2b616839928b1c6bcd1d987eb4100eb1d5b4202b.png[/img]
What you are looking at right now is not only an amazingly fun hatchback ready to deliver a supercar experience on a budget ride, but the 2022 Volkswagen Golf R also the most powerful Golf ever produced and its 2.0-liter engine with 315 hp are here to prove It.  

As the race car that it is, the Golf R is built with an AWD system and a magnificent braking system that makes it swift and nimble entering and exiting the tightest of corners.   

Make this car feel right at home by driving it along the twistiest, bendiest, craziest tracks you can find at the Horizon Festival. 

[h3]2022 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d0f8ecfbbd87cf78fbc3cf67f7a2a42a4a71967e.png[/img]
The most exciting part of the 2022 Porsche 718 Cayman GT4 RS is the “GT” in its name. This means this car was designed with the intention of performing as best as it could on the track and outside of it. And the Porsche engineers really delivered on that purpose.   

The GT4 RS was fitted with the same engine that you can find on the 911 GT3 with the slight distinction that it is now fitted in the middle. So you will now be delighted by the delicious noise that comes out of its naturally aspirated, 4-liter flat six that produces a monstrous 493 bhp. 

And to add up to the improvements made on this machine, the stiffer suspension and heavily improved aerodynamics will make this one of the strongest candidates for your favorite track toy. 

[h3]2020 KTM X-Bow GT2 [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5e358abe5745232a8bc749d8cc1386dc5c426755.png[/img]
Lean, precise, and lethal on the tarmac, the 2020 KTM X-Bow is the ideal weapon of choice for drivers having a go on the track.  

Its Audi 5-cylinder turbocharged engine puts you in charge of 600 bhp, combine those stats with its incredibly light weight and you get an explosively fast vehicle that will cut through raceways like butter.  

The X-Bow is locked and loaded to pierce through the competition at the Horizon Festival on the Super Speed Car Pack. 

[h3]2019 Elemental RP1 [/h3] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/485be6253929a6155e88c63c75bbb189dab5887b.png[/img]
When you get behind the driver’s seat of a 2019 Elemental RP1 you are trading a windshield for massive amounts of speed. And we believe that is a good trade.   

Every bit of this car, including the driving position, was thought of and designed to make the car lighter, more aerodynamic, and, of course, much faster than any other you could meet on the track. The RP1 is said to generate as much downforce as an F1 car.  

And all of the weight goes into the most important part: the engine. This car produces a whopping 370bhp through its 2.3L Ford Ecoboost turbocharged engine. Paired up with its 1,000 kg total weight and this car can blast from 0 – 100 km/h in just 2.7 seconds  

A unique ride that can finish a lap in the blink of an eye, the RP1 is a statement on racing and versatility. 

[h2]What's Next? [/h2] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d726c9746af9099f9cb947da6bed062fcbbd89aa.png[/img]
The Horizon Festival welcomes the biggest and most muscular cars from American Automotive history as well as 4 new Road Racing routes that will also be available in Rivals and Horizon Open. More details to come in November!

notes.title: A BMW Staple Comes Back Faster and Stronger
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/72628e3eb75fa201bc981553ce1f9af97b44c724.jpg[/img]
BMW’s signature coupé looks bigger than ever. Get a hold of the 2023 BMW M2 on the third week of Horizon Creatives. 

This fierce-looking version of the M2 was designed in Mexico by Mexican designer José Casas; we figure he had “how to go faster” on his mind while he made his early sketches.  

The result is a completely mad car equipped with a 3.0 - liter straight 6 –cylinder engine capable of sprinting from 0 – 100 km/h in 4.2 seconds that looks like the powerhouse it is.  

Unlock the M2 from September 28 until Octobre 5 by earning 20 PTS on the Festival Playlist.
