notes.title: Reach Peak Performance in Mexico with the 2010 Renault Clio R.S.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7a42277ae8685c8cffcf7fd4060b6df32275e4ed.jpg[/img]

The final week of[b] #FORDzathon[/b] has arrived, however don’t worry, there’s plenty of events and rewards to dig into, including the [b]2010 Renault Clio R.S.[/b] which brings the precise, sporty and efficient perks of the Clio line to a whole new level. It packs a 2.0-liter 16-valve engine with Brembo brake calipers, as well as upgraded suspension with widened front and rear tracks to deliver stable and grippy handling. The TLDR is that there’s no better investment for getting around Mexico with ease. 

Here’s what you can unlock until [b]Thursday, February 2[/b]: 
[list]
[*][b]20 PTS:[/b] 2010 Renault Clio R.S. 
[*][b]40 PTS:[/b] 2017 Ford #14 Rahal Letterman Lanigan Racing GRC Fiesta [/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8f403585aa26865a2d6d480c4f04b095bed55605.jpg[/img]

This week is also your final chance to set clean lap times in the [b]Monthly Rivals[/b] and [b]Forza EV[/b] events spotlighting Ford’s engineering prowess, and to unlock the overall [b]#FORDzathon[/b] series rewards: 
[list]
[*][b]80 PTS:[/b] 2021 MG MG6 XPower  
[*][b]160 PTS:[/b] 1965 Hoonigan GYMKHANA 10 Ford Hoonicorn Mustang [/list]An iconic Rally Legend awaits in the [b]Weekly Forzathon Challenge[/b], the [b]1977 Ford #5 Escort RS1800 MKII[/b]. Built to Group 4 spec, it won the first World Rally Championship for drivers in 1979, and it can achieve some great airtime taking your rally beast to new heights! 

Over in the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b], look out for the [b]1965 Hoonigan Ford "Hoonicorn" Mustang[/b] and the [b]2014 Ford #11 Rockstar F-150 Trophy Truck[/b], as well as the [b]Doom E1M1 High Car Horn[/b] and [b]Senkoe's Tank Top[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/79ba420dbbed74298d22a812dbda7651a25a11a9.jpg[/img]

Get your Focus on in [b]The Trial[/b]! You’ll be mastering the [b]2017 Ford Focus RS[/b] to win a[b] 1992 Ford Escort RS Cosworth[/b]. Meanwhile, the [b]Seasonal Playground Games[/b] has [b]Team King[/b] in the spotlight and a [b]1985 Ford RS200 Evolution[/b] up for grabs. 

A trio of [b]Super Wheelspins[/b] can be yours in the [b]Seasonal PR Stunts[/b]. Build your best Ford car to S1 class and push it to the limit in the [b]Bypass Speed Trap[/b], the [b]Atlantes De Tula Speed Zone[/b] and the [b]Cannonball Danger Sign[/b]. Another [b]Super Wheelspin [/b]can be yours from the [b]Nexus View Speed Trap[/b] on [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b]. 

This week’s [b]Seasonal Championship[/b] rewards include [b]2020 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500[/b] in [b]Track Time[/b], the [b]2011 Ford F-150 SVT Raptor[/b] in [b]Grass Routes[/b] and the [b]1965 Ford Mustang GT Coupe[/b] in [b]Shelby Street[/b]. You can also win the [b]2011 Ford Transit SuperSportVan [/b]from the [b]Sightseeing [/b]event on [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] and check out [b]Horizon Tour[/b] to earn some additional PTS for the Festival Playlist. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c9b3e1d281f65195d44f07f69d16479eca9f7eee.jpg[/img]

[b]Photograph[/b] the [b]1965 Ford Mustang GT Coupe[/b] at [b]Uxmal[/b] to complete this week’s[b] Photo Challenge[/b] and unlock a [b]Wheelspin[/b]. You can also grab the [b]2020 Ford Super Duty F-450 DRW PLATINUM[/b] by proving your mastery of cars in the [b]Super7 Challenge[/b]! 

That’s a wrap on [b]#FORDzathon[/b] in Forza Horizon 5! Next week, we’ll be back with details on the events and challenges that await in the next series. Until then, we’ll see you at the Horizon Festival. 

Got feedback to share on the Festival Playlist or Forza Horizon 5? [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5ce2657a4f6178a5942645daa8efd6e465a477ef.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Push Your Driving to the Limit in #FORDzathon
notes.content:
[h3]Happy New Year! We hope you all had a wonderful holiday break and shared the joy of food, presents and playing video games with your friends and family.[/h3]

While the celebrations may be over, your 2023 driving adventures are already warming up as Mexico presents #FORDzathon, the latest series available now in Forza Horizon 5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9e71f6120c5ecde5c784044e10ceda0ad70df07f.jpg[/img]

Get ready for four weeks of Ford themed events and rewards on the Festival Playlist with some unique challenges along the way. You’ll experience the incredible impact Ford has made on automotive culture across Seasonal Championships, The Trial, Forzathon, Horizon Open, Photo Challenges and Seasonal PR Stunts.

In our Monthly Rivals, set your fastest lap time on the Horizon Baja Scramble while behind the wheel of the 2017 Ford #14 Rahal Letterman Lanigan Racing GRC Fiesta. Meanwhile, on Emerald Circuit, Forza EV showcases the incredible all-electric 2021 Ford Mustang Mach-E 1400, developed in collaboration between Ford Performance and RTR Vehicles, founded by Formula Drift champion Vaughn Gittin Jr.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8f403585aa26865a2d6d480c4f04b095bed55605.jpg[/img]

We’re also bringing back the Floating Lanterns collectibles in celebration of the New Year. These are available now through January 12. You’ll need to smash 50 of them to complete the Festival Playlist challenge and unlock “Nocturne” by Keeno for Horizon Mixtape. We recommend checking them out at night-time to see their illuminated glow.

In addition to the Ford reward cars, we’re also introducing two new-to-franchise cars and three cars returning from previous Forza games. Check them out!

[h3]2021 MG MG6 XPower[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/de0553c5be1cabf91b3324afa3f6e0a410420a3e.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 80 PTS in the #FORDzathon Festival Playlist series. Available from Jan. 5 – Feb. 2.[/i]

The 2021 MG MG6 XPower unleashes the true capabilities of the MG6 lineup with a straight-four 1.5-liter direct-injection turbocharged engine that’s fused with a high-power synchronous electric motor. The combined outputs of both give this plug-in hybrid a solid 300 horsepower, and it’s capable of reaching 62mph from zero in just six seconds. What’s more, the front-wheel-drive car has a combined peak torque of 354 lb-ft and a 10-speed electric drive gearbox while the wide grippy tires, unique elastic suspension, large shock absorbers and a stiffer spring stabilizer bar extends the car for more rigid, durable and extreme driving, so it’s the ideal machine for your next Forza Horizon 5 adventure. Its brakes are even racing grade with an innovative brake disc and upgraded front and rear caliper system bringing the car from 62mph to standstill in a short 33-meter sprint! These incredible numbers are paired with an aggressive eye-catching design as the sporty looks of the ultra-wide body aerodynamic kit and carbon fiber rear spoiler cement MG’s racing legacy all over this XPower, so you always know you’re in control of a beast and a truly modern interpretation of racing DNA!

[h3]2010 Renault Megane RS 250[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8a9eb462ebe70455a763e1e4cd22e42d95ed3b19.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Summer “Wet” Season on the #FORDzathon Festival Playlist. Available from Jan. 5 – Jan. 12.[/i]

Quintessentially French, the Renault Megane RS250 combines a serious helping of Renaultsport’s tuning expertise with the already stylish Megane. The blacked-out grille is the first clue this is not a run-of-the-mill Renault, and if you weren’t convinced right away you could peer at the red-painted brake calipers or the bright, yellow-faced tachometer for further confirmation. A twin-scroll turbocharger boosts output to a remarkable 250 horsepower, considering that the engine is only 2 liters. So, it’s perhaps no surprise that this fast Megane gets out of its own way with an emphatic bark from the center-exit sport exhaust. The RS250’s stiffened sport suspension also hunches the hatch down low over larger alloy wheels, improving the stance and the cornering at the same time. That’s not just lip service—the RS250 has some serious moves, helped in part by a limited-slip differential and an electrically assisted variable power steering system to keep the front wheels from churning under the ample torque.

[h3]2020 MG #20 MG6 XPower[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c593274a7c3a9535c91239e23769ad2875ca7c5d.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Autumn “Storm” Season on the #FORDzathon Festival Playlist. Available from Jan. 12 – Jan. 19.[/i]

Sure, the road-going version of this car is your overall reward for the #FORDzathon series; however, the racecar variant isn’t anything to snuff at. The great news is that it’s also coming to Forza Horizon 5, so you can have the best of both worlds. In addition to the special racecar livery, you’ll even get a boost to performance with a 350-horsepower front-wheel-drive output. It has a six-speed sequential gearbox, and the car utilizes a dual master cylinder brakes system with four-piston calipers reaching the front brakes and two-piston calipers sent to the rear brakes. Take it out to the Horizon Festival Circuit and set your fastest lap times so you can experience how nice it is to drive! Maybe you'll impress Tío Forza.

[h3]2016 Renault Clio R.S. 16 Concept[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2df8755f237424da7264fb34b8352406aa7d37af.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Winter “Dry” Season on the #FORDzathon Festival Playlist. Available from Jan. 19 – Jan. 26.[/i]

Is it stripped down due to the lack of air-conditioning and a back seat, or is it loaded since it’s packed with performance from the Renault parts bin? Disregarding the semantics and getting straight to the spec sheet delivers a clearer judgement. Renault has taken the 271-horsepower turbo four-cylinder from the Megane RS 275 Trophy-R model, along with key suspension and braking components and then stuffed them into the small package of the Clio. With the appropriate flare of the Clio Cup rear diffuser, a stout aero kit and actual flares to contain the massive 19-inch wheels this Concept has properly celebrates the 40th anniversary of the much-loved RS model.

[h3]2010 Renault Clio R.S.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7a42277ae8685c8cffcf7fd4060b6df32275e4ed.jpg[/img]
[i]Earn 20 PTS during the Spring “Hot” Season on the #FORDzathon Festival Playlist. Available from Jan. 26 – Feb. 2.[/i]

Celebrating 20 years on the market as “the small car with big-car attributes,” the Clio has been a top-selling compact, replacing the Renault 5 line. While the Clio has always been appreciated by its exacting owners as precise, sporty and efficient, the Clio RS takes it to a new level. The 2.0 liter 16-valve is peppy and, thanks to its Brembo brake calipers, it will start and stop with the best in its class. Its distinctive nose is endearing and may even prompt others to grin back at it. The Clio RS suspension has been upgraded with widened front and rear tracks which deliver stable and grippy handling. At nearly twice the cost of a base Clio, you can rest assured the additional investment has been put to good use with your performance pleasure in mind.

[h2]What's Next[/h2]

The next Forza Horizon 5 series update celebrates Japanese Automotive by introducing new cars, a new collectible and new EventLab props in the Blueprint Builder. Stay tuned for more details later this month.

notes.title: Forza Horizon 5 is a sea of Hoonigans following the death of Ken Block
notes.content:
After learning of the death of Ken Block, Forza Horizon 5 players have been paying tributes to the rally star from within the open-world racing game.

Block, who was killed at the age of 55 after a snowmobile accident, was one of the most famous names in rallying thanks to his stunt-filled videos on YouTube and social media making him a viral sensation. Off the back of his stardom, Block started his own rally team which came to be known as Hoonigan Racing Division, and over the years many modern rally cars and souped up classics have proudly worn the Hoonigan name.

Many of these cars feature in Forza Horizon 5, and the game is now awash with Hoonigans as players pay their respects to Block.

notes.title: Ring in the New Year Bells with a V8 Muscle Machine
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ed82bf7346a2ddf0db6e1460ef5c2818a4de79af.jpg[/img]
 
The New Year is almost upon us – we're counting the days until the firework celebrations – and in Forza Horizon 5, we have a new week of events and rewards, as well as another exclusive Forzathon Shop sale that you don’t want to miss. Before we jump in, remember that you can [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaForums]discuss this week’s events and rewards over on the Forza Forums[/url] and we’re always open to your feedback, be sure to [url=https://aka.ms/SuggestionsHub]share your ideas for future content on the Suggestions Hub[/url].

And what better way to celebrate than with an incredible V8 muscle machine. This week you can unlock the [b]1970 AMC Rebel 'The Machine'[/b] with its flamboyant red, white, and blue paint scheme that made as much of a statement as its 340-horsepower V8. From the factory this Rebel was poised as a street legal drag race car and could run mid-14s in the quarter mile, while the distinctive ram-air hood scoop and hood-mounted tachometer contributed to its performance-minded attitude.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ad24f444f4cd1d1db67eeef50ee9d35aba9a8694.jpg[/img]

By earning [b]20 PTS[/b] on this week’s[b] Festival Playlist[/b], you can expand your garage with this delightfully different muscle car from AMC, a manufacturer notorious for taking on the big three in its own way with performance that could give the big boys a run for their money. Now you can prove that it’s the definitive pony car in Forza Horizon 5 – see you at the drag strip!

As a reminder, this week is your last chance to participate in our [b]Monthly Rivals[/b] and [b]Forza EV[/b] events, as well as unlock the overall Horizon Holidays series rewards. You have until [b]Thursday, January 5[/b] to get your hands on these cars, as well as the rewards discussed in this blog:
[list]
[*][b]80 PTS:[/b] 2022 Extreme E #22 JBXE
[*][b]160 PTS:[/b] 2014 Ferrari California T[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0127d943f832f8cbe7a404dc3e0446c6de329455.jpg[/img]

Here’s a look at the new cars for this week:
[list]
[*][b]20 PTS:[/b] 1970 AMC Rebel 'The Machine'
[*][b]40 PTS:[/b] 1995 Porsche 911 Carrera 2 by Gunther Werks[/list]Flex those muscles with the most powerful muscle car in production, the [b]2018 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon[/b]. Purpose-built for drag racing with a supercharged 6.2-liter Hemi V8 under the hood, the 840 horses are certain to get you across every finish line faster than your competitors will realize. It’s also rare too, with only 3,300 ever produced. Celebrate this iconic car that harkens back to the legendary pony days in the [b]Weekly Forzathon Challenge[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2c57d02ce15457540bd985dc25d846470960181a.jpg[/img]

Where to spend those [b]Forzathon Points[/b], you ask? The [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] of course! Look out for the [b]2009 Pagani Zonda Cinque Roadster[/b] and the [b]2015 Mercedes-Benz #24 Tankpool24 Racing Truck[/b], as well as the [b]Green Suit Outfit[/b], the [b]Yellow Sundress[/b] and the [b]Clock Tower[/b] car horn.

Ring in the New Year with an [b]exclusive Forzathon Shop sale[/b] available from [b]2:30 PM UTC[/b] on [b]Dec. 31[/b] until [b]2:30 PM UTC[/b] on [b]Jan 2[/b]. The high-performance cars on discount include the[b] 2016 Pagani Huayra BC Forza Edition[/b], the [b]2013 Ferrari 458 Speciale[/b], the [b]2010 Jaguar C-X75[/b] and the [b]2016 Audi R8 V10 plus[/b]. Don’t miss out!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e0bf274255b578bd9ba3f8e2fe6f757323ac598c.jpg[/img]

It’s a Holiday Rush in [b]The Trial[/b] this week, so you better overtake those Drivatars to make it home in time for the New Year festivities and of course, unlock a shiny [b]2015 Audi TTS Coupé[/b] on your travels.

We 3 Kings come together for [b]Seasonal Playground Games [/b]exclusively featuring [b]Team King[/b]. Your participation will be rewarded with the [b]2008 BMW Z4 M Coupe[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a259c0383d9e9ba2de3d1adc5a0a8436e2290a82.jpg[/img]
 
Three[b] Super Wheelspins [/b]await in this week’s [b]Seasonal PR Stunts[/b]. Take on the [b]Heights of Mulegé Danger Sign[/b], the [b]La Subida Speed Zone[/b] and the [b]Sand and Deliver Trailblazer[/b]. As always, [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] has a fourth to complete with another [b]Super Wheelspin[/b] up for grabs in the [b]Ice Crash Danger Sign[/b].

Expand your garage with three new cars courtesy of [b]Seasonal Championships[/b]. Get the [b]2002 Chevrolet Corvette Z06[/b] in [b]Feliz Navidad[/b], the [b]2016 Cadillac ATS-V[/b] in [b]New Beginnings[/b] and the [b]2017 Jaguar F-PACE S[/b] in [b]Down for the Countdown[/b]. You can also obtain the [b]2018 Mercedes-Benz X-Class[/b] from [b]By The Fire[/b] over on [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8b62bd1fcc939cb866a67caadef2c8cb975bc818.jpg[/img]

[b]Horizon Tour[/b] is back on the Festival Playlist, so team up with your friends and the community for a road-trip across Mexico.

It’s [b]Photo Challenge[/b] time! This week, you’re tasked to photograph the [b]Snowman[/b] at the [b]Buena Esperanza Player House[/b] near [b]Ek' Balam[/b] to unlock the [b]Sad Snowman Head[/b] for your wardrobe. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/28c3ffea915eb3cca59c728d732ed6d3a84246dc.jpg[/img]

Lastly, the [b]Horizon Super7[/b] is featuring the [b]2016 Formula Drift #530 HSV Maloo Gen-F[/b] as a reward for those who successfully take on all seven [b]Challenge Cards[/b]!

That’s it for Horizon Holidays. We wish you all a happy and safe New Year! Enjoy the celebrations and we’ll see you in 2023 for the next Forza Horizon 5 series, [b]#FORDzathon[/b]. Remember, there won’t be a content update to download for this one as all the necessary reward cars and events were included in the previous update. With that said, thanks for your continued support and we’ll see you in Mexico!

notes.title: Available NOW and FREE! The 2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/149b90b82d76c802c27f0189d63d2f15e1d4c821.jpg[/img]
 
You’ve done it! Thanks to the generosity of the Forza Horizon 5 community, this year’s [b]Secret Santa[/b] has been an incredible success and your reward is now unlocked.

It’s none other than the [b]2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster[/b], the Italian manufacturer's first open-top hybrid supercar to feature a supercapacitor and an incomparable 800-horsepower V12 that is at the top of its class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5c69ba2c4e306edf0cf1ce5afeeb45034a56d6b0.jpg[/img]

The [b]2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadste[/b]r has been unlocked for all players, for FREE. Even if you didn’t participate in Secret Santa, log in to Forza Horizon 5 and check the [b]“Gifts”[/b] tab of the [b]Message Center[/b] to download this incredible all-wheel-drive hybrid supercar built with meticulous attention to detail, very fine materials and an ultralight body.

While only 19 models are planned for the real world, the festive spirit of all our wonderful drivers at the Horizon Festival has ensured that you can experience the most powerful Lamborghini engine yet, capable of 217mph with electrified intensity, in Forza Horizon 5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/9612ec7b65e4721ba2d1a823979be6169994e317.jpg[/img]
 
Spread the joy by visiting the [b]Horizon Wonderland[/b] in [b]Mulegé[/b] where our community might have left another gift with your name on it. Here you can also give a car from the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] to another player, once per week, during the [b]Horizon Holidays[/b]. You can also share an endless number of cars using the [b]Gift Drops[/b] feature.

The [b]2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster[/b] takes hybrid technology to the next level with its unique and innovative use of a supercapacitor. It also has futuristic design features, such as sculptured contours, distinct aero wings and aluminum details painted in Oro Electrum, a special type of gold paint chosen by Lamborghini to indicate their hybrid cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/93fad12c89bb67c1a135759ac9f6f1ddfe78d50f.jpg[/img]

Check out the car in Forza Horizon 5! Thanks for playing the game, thanks to the community for their incredible support and being so incredibly generous for this year’s Secret Santa.

Discuss the 2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaForums]over on the Forza Forums[/url] and visit the Suggestions Hub where you can [url=https://aka.ms/SuggestionsHub]vote on the cars you would like to see added in future Forza Horizon 5 updates[/url].

notes.title: Give Your Car the Rocket Bunny Makeover It Deserves
notes.content:
With last month’s release of the Donut Media update, mechanics at the Horizon Festival began offering 21 Rocket Bunny kits for drivers to fit onto their cars. There’s no better way to express yourself around Mexico’s Street Scene than with a new body kit, and luckily for you, there’s plenty to choose from. 

How do I fit a Rocket Bunny kit onto my car in Forza Horizon 5? 
[list]
[*]Drive one of the 20 vehicles that feature a Rocket Bunny kit. [url=https://aka.ms/RocketBunnyList]Click here to find the full list of supported vehicles[/url]. 
[*]Enter any Horizon Festival Outpost or Player House 
[*]Navigate to the “Tuning & Upgrades” menu and select “Body Kits & Presets.” 
[*]From there you can fit the Rocket Bunny kit and install both the visual and performance upgrades in a single transaction! [/list]Check out the below gallery for a snapshot of the Rocket Bunny kits you can fit onto your cars in Forza Horizon 5: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/04176022b55ed38ce60e41d2cdbee943e50df094.jpg[/img]
[i]Two BMW M3s. Two Rocket Bunny kits. One impossible choice. Red or blue. Which of the iconic duo are you drifting on the streets of Mexico? [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/22ef419edfcca7346816d8896a5ecbef68e5adc5.jpg[/img]
[i]Expressive doesn't even begin to describe this transformation. Get your 2015 Lexus RC F fitted with a Rocket Bunny kit, and everyone at the festival will take note of your car. After all, that’s the reason to fit a large spoiler onto any car, right? [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a01098050b6c5e0e11a6170574b9268761afd597.jpg[/img]
[i]Your choice: 1994 Mazda MX-5 Miata or 1969 Nissan Fairlady Z 432. Which Rocket Bunny fitted car would you drift towards the Gran Caldera peak? There’s no wrong answer. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d3f5f6e00043e017b36270aa44b2e540e5e4ddb7.jpg[/img]
[i]Undoubtedly one of the most iconic Rocket Bunny fitted cars in the world. The 1997 Mazda RX-7 is a JDM masterclass and in Forza Horizon 5, it’s double trouble. We’d ask which one you’d have in your garage only we already know the answer is both. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f48c5d627390fe925f35bf50a100b4539b611b0e.jpg[/img]
[i]JDM enthusiasts, here’s one for you. This ‘90s Nissan Silvia podium line-up is simply incomparable, and once you’ve fitted a Rocket Bunny kit courtesy of a visit to Forza Horizon 5’s mechanic, you’ll always have the looks, sounds and performance to standout at the Street Scene. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2e29773139222f7e9ba4b81d85eebf2ae45c2fe0.jpg[/img]
[i]Transform every detail of your 2015 Porsche Cayman GTS with this stylish Rocket Bunny kit featuring custom bumpers, unique fender flares and arches, and race ready aero parts.   [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7409a7a6df1cd580fccd9cc796df9ddbb0cd36cd.jpg[/img]
[i]Get that stance on! This 2014 Volkswagen Golf R fitted with the finest Rocket Bunny craftsmanship leaves an impression both on and off the pitch. [/i]

Which Rocket Bunny kit are you fitting onto your car next at the Horizon Festival? [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaForums]Discuss your collection of highly-tuned rides over on the Forza Forums[/url] and [url=https://aka.ms/SuggestionsHub]share your ideas for new cars, body kits and customization options on the Suggestions Hub[/url].

notes.title: Forza Year in Review – 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ce2401f54f4fe238263149d9204fe23b61fe1ed4.jpg[/img]

[h2]It’s almost time to ring in the New Year, however before we turn those calendars over to 2023, we’re looking back on the last twelve months of Forza. This is the 2022 Forza Year in Review![/h2]

From the release of Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels and the 10-Year Anniversary celebration of the Forza Horizon series to the first gameplay reveal of the all-new Forza Motorsport, as well as monthly series updates for Forza Horizon 5 and ongoing community Rivals events in Forza Motorsport 7, this has undoubtedly been a busy year for Forza fans.

To kickstart this Year in Review, we’re celebrating some of the most creative content submitted into our weekly Forza Horizon 5 Photo and Livery Contests. We’ve taken all the frontrunners from the past year and put them head-to-head in the ultimate showdown! Here are the winners and don’t forget to check out the Forza Forums for the full gallery of submissions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/10384e1b444cfead9b07237427a9ebb32da9500e.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2022-in-fh5-photos/578752][b]Best of 2022 in FH5 Photos[/b][/url]
[*][url=https://forums.forza.net/t/best-of-2022-in-fh5-liveries/578733][b]Best of 2022 in FH5 Liveries[/b][/url][/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fca99c4a9dff3e4de1cd156e73e4f85919ecbb29.jpg[/img]

[h2]Community Leaders[/h2]

Community is at the heart of the Forza franchise, and we’re constantly in awe of the incredible accomplishments of our players. Before we dive into everything that we’ve done this year, here’s an overview of what just some of most prominent community leaders have achieved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e934023f48feac0321123683333e4fa24e751a32.jpg[/img]

The Forza Spec Racing Series kicked off 2022 with its 44th season. LS Subaru continued their success from the year prior by securing a third consecutive championship and would go on to dominate the year’s schedule. In total, 47 drivers took on 54 races in six different vehicles. For 2023, the series celebrates ten years running with Season 50 starting January 10. No matter your racing finesse, everyone is invited to participate. Learn more and register on the r/FM4 subreddit.

In March, the long-running community racing league TORA (The Online Racing Association) hosted the 12 Hours of Sebring Revival on Forza Motorsport 7, where a staggering 106 teams – yes, you read that correctly – took the green flag across six lobbies with Daytona Prototype and GT machinery producing some epic racing action. From morning into darkness, the fight for the lead was never certain, with multiple teams holding the top spot in each stint. This event proved you should never give up on a race, as the winners ESV can attest to!

Fast forward to June when Forzatography Central hosted their special FTC30 event, 30 days of Forzatography. Each day featured a unique theme to spotlight the absolute best of the community's creativity. With so many wonderful pictures from both newcomers and veterans alike, it was truly incredible to see it all come together. To stay up to date with their latest Forzatography goodness, [url=https://twitter.com/FTCentral_]be sure to follow the FTCentral page[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f73cec6445bc29bcb67ec7f39dedbf006fb1a76e.jpg[/img]

2022 has been an exciting year for the FH5 Livery & Designs team resulting in 60 incredible designs being shared for everyone to download in Forza Horizon 5. With livery competitions ranging from Muscle Cars, Drift Kings to Halloween, the creativity and skill of this community was on full display all year long. The Halloween event proved to be a particular favorite among the team’s admins thanks to a staggering number of fearsome entries suitable for some thrilling scares across the Horizon Festival.

[h2]January[/h2]

We started 2022 by [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-3-update]celebrating the Lunar New Year in Forza Horizon 5[/url] with lanterns dressing the streets of Guanajuato, new Trailblazer PR Stunts, new Festival Playlist reward cars such as the 2003 Toyota Celica SS-I and the 2016 Zenvo TS1, and new Car Pass vehicles like the 1993 Jaguar XJ220S TWR and the 2018 Ferrari FXX-K Evo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/25548b729ab63f44426106d7aaac1d988549103d.jpg[/img]

Over in Forza Motorsport 7, we highlighted the return of Master Chief following the release of Halo Infinite one month prior. Players would drive the 2016 Jeep Trailcat on the Dubai Mountain Circuit to unlock Master Chief Driver Gear and an exclusive Halo Infinite livery – with a special Spartan-117 version reserved exclusively for those fastest lap times in the top 20% of the leaderboard.

At the end of the month, we invited [url=http://josefnewgarden.com/]our close friend of the Forza franchise and two-time IndyCar champion Josef Newgarden[/url] to throw it down in a special Rivals events featuring the 2019 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 Pace Car on Watkins Glen. Josef would return in March and May with two additional events, featuring the 2015 #10 Konica Minolta Corvette on Brands Hatch GP and his very own 2019 Chevrolet #2 Team Penske Dallara at “The Brickyard” on Indianapolis Motor Speedway to celebrate the Indy 500. Rewards were just as aplenty, including exclusive Josef Newgarden liveries for each vehicle, as well as special variants for those who beat Josef’s time. Chevrolet and Indianapolis Driver Gear were also up for grabs.

[h2]February[/h2]

The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-4-update]Horizon World Cup made its Mexico splash in February[/url]. You could support France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the UK or the USA by driving the cars of the country you wanted to cheer on in Festival Playlist events. Racesuits representing each of the competing countries were unlocked, while new Chinese cars were introduced into the Forza franchise for the first time, including the all-electric 2016 NIO EP9, the 2013 Wuling Sunshine S microvan and the 2015 MG MG3, which is the most popular Chinese manufactured car sold today in the UK!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/1ae3012d5801a4eefd8c54a1ac18e35924251f9e.jpg[/img]

Car Pass owners also received a new collection of cars, including the aggressively styled yet iconic 2005 MG XPower SV-R, a modern revision of one of the most renowned hatchbacks in the world, the 2021 Volkswagen Golf R, and a legend in Japanese hot-hatchback design, the 1992 Mazda 323 GT-R.

With this update, we also introduced the option to save and edit EventLab Blueprints, which had been highly requested from the community since Forza Horizon 5 released.

Japan emerged on top of the Horizon World Cup followed by France and Germany respectively. Check out the infographic below for a refresher on your incredible accomplishments throughout the greatest sporting event at the Horizon Festival:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/c00e044c529efcbdef2939e77dee996dada736e0.jpg[/img]

[h2]March[/h2]

The [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-5-update]Horizon Rush Takeover introduced several new PR Stunts[/url] and even transformed the Horizon Stadium into a dedicated Stunt Park where players could show off their best driving skills. With this update, we also expanded our accessibility options with [url=https://news.microsoft.com/features/forza-horizon-5-introduces-sign-language-support-throughout-in-game-scenes/]American Sign Language (ASL) and British Sign Language (BSL) for cinematics[/url], a feature that makes Forza Horizon 5 accessible to more players.

In addition to new EventLab props for creators, this update introduced some important fixes to the Festival Playlist and Photo Mode, as well as improvements to the Livery Editor interface and traffic synchronisation. For your garage, there was the aggressive and fast 2020 Nissan GT-R NISMO (R35) and the 1965 MINI Cooper S Forza Edition, while Car Pass holders received the 2006 Noble M400 and the 2017 Ferrari #25 Corse Clienti 488 Challenge.

[previewyoutube=7-LqVe2PArM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

In March, we also [url=https://forza.net/news/the-new-forza-forums-have-arrived]launched the new Forza Forums[/url] with a revamped navigation layout and faster loading, forum tags, as well as thread sorting.

To celebrate women in motorsports as part of Women’s History Month, we teamed up with professional race car driver Shannon McIntosh who inspired a new Rivals event, and its reward, in Forza Motorsport 7. Drivers would set their fastest times in the 2013 Ford Formula Ford EcoBoost 200 on Maple Valley to unlock an exclusive livery for that vehicle, which pays homage to Janet Guthrie and the IndyCar that she raced in the 1978 Indy 500. Drivers in the top 40% also received the elusive M. Rossi Driver Gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e82e2fc5b08d506bcc396f6bb0b379d14f9fd9ba.jpg[/img]

Later in the month, we released another Forza Horizon 5 update. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-6-update]Horizon Customs celebrated both the creative and racing talents of our community[/url] with Horizon Open Custom Racing, new unlockable Badges, and new EventLab features such as the Scale Gravity rule and improvements to terrain visibility at high altitude to provide a better visual experience when playing certain Blueprints.

Drift Club also made its mark on Mexico with the return of Welshman Robert Glenn and a new set of challenges, where you could get behind the wheel of the revolutionary 2021 Ford Mustang Mach-E 1400, courtesy of Formula Drift champion and RTR Vehicles founder Vaughn Gittin Jr. This car is incredibly unique with its ability to seamlessly swap between RWD and AWD at a button push.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/b29ac0987381cb361f99df597236ee0893fcb169.jpg[/img]

Over on the Festival Playlist we introduced the 2021 McLaren 765LT Coupe and the 2012 Ascari KZ1R, while Car Pass holders could drive the race-ready 2021 McLaren 620R and the 2021 MINI John Cooper Works GP, the fastest MINI ever.

[h2]April[/h2]

April saw us bring [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-7-update]Cinco de Mayo to life in Forza Horizon 5[/url]. As an annual celebration of Mexico’s culture, cuisine and heritage, new colorful decorations were displayed in Guanajuato, and we introduced new character cosmetics inspired by Mexico’s murals. We also added over 200 new Horizon Tour championships including S2 class racing, while new props and customizable rule conditions become available in EventLab, such as “Get Engine Torque” and “Get Gravity.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/ca7398937ddd492e4360d7ee19cb17f2b6c2edea.jpg[/img]

We also brought in fixes for Treasure Chests not solving, the Weekly Forzathon Challenge not registering the required car being owned and driven in the first chapter, and stalls on PC when challenging other players to head-to-head races.

Over on the Festival Playlist, we gave players a chance to unlock the car that celebrated 90 years of Scuderia Ferrari, the 2020 Ferrari SF90 Stradale, as well as the 2020 Ferrari F8 Tributo, a car that pays homage to the Prancing Horse’s most powerful V8 yet. Meanwhile, the Car Pass received the 2014 Forsberg Racing Nissan 'SafariZ' 370Z and the 2008 Dodge Magnum SRT8.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/89a834f7ad13d24d79d13ad6c1254acb0ec19efa.jpg[/img]

To celebrate Earth Day on April 22 and support Microsoft and Xbox’s commitment to reduce our carbon footprint and to raise awareness with our community, we featured a Forza Motorsport 7 Rivals event on VIR – Grand West featuring the 2010 Chevy #99 Green Earth Team Gunnar Oreca FLM09. All participants received an Earth Day themed livery on the 2015 BMW i8, while those in the top 40% unlocked an Earth Day themed Driver Gear.

[h2]May[/h2]

Just before Forza’s busiest month on the calendar, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-8]we celebrated German Automotive Excellence in Forza Horizon 5[/url] with new cars like the 2021 Porsche 911 GT3 and the 2018 Audi RS 4 Avant, while over in the Car Pass, we introduced the 2020 BMW M8 Competition Coupe and the 2020 Audi RS 3 Sedan.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2d5350f868379bf0c55e6f788822d4c4f3cb3abc.jpg[/img]

We teamed up with the [url=https://www.petersen.org/]Petersen Automotive Museum[/url] for a special Rivals event in Forza Motorsport 7 as they celebrated BMW’s 50th anniversary of the M series car. Players would set their fastest lap times on Laguna Seca in the 1975 BMW #25 BMW Motorsport 3.0 CSL to unlock two unique red and blue liveries for the car, inspired by the exterior design of the Petersen Museum.

[h2]June[/h2]

Undoubtedly the biggest month of the year for Forza fans, we were at the Xbox & Bethesda Games Showcase to reveal Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels, which released on July 19, as well as the first ever gameplay of Forza Motorsport.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/08209baf83c44ccbc8c0c0b6a24b287b1000c2c3.jpg[/img]

In the first expansion for Forza Horizon 5, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-hot-wheels]players would venture to the visually stunning, exhilarating new Hot Wheels Park[/url] in the clouds high above Mexico with over 200 km of twisting, looping iconic orange track! Across four new biomes packed with spectacular detail and diversity, drivers were challenged with unique track types such as gravity defying magnet tracks as well as ice, water flume, and rumble tracks. EventLab also expanded with 80 new snappable track and stunt pieces, which allows expansion owners to build their dream Hot Wheels tracks anywhere in Mexico or on Hot Wheels Park. Meanwhile, the cars… we’ll let the Bad to the Blade, the Deora II, the 2021 Hennessey Venom F5 and the 2019 Brabham BT62 all speak for themselves.

To prepare for the expansion, the Festival Playlist brought [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-9]four weeks of Hot Wheels themed events and rewards[/url], including returning Hot Wheels cars from previous Forza games, as well as Hot Wheels cosmetics and horns. This update saw the final Car Pass vehicles released, including the 2021 Aston Martin DBX, the 2020 Lexus RC F Track Edition and the 2019 Nissan 370z Nismo. It also introduced temporal anti-aliasing (TAA) for PC players, coop play for Horizon Stories, a duplicate car filter and expanded VO and subtitle support for additional languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/fb0a8275e7afb96f99c134e8be5fc31f0736cdad.jpg[/img]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-motorsport-the-most-technically-advanced-racing-game-ever-made]In the first ever gameplay reveal of Forza Motorsport[/url], we showcased how the fan-favorite track Maple Valley is being brought to life in stunning detail and beauty. We also revealed that Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps and Laguna Seca would return, alongside Kyalami, our first ever South African track, as well as Hakone, an original, high-speed Grand Prix circuit set in Japan. Fully dynamic time of day and weather is available on every track, while our environments have been captured using photogrammetry and 3D material scans using advanced rendering features to fully immerse you in our Motorsport world.

Based on your feedback, Forza Motorsport introduces new features like tire and fuel management, multiple tire compounds and new in-depth car building. With a 48 times improvement in the fidelity of our physics simulation, advanced car damage reproduced down to the individual scratches on the bodywork, and real-time ray tracing on-track that makes everything feel more connected, natural and real, Forza Motorsport is a generational leap in immersion built from the ground up to showcase the Xbox Series X|S consoles.

[previewyoutube=5qZRgVD_niU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

A few days later, we were joined by Forza Motorsport Creative Director Chris Esaki on Forza Monthly to discuss everything you saw in our trailer and gameplay video. [url=https://youtu.be/mfcmJor6tXY?t=440]If you missed it, be sure to check out the interview[/url].

To celebrate Pride 2022 alongside Xbox, in June we gifted all players an exclusive Forza rainbow livery adorning the 2009 Pagani Zonda Cinque Roadster in Forza Horizon 5 and Forza Horizon 4, as well as Forza Motorsport 7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/113cb7e1e26b6185aa23404622d444767e16d7ad.jpg[/img]

Lastly, we retired ForzaMotorsport.net and [url=https://forza.net/news/welcome]launched the new Forza.net[/url] to celebrate our players and combine cars, community, and creativity in a sleek, modernized website. It’s very likely that you’re reading this blog on it!

[h2]July[/h2]

In July, [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-hot-wheels-now-available]we launched the Forza Horizon 5: Hot Wheels expansion[/url] and announced a partnership with Extreme E inviting players to get behind the wheel of the fully-electric Extreme E ODYSSEY 21 e-SUV and experience [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-series-10]four weeks of off-road racing action on the Festival Playlist[/url]. We also introduced the Hot Wheels signature redline tire compound and 12 new Hot Wheels Spectraflame colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/88a5c32f7c234f4d707dffe35f64e2ac94659a2b.png[/img]

[h2]August[/h2]

Forza Horizon 5 players were invited to [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-ramis-racing-history]tour Mexico’s rich heritage of automotive manufacture and racing history in Rami’s Racing History[/url]. It featured an eight-chapter Horizon Story called Made in Mexico which explored the major eras of manufacturing and car culture in the country. This update introduced display integration support for the Thrustmaster T248X and a Festival Playlist highlighting four unique eras of cars with special Classic Wednesday Sales on the Forzathon Shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/97c6ace76ebfa5855d1e915c380a54c0b4e8ecb0.jpg[/img]

New cars included the second generation 2021 BMW M4 Competition Coupe and the futuristic 2020 Xpeng P7 sedan. The Autoshow also received its most expensive car, the 1955 Mercedes-Benz 300 SLR priced at 140 million credits in honor of the real-world auction that saw it become the most valuable car in the world!

[h2]September[/h2]

The Horizon Road Trip introduced the first of several new body kit pre-sets for Forza Horizon 5, like the ADRO USA widebody for the 2019 Hyundai Veloster N and the APR Performance Inc. widebody for the 2010 Volkswagen Golf R. For character customization, we added a new category called Amplification with a selection of hearing aids in various colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/5ed47d3dfa7769b4fc752c6044f0f1678c1366fc.jpg[/img]

The Festival Playlist for this series was [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-horizon-road-trip]inspired by the variety of racing activities available throughout Mexico’s vast landscape[/url] with some championships featuring additional races and Goliath-type routes. This update also introduced three new to Forza cars, including the futuristic all-wheel-drive 2021 Audi RS e-tron GT, the aesthetically wild 2021 Audi RS 7 Sportback and the 2021 Lynk & Co 03+ sports saloon.

Later in September, [url=https://forza.net/news/get-ready-horizon-10-year-anniversary]we announced at the Tokyo Game Show[/url] that Forza Horizon 5 would celebrate the 10-Year Anniversary of Forza Horizon with a special update featuring a new story, as well as returning cars, music and more.

[previewyoutube=onFtzs2mmI8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, on Forza Monthly, we were joined by GM of Motorsport, Dan Greenawalt and Creative Director Chris Esaki for an insightful discussion into the development and production cycles of Forza Motorsport. We also said we’d be sharing more about the game next year leading up to its release in Spring 2023. [url=https://youtu.be/D82BR774SVg?t=1395]Be sure to check it out if you missed it[/url].

[h2]October[/h2]

The Horizon 10-Year Anniversary arrived with [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-celebrates-horizon-10-year-anniversary]four weeks of events reliving the series’ most iconic gameplay moments[/url]. Completing all five chapters of the Horizon Origins Story unlocked the 2013 Dodge SRT Viper GTS Anniversary Edition paying homage to the original Forza Horizon cover car. Across 16 Street Races, four head-to-head Midnight Battles emerged with each allowing you to score the competitor’s car. Meanwhile, a new Horizon Classics Prop Pack expanded EventLab with 97 recognizable props and structures from previous Forza Horizon games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2828f0e830bc570c2355e23dba74ea63525c1657.png[/img]

The Horizon Mixtape brought a flash of throwback music to your radio dial, with additional songs unlocked on the Festival Playlist. In addition to 22 ADV.1 rims, iconic Forza Horizon cars returned, including the 2010 Ferrari 599XX, the 2011 Koenigsegg Agera, the 2012 Eagle Speedster and the 2010 Aston Martin One-77. With each week themed around Forza Horizon 1-4 and temporary Festival outposts setup around Mexico, there was plenty of nostalgia-fueled driving on tap!

To coincide with the Horizon Festival’s 10-Year Anniversary, we hosted four Rivals events in Forza Motorsport 7 that put your driving skills to the test in special car and track combos that not only celebrated past Forza Horizon games, but also corresponded to the game in the Festival Playlist spotlight in Forza Horizon 5! In addition to exclusive Forza Horizon branded Driver Gear, those who set a lap time in all four events unlocked the highly coveted 1958 MG MGA Twin-Cam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e22e6f03a0ea827e1c92ba9e262a96327cbd2247.png[/img]

We also posted a special anniversary blog looking back on the past decade of the Forza Horizon series, reflecting on its growth and evolution over the past ten years. [url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-celebrating-a-decade-of-festivals]Check it out for a deep dive tour into the history of Forza Horizon[/url]!

Additionally in October, we launched the Suggestions Hub on the Forza Forums, the next step on our journey in listening to player feedback. This is a central location for you to share your constructive input and ideas with the teams at Turn 10 and Playground Games. We also have car and track voting, and you can even upvote feature suggestions posted by other players. [url=https://forza.net/news/introducing-suggestions-hub]Here’s a link with all the details to help you get started[/url].

[h2]November[/h2]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-donut-media]Donut Media was on the menu for November’s Forza Horizon 5 update[/url] as James and Nolan flew into Horizon Mexico with a brand-new tire-burning Horizon Story. PC players received access to several new options, including NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution, NVIDIA DLAA and AMD FSR 2.2, as well as enhanced DirectX Raytracing pre-sets with car self-reflections in Free Roam and Photo Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/a01098050b6c5e0e11a6170574b9268761afd597.jpg[/img]

This update also included 21 Rocket Bunny kits, a Festival Playlist full of Donut Media goodness and the new-to-franchise 2020 Lynk & Co #100 Cyan Racing 03. Remember that this update was only the beginning of our collaboration with Donut Media with more tasty treats to come in 2023!

[h2]December[/h2]

To mark the end of the first year of the Horizon Festival, Playground Games shared this infographic to highlight all the updates to Forza Horizon 5 over this past year. With 137 cars, over 270 EventLab props and 23 body kits, on top of the constant flow of new events and challenges on the Festival Playlist, 2022 has undoubtedly been a packed year of driving adventures for Forza players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f89735e6a0a145f42feccd995ff5a68d455facf2.png[/img]

[url=https://forza.net/news/forza-horizon-5-holidays]Today, we’re celebrating the Horizon Holidays in Mexico[/url] with the return of car gifting through Secret Santa – and thanks to the generosity of our Forza Horizon 5 community, everyone has already unlocked two incredible rewards: the dazzling Holiday Tree Outfit and the open-top hybrid 2020 Lamborghini Sián Roadster. Redeem yours today from the “Gifts” tab of the Message Center if you haven’t already, where you’ll also find the 2022 CUPRA UrbanRebel Concept through January 5, 2023.

Once you’ve collected all your holiday treats, spread the seasonal joy by visiting the Horizon Wonderland in Mulegé, where you can find limited time holiday sales in the Forzathon Shop, and don’t forget to bring your Convoy to the Ice Rink Stadium for some sliding shenanigans. You’ll also find festive decorations aplenty, from the towns and city of Guanajuato to even your own home!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/2c892910f9d8247825d0a98dbc80c12200d61aac.png[/img]

Over in Forza Motorsport 7, the Triple Crown Rivals event is live through January 3, 2023! You’re invited to race the Turn 10 Community Team across three events voted for by players including Open-Wheel, Prototype and GT Cars, and score incredible rewards along the way. 

The events include the 1988 McLaren #12 Honda McLaren MP4 at Suzuka with the Olympia Driver Gear reward, the 1991 Mazda #18 787B at Road Atlanta featuring the JD Driver Gear, and the 2009 BMW #92 Rahal Letterman Racing M3 GT2 at Hockenheimring where you’ll receive the Kait Driver Gear. Those who set a time in all three events will also receive the 2010 Maserati Gran Turismo S Forza Edition and the Master Chief Driver Gear. [url=https://forza.net/events/ForzaTripleCrownTakeontheForzaTeam/]Check out the event where you can find the list of participating Turn 10 Gamertags[/url]. You might even find T10 Tio Forza on the leaderboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/4ee7597ff29ba9a23dcac8542994fbead2b6f6ca.jpg[/img]

That wraps up this edition of the Forza Year in Review! Thanks to our incredible community for their continued support, their constructive feedback and input, as well as their creative spirits. We’re grateful to have you all on every road-trip, and we hope you join us in 2023 as we gear up for the launch of the all-new Forza Motorsport and the debut of Forza Horizon 5’s second expansion. Until then, we wish everyone a happy and safe holiday, and a wonderful New Year.

notes.title: Luxurious Driving Awaits as a Limousine Enters the Festival Playlist
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/0f80285ced0cc6709c32d148ad77cde21543fffa.jpg[/img]
 
There is no doubt that the [b]2013 Cadillac XTS Limousine[/b] is the longest car in the Forza Horizon 5 garage. After all, this is a limousine, so it is deservedly massive, though it’s no slouch on the open road with an impressive 300 horsepower in the stock version and an optional NASCAR engine upgrade. Practice your cornering from a new perspective with the most hulking vehicle you’ll find in Mexico – the limo can be yours for [b]20 PTS[/b] on the [b]Festival Playlist[/b].

This week is also your opportunity to unlock the [b]1955 Mercedes-Benz 300 SLR[/b] – the most expensive car in the Forza Horizon 5 Autoshow priced at 140 million credits. A treasured masterpiece, both in-game and in the real world, only two prototypes of the 300 SLR were ever built, and it is currently considered the most valuable car in the world as just earlier this year, the 300 SLR was sold at auction to a private car collector for $143 million.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/05f5253822bc05739ba4f6ad1c3f8ab8bdf64623.jpg[/img]

Both cars can be yours on the [b]Festival Playlist[/b], so be sure to unlock them and save a pretty penny before [b]Thursday, December 29[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]20 PTS:[/b] 2013 Cadillac XTS Limousine
[*][b]40 PTS:[/b] 1955 Mercedes-Benz 300 SLR[/list]The [b]Weekly Forzathon Challenge[/b] celebrates an ultra-lightweight and high-performance supercar developed in Mexico, the [b]2017 VUHL 05RR[/b]. Designed for the track while remaining street legal, the VUHL 05RR can reach a top speed beyond 170mph thanks to its power and overall lightness. Get to grips with it across Road Racing, top speed and Danger Sign challenges. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/826e41665f4fb73c5048ff81f42c37cd4c532b61.jpg[/img]

Visit the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] and spend your [b]Forzathon Points[/b] on the [b]2013 Lamborghini Veneno[/b] and the [b]1964 Aston Martin DB5[/b], as well as the [b]Santa Outfit[/b] and [b]Santa Hat[/b], and the [b]HO HO HO![/b] car horn. This season also includes the first of our [b]holiday Forzathon Shop sales[/b]. From [b]2:30 PM UTC[/b] on [b]Dec. 24[/b] until [b]2:30 PM UTC[/b] on [b]Dec. 26[/b], look out for unmissable discounts on the [b]2011 Lamborghini Sesto Elemento Forza Edition[/b], the [b]2004 Saleen S7[/b], the [b]2019 Zenvo TSR-S[/b] and the[b] 2019 Porsche 911 GT3 RS[/b]. The perfect gifts to share in [b]Secret Santa[/b]!

Put those Santamental Feelings aside in [b]The Trial[/b], because the Drivatars will be bringing their a-game as always. Lead your team to victory and win the [b]1973 Holden HQ Monaro GTS 350[/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/f37655fa85652182e9ac8385664e3b720da5b751.jpg[/img]

Over in [b]EventLab[/b], Forza faithful [b]Don Joewon Song[/b] is celebrating the [b]Neon Nights[/b] with a special event encompassed in waves of color and unique architectural “Relics” to discover. Complete it to unlock the song [b]“Language”[/b] by [b]Porter Robinson[/b] for the [b]Horizon Mixtape[/b].

There’s a duo of[b] Super Wheelspins[/b] to unlock this week from [b]Seasonal PR Stunts[/b] in the [b]Sendero Speed Trap[/b] and the [b]Punto De Vista Speed Zone[/b]. What’s more, [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] visitors can also test their driving finesse at the [b]Horizon Nexus Speed Trap[/b] to bag another [b]Super Wheelspin[/b].
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/282af37c375ba1b7930e3b71228b319b01b186a9.jpg[/img]

Bring your tuned rides into the [b]Seasonal Championships [/b]and unlock the [b]2018 Exomotive Exocet Off-Road[/b] in [b]All The Trimmings[/b], the [b]2019 BMW Z4 Roadster[/b] in [b]Candlelight Parade[/b] and the [b]1969 Volkswagen Class 5/1600 Baja Bug[/b] in [b]Oh, Deer[/b]. Don’t forget there’s always a fourth you can complete on [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b], featuring the [b]2016 Porsche Cayman GT4[/b] by winning the [b]Canyon and On[/b]!

Photograph the Snowman at the [b]Buenas Vistas Player House[/b] in [b]Cabo San Lucas[/b] to complete this week’s [b]Photo Challenge[/b] and unlock the [b]Merry Christmas[/b] car horn. [b]Collectibles[/b] are also on the menu. [b]Smash 20 Snowmen[/b] at the top of [b]La Gran Caldera[/b] – Mexico's massive volcano – to unlock the [b]Snowman Outfit[/b]. Finally, finish 30th or better in [b]The Eliminator[/b] to get the [b]Gingerbread Outfit[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d7658e7fc1fa3762675d4ab49ed5e62bed81806a.jpg[/img]

That’s everything in store for this penultimate week of the Horizon Holidays. [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaForums]Discuss these events and rewards over on the Forza Forums[/url]. Do you have ideas for future Forza Horizon 5 updates and Festival Playlist content? [url=https://aka.ms/SuggestionsHub]Check out the Suggestions Hub where you can post your feedback and upvote ideas shared by the Forza community[/url].

Until next time, we hope you all have a wonderful holiday break! See you at the Horizon Festival.

notes.title: Unlock a Classic Plymouth Fury in Forza Horizon 5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/8dbc1281e0115a5de47efd4b8dcff2686ef73d85.jpg[/img]

Gorgeous, alluring and powerful. There’s no car more fun to drive in a straight line down an airstrip than the [b]1958 Plymouth Fury[/b]. With a 305hp Golden Commando V8 under the hood and beautiful lines worthy of close appreciation, the Fury can be yours for [b]20 PTS[/b] on this week’s [b]Festival Playlist[/b]. 

Available through [b]Thursday, December 22[/b], here’s a look at what’s in store for this week:  
[list]
[*][b]20 PTS:[/b] 1958 Plymouth Fury 
[*][b]40 PTS:[/b] 1970 Dodge Coronet Super Bee [/list]Sport is in the name of the [b]2015 Audi S1[/b]. With an iconic rallying legacy, this is the smallest S Line Audi fitted with a 2-liter turbocharged engine and the renowned quattro AWD system. Put it through its pace in the [b]Weekly Forzathon Challenge[/b].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/09bdfe6ee4ac4b8821b2190087dd9067f2ce929a.jpg[/img]

Spend those hard earned [b]Forzathon Points[/b] over in the [b]Forzathon Shop[/b] to acquire the [b]2014 Ferrari FXX K[/b] and the [b]1968 Ferrari 365 GTB/4[/b], and show your appreciation for the holidays by expanding your wardrobe with the [b]Elf Outfit [/b]and the [b]Elf Hat[/b], as well as the [b]Deck the Halls[/b] car horn. 

Did somebody say minigames? [b]Horizon Arcade[/b] is featured on this week’s Festival Playlist, so invite your friends for fun and ensure they stick around for [b]The Trial[/b], as overtaking a team of Drivatars to victory will ensure your team walks away with the [b]2011 BMW 1 Series M Coupe[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/e4792b249231b94b74070b632cff2547a2a3d6d7.jpg[/img]

Survive the Holidays in [b]Seasonal Playground Games[/b] and receive the [b]2015 Jaguar XE-S[/b] for your participation. This week’s [b]Seasonal PR Stunts[/b] are your opportunity to win a trio of [b]Super Wheelspins[/b]. Take on the [b]Desert Dunes Danger Sign[/b], the [b]Pyramid of the Sun Speed Trap[/b] and the [b]Granjas Trailblazer[/b]. Unlock a fourth [b]Super Wheelspin[/b] over on [b]Hot Wheels Park[/b] by completing the [b]Rockslide Drift Zone[/b]. 

Three [b]Seasonal Championships[/b] await with a trio of reward cars, including the [b]1999 Lotus Elise Series 1 Sport 190[/b] in [b]Papa Noel[/b], the [b]2012 Mercedes-Benz SLK 55 AMG[/b] in [b]Extra Special[/b] and the [b]1986 Lamborghini LM 002[/b] in [b]Boot Full of Presents[/b].  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/7f8564f7fca5f0021d00dac3952493b7ac09b402.jpg[/img]

Photograph the [b]Snowman[/b] at the [b]Lugar Tranquilo Player House[/b] in [b]Playa Azul[/b] to complete this week’s [b]Photo Challenge[/b] and unlock the [b]Happy Snowman Head[/b] for your character. 

Don’t forget to check out the [b]Horizon Super7[/b] this week where you can win a [b]2012 BMW M5[/b] by successfully completing all the [b]Challenge Cards[/b] you’re presented! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40722422/d50c9fa45f5d403d15a8515e815e070b6bde1e2f.jpg[/img]

Next week the Horizon Holidays celebrations continue! As always, we’ll share the latest events and rewards, and you can [url=https://aka.ms/ForzaForums]discuss this week’s Festival Playlist content over on the Forza Forums[/url] and we’re eager to know your thoughts, so be sure to [url=https://aka.ms/SuggestionsHub]share your ideas for future updates and improvements on our official Suggestions Hub[/url] where you can also upvote other player ideas.  

Rev up your engines and we’ll see you at the Horizon Festival.
